Mishneh Torah, Repentance 5: Reshut lechol adam netuna. im ratza lehattot atzmo lederech tova velihyot tzaddik harshut beyado. veim ratza lehattot atzmo lederech raa velihyot rasha harshut beyado. hu shekkatuv battora <small>(Bereshit 3 22)</small> "hen haadam haya keachad mimmennu ladaat tov vara". kelomar hen min ze shel adam haya yachid baolam veen min sheni dome lo beze hainyan sheyyehe hu meatzmo bedato uvemachashavto yodea hattov vehara veose kol ma shehu chafetz veen mi sheyyeakkev beyado millaasot hattov o hara. vechevan shekken hu pen yishlach yado:

Al yaavor bemachashavtecha davar ze sheomrim tippeshe ummot haolam verov galme bene yisrael shehakkadosh baruch hu gozer al haadam mittechillat beriyyato lihyot tzaddik o rasha. en haddavar ken ella kol adam rauy lo lihyot tzaddik kemoshe rabbenu o rasha keyaravam o chacham o sachol o rachaman o achzari o kilay o shua vechen shear kol haddeot. veen lo mi sheyyichpehu velo gozer alav velo mi shemmoshcho leechad mishshene hadderachim ella hu meatzmo umiddato note lee zo derech sheyyirtze. hu sheyyirmeyahu amar <small>(Eicha 3 38)</small> "mippi elyon lo tetze haraot vehattov". kelomar en habbore gozer al haadam lihyot tov velo lihyot ra. vechevan shekken hu nimtza ze hachote hu hifsid et atzmo. ulefichach rauy lo livkot ulekonen al chataav veal ma sheasa lenafsho ugemalah raa. hu shekkatuv acharav <small>(Eicha 3 39)</small> "ma yitonen adam chay" vegomer. vechazar veamar hoil ureshutenu beyadenu umiddatenu asinu kol haraot rauy lanu lachazor bitshuva velaazov rishenu sheharshut atta beyadenu. hu shekkatuv acharav <small>(Eicha 3 40)</small> "nachpesa derachenu venachkora venashuva" vegomer:

Vedavar ze ikkar gadol hu vehu ammud hattora vehammitzva shenneemar <small>(Devarim 30 15)</small> "ree natatti lefanecha hayyom et hachayyim". uchetiv <small>(Devarim 11 26)</small> "ree anochi noten lifnechem hayyom". kelomar sheharshut beyedchem. vechol sheyyachpotz haadam laasot mimmaase bene haadam ose ben tovim ben raim. umippene ze hainyan neemar <small>(Devarim 5 26)</small> "mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem". kelomar sheen habbore kofe bene haadam velo gozer alehen laasot tova o raa ella hakkol masur lahem:

Illu hael haya gozer al haadam lihyot tzaddik o rasha o illu haya sham davar shemmoshech et haadam beikkar toladto lederech min hadderachim o lemadda min hammaddaot o ledea min haddeot o lemaase min hammaasim kemo shebbodim millibbam hattippeshim hovre shamayim heach haya metzavve lanu al yede hanneviim ase kach veal taase kach hetivu darchechem veal telchu achare rishachem vehu mittechillat beriyyato kevar nigzar alav o toladto timshoch oto ledavar shei efshar lazuz mimmennu. uma makom haya lechol hattora kullah uvee ze din veeze mishpat nifra min harasha o meshallem sachar latztzaddik. hashofet kol haaretz lo yaase mishpat. veal titma vetomar heach yihye haadam ose kol ma sheyyachpotz veyihyu maasav mesurim lo vechi yease baolam davar shello birshut kono velo cheftzo vehakkatuv omer <small>(Tehillim 135 6)</small> "kl asher chafetz Adonai asa bashshamayim uvaaretz". da shehakkol kecheftzo yease veaf al pi shemmaasenu mesurin lanu. ketzad. keshem shehayyotzer chafetz lihyot haesh veharuach olim lemala vehammayim vehaaretz yordim lematta vehaggalgal sovev beiggul vechen shear beriyyot haolam lihyot keminhagan shechafetz bo. kacha chafetz lihyot haadam reshuto beyado vechol maasav mesurin lo velo yihye lo lo kofe velo moshech ella hu meatzmo uvedato shennatan lo hael ose kol shehaadam yachol laasot. lefichach danin oto lefi maasav. im asa tova metivin lo veim asa raa merein lo. hu shehannavi omer <small>(Malachi 1 9)</small> miyyedchem hayta zot lachem. <small>(yeshaya 66 3)</small> gam hemma bacharu bedarchehem. uveinyan ze amar shelomo <small>(Kohelet 11 9)</small> "semach bachur beyaldutecha" <small>(Kohelet 11 9)</small> "veda ki al kol elle yeviacha haelohim bammishpat". kelomar da sheyyesh beyadcha koach laasot veatid atta litten et haddin:

Shemma tomar vahalo hakkadosh baruch hu yodea kol ma sheyyihye vekodem sheyyihye yeda shezze yihye tzaddik o rasha o lo yeda. im yeda shehu yihye tzaddik i efshar shello yihye tzaddik veim tomar sheyyeda sheyyihye tzaddik veefshar sheyyihye rasha hare lo yeda haddavar al buryo. da shetteshuvat sheela zo arukka meeretz midda urechava minni yam vechamma ikkarim gedolim vahararim ramim teluyim bah aval tzarich atta leda ulehavin bedavar ze sheani omer. kevar bearnu beferek sheni mehilchot yesode hattora shehakkadosh baruch hu eno yodea middea shehi chutz mimmennu kivne adam shehem vedatam shenayim. ella hu yitalle shemo vedato echad veen dato shel adam yechola lehassig davar ze al buryo. ucheshem sheen koach baadam lehassig velimtzo amittat habbore shenneemar <small>(Shemot 33 20)</small> "ki lo yirani haadam vachay" kach en koach baadam lehassig velimtzo dato shel habbore. hu shehannavi amar <small>(yeshaya noah 8)</small> "ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem velo darchechem derachay". vechevan shekken hu en banu koach leda heach yeda hakkadosh baruch hu kol habberuim vehammaasim aval neda belo safek shemmaase haadam beyad haadam veen hakkadosh baruch hu moshcho velo gozer alav laasot kach. velo mippene kabbalat haddat bilvad noda davar ze ella birayot berurot middivre hachachma. umippene ze neemar bannevua sheddanin et haadam al maasav kefi maasav im tov veim ra veze hu haikkar shekkol divre hannevua teluyin bo:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 6: Pesukim harebe yesh battora uvedivre neviim shehen nirin kesotrin ikkar ze venichshalin bahen rov haadam veyaale al datan mehen shehakkadosh baruch hu hu gozer al haadam laasot raa o tova vesheen libbo shel adam masur lo lehattoto lechol asher yirtze. vahare ani mevaer ikkar gadol shemmimmennu teda perush kol otan happesukim. bizman sheadam echad o anshe medina chotim veose hachote chet sheose middato uvirtzono kemo shehodanu rauy lehippara mimmennu vehakkadosh baruch hu yodea ech yippara. yesh chet shehaddin noten shennifraim mimmennu al cheto baolam hazze begufo o bemamono o bevanav hakketannim shebbanav shel adam hakketannim sheen bahem daat velo higgiu lichlal mitzvot kekinyano hen uchetiv <small>(Devarim 24 16)</small> "ish becheto yamut" ad sheyyease ish. veyesh chet shehaddin noten shennifrain mimmennu laolam habba veen laover alav shum nezek baolam hazze. veyesh chet shennifrain mimmennu baolam hazze velaolam habba:
Bamme devarim amurim bizman shello asa teshuva aval im asa teshuva hatteshuva kitris lifne happuranut. ucheshem shehaadam chote middato uvirtzono kach hu ose teshuva middato uvirtzono:

Veefshar sheyyechta adam chet gadol o chataim rabbim ad sheyyitten haddin lifne dayan haemet sheyyehe happeraon mizze hachote al chataim ellu sheasa birtzono umiddato shemmonin mimmennu hatteshuva veen mannichin lo reshut lashuv merisho kede sheyyamut veyovad becheto sheasa. hu shehakkadosh baruch hu amar al yede yeshayahu <small>(yeshaya 6 10)</small> "hashemen lev haam hazze" vegomer. vechen hu omer <small>(11 36 16)</small> "vayyihyu malivim bemalache haelohim uvozim devarav umittateim binviav ad alot chamat Adonai beammo ad leen marpe". kelomar chatu birtzonam vehirbu lifshoa ad shennitchayyevu limnoa mehen hatteshuva shehi hammarpe. lefichach katuv battora <small>(Shemot 4 21)</small> "vaani (achazzek) [akshe] et lev paro". lefi shechata meatzmo techilla veherea leyisrael haggarim beartzo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 1 10)</small> "hava nitchakkema lo". natan haddin limnoa hatteshuva mimmennu ad shennifra mimmennu. lefichach chizzek hakkadosh baruch hu et libbo. velamma haya sholeach lo beyad moshe veomer shelach vaase teshuva uchevar amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu en atta meshalleach shenneemar <small>(Shemot 9 30)</small> "veatta vaavadecha yadati" vegomer <small>(Shemot 9 16)</small> "veulam baavur zot heemadticha". kede lehodia levae haolam shebbizman shemmonea hakkadosh baruch hu hatteshuva lachote eno yachol lashuv ella yamut berisho sheasa bitchilla birtzono. vechen sichon lefi avonot shehayu lo nitchayyev lemano min hatteshuva shenneemar <small>(Devarim 2 30)</small> "ki hiksha Adonai elohecha et rucho veimmetz et levavo". vechen hakkenaanim lefi toavotehen mana mehen hatteshuva ad sheasu milchama im yisrael. shenneemar <small>(Yehoshua 11 20)</small> "ki meet Adonai hayta lechazzek et libbam likrat hammilchama im yisrael lemaan hacharimam". vechen yisrael bime eliyyahu lefi shehirbu lifshoa mana meotan hammarbim lifshoa teshuva shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 18 37)</small> "veatta hasibbota et libbam achorannit" kelomar manata mehen hatteshuva. nimtzeta omer shello gazar hael al paro lehara leyisrael. velo al sichon lachato beartzo. velo al hakkenaanim lehateiv. velo al yisrael laavod avoda zara. ella kullan chatu meatzman vechullan nitchayyevu limnoa mehen hatteshuva:

Ucheinyan ze shoalin hatztzaddikim vehanneviim bitfillatam meet Adonai leazram al haemet. kemo sheamar david <small>(Tehillim 27 11)</small> "horeni Adonai darkecha". kelomar al yimnauni chataay derech haemet shemmimmenna eda darkecha veyichud shemecha. vechen ze sheamar <small>(Tehillim 51 14)</small> "veruach nediva tismecheni" kelomar tanniach ruchi laasot cheftzecha veal yigremu li chataay lemaneni mitteshuva ella tihye harshut beyadi ad sheechezor veavin veeda derech haemet. veal derech zo kol haddome lifsukim ellu:

Umahu ze sheamar david <small>(Tehillim 25 8)</small> "tov veyashar Adonai al ken yore chattaim baddarech" <small>(Tehillim 25 9)</small> "yadrech anavim" vegomer. ze sheshshalach neviim lahem modiim darche Adonai umachzirin otan bitshuva. veod shennatan bahem koach lilmod ulehavin. shemmidda zo bechol adam shekkol zeman shehu nimshach bedarche hachachma vehatztzedek mitavve lahen verodef otam. vehu ma sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha ba littaher mesayyein oto kelomar yimtza atzmo neezar al haddavar. vahalo katuv battora <small>(Bereshit 15 13)</small> "vaavadum veinnu otam", hare gazar al hammitzriyyim laasot ra. uchetiv <small>(Devarim lo 16)</small> "vekam haam hazze vezana achare elohe nechar haaretz", hare gazar al yisrael laavod avoda zara. velamma nifra mehen. lefi shello gazar al ish peloni hayyadua sheyyihye hu hazzone ella kol echad veechad meotan hazzonim laavod avoda zara illu lo ratza laavod lo haya oved. velo hodio habbore ella minhago shel olam. ha lema ze dome leomer haam hazze yihye bahen tzaddikim ureshaim. lo mippene ze yomar harasha kevar nigzar alav sheyyihye rasha mippene shehodia lemoshe sheyyihyu reshaim beyisrael. kainyan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 11)</small> "ki lo yechdal evyon mikkerev haaretz". vechen hammitzriyyim kol echad veechad meotan hammetzerim vehammereim leyisrael illu lo ratza lehara lahem harshut beyado. shello gazar al ish yadua ella hodio shessof zaro atid lehishtabed beeretz lo lahem. uchevar amarnu sheen koach baadam leda heach yeda hakkadosh baruch hu devarim haatidin lihyot:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 7: Hoil ureshut kol adam netuna lo kemo shebbearnu yishtaddel adam laasot teshuva ulehitvaddot befiv mechataav velinor kappav mechataav kede sheyyamut vehu baal teshuva veyizke lechayye haolam habba:

Leolam yire adam atzmo keillu hu note lamut veshemma yamut bishato venimtza omed becheto. lefichach yashuv mechataav miyyad velo yeamer kesheazkin ashuv shemma yamut terem sheyyazkin. hu sheshshelomo amar bechachmato <small>(Kohelet 9 8)</small> "bechol et yihyu vegadecha levanim":

Al tomar sheen teshuva ella meaverot sheyyesh bahen maase kegon zenut vegezel ugeneva. ella keshem shetztzarich adam lashuv meellu kach hu tzarich lechappes bedeot raot sheyyesh lo velashuv min hakkaas umin haeva umin hakkina umin hahittul umerdifat hammamon vehakkavod umerdifat hammaachalot vechayyotze bahen min hakkol tzarich lachazor bitshuva. veellu haavonot kashim meotan sheyyesh bahen maase shebbizman sheadam nishka beellu kashe hu lifrosh mehem. vechen hu omer <small>(yeshaya noah 7)</small> "yaazov rasha" vegomer:

Veal yedamme adam baal teshuva shehu meruchak mimmaalat hatztzaddikim mippene haavonot vehachataot sheasa. en haddavar ken ella ahuv venechmad hu lifne habbore keillu lo chata meolam. velo od ella shessecharo harebe shehare taam taam hachet uferash mimmennu vechavash yitzro. amru chachamim makom shebbaale teshuva omdin en tzaddikim gemurin yecholin laamod bo. kelomar maalatan gedola mimmaalat ellu shello chatu meolam mippene shehen kovshim yitzram yoter mehem:

Kol hanneviim kullan tziuu al hatteshuva veen yisrael nigalin ella bitshuva. uchevar hivticha tora shessof yisrael laasot teshuva besof galutan umiyyad hen nigalin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 30 1)</small> "vehaya chi yavou alecha kol haddevarim" vegomer <small>(Devarim 30 2)</small> "veshavta ad Adonai elohecha" <small>(Devarim 30 3)</small> "veshav Adonai elohecha" vegomer:

Gedola teshuva shemmekarevet et haadam lashshechina shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 14 2)</small> "shuva yisrael ad Adonai elohecha". veneemar <small>(Amos 4 6)</small> "velo shavtem aday neum Adonai". veneemar <small>(yirmeya 4 1)</small> "im tashuv yisrael neum Adonai elay tashuv". kelomar im tachazor bitshuva bi tidbak. hatteshuva mekarevet et harchokim. emesh haya ze sanouy lifne hammakom meshukkatz umeruchak vetoeva. vehayyom hu ahuv venechmad karov veyadid. vechen atta motze shebbelashon shehakkadosh baruch hu marchik hachotim bah mekarev et hashshavim ben yachid ben rabbim. shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 2 1)</small> "vehaya bimkom asher yeamer lahem lo ammi attem yeamer lahem bene el chay". veneemar bichanyahu berishato (ketov) [kitvu] <small>(yirmeya 22 30)</small> "et haish hazze ariri gever lo yitzlach beyamav", <small>(yirmeya 22 24)</small> "im yihye kanyahu ben yehoyakim melech yehuda chotam al yad yemini" vegomer. vechevan sheshshav begaluto neemar bizrubbavel beno <small>(Chagai 2 23)</small> "bayyom hahu neum Adonai tzevaot ekkachacha zerubbavel ben shealtiel avdi neum Adonai vesamticha kachotam":

Kamma meulla maalat hatteshuva. emesh haya ze muvdal meAdonai elohe yisrael shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 59 2)</small> "avonotechem hayu mavdilim benechem leven elohechem". tzoek veeno naane shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 1 15)</small> "ki tarbu tefilla" vegomer. veose mitzvot vetorfin otan befanav shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 1 12)</small> "mi vikkesh zot miyyedchem remos chatzeray", <small>(Malachi 1 10)</small> "mi gam bachem veyisgor delatayim" vegomer. vehayyom hu mudbak bashshechina shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 4)</small> "veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem". tzoek venaane miyyad shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 65 24)</small> "vehaya terem yikrau vaani eene". veose mitzvot umekabbelin otan benachat vesimcha shenneemar <small>(Kohelet 9 7)</small> "ki chevar ratza haelohim et maasecha". velo od ella shemmitavvim lahem shenneemar <small>(Malachi 3 4)</small> "vearva laAdonai minchat yehuda virushalomi kime olam ucheshanim kadmoniyyot":

Baale teshuva darkan lihyot shefalim vaanavim beyoter. im cherfu otan hakkesilim bemaasehem harishonim veamru lahen emesh hayita ose kach vechach veemesh hayita omer kach vechach. al yargishu lahen ella shomin usemechim veyodin shezzo zechut lahem. shekkol zeman shehem boshim mimmaasehem sheavru venichlamim mehen zechutam merubba umaalatam mitgaddelet. vechet gamur hu lomar levaal teshuva zechor maasecha harishonim o lehazekiran lefanav kede levayyesho. o lehazekir devarim veinyanim haddomin lahem kede lehazekiro me asa. hakkol asur umuzhar alav bichlal honayat devarim shehizhira tora aleha shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 17)</small> "velo tonu ish et amito":
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 8: Hatova hatztzefuna latztzaddikim hi chayye haolam habba vehi hachayyim sheen mavet immahen vehattova sheen immah raa. hu shekkatuv battora <small>(Devarim 22 7)</small> "lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim". mippi hashshemua lamdu lemaan yitav lach leolam shekkullo tov vehaarachta yamim leolam shekkullo aroch. veze hu haolam habba. sechar hatztzaddikim hu sheyyizku lenoam ze veyihyu betova zo. ufiron harshaim hu shello yizku lechayyim ellu ella yikkartu veyamutu. vechol mi sheeno zoche lechayyim ellu hu hammet sheeno chay laolam ella nichrat berisho veaved kivhema. vezehu karet hakketuva battora shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 lo)</small> "hikkaret tikkaret hannefesh hahi". mippi hashshemua lamdu hikkaret baolam hazze tikkaret laolam habba. kelomar sheotah hannefesh sheppersha min hagguf baolam hazze enah zocha lechayye haolam habba ella gam min haolam habba nichretet:

Haolam habba en bo guf ugeviyya ella nafshot hatztzaddikim bilvad belo guf kemalache hashsharet. hoil veen bo geviyyot en bo lo achila velo shetiyya velo davar mikkol haddevarim sheggufot bene adam tzerichin lahen baolam hazze. velo yeera davar bo min haddevarim shemmearin laggufot baolam hazze. kegon yeshiva vaamida veshena umita veetzev usechok vechayyotze bahen. kach amru chachamim harishonim <small>(gemara berachot 17 1)</small> "haolam habba en bo lo achila velo shetiyya velo tashmish ella tzaddikim yoshvim veatrotehem berashehen venehenin mizziv hashshechina". hare nitbarer lecha sheen sham guf lefi sheen sham achila ushetiyya. veze sheamru tzaddikim yoshvin derech chida amru. kelomar hatztzaddikim metzuyin sham belo amal uvelo yegia. vechen ze sheamru atrotehen berashehen kelomar daat sheyyadu shebbiglalah zachu lechayye haolam habba metzuya immahen vehi haatara shellahen kainyan sheamar shelomo <small>(Shir HaShirim 3 11)</small> "baatara sheittera lo immo". vahare hu omer <small>(yeshaya la 10)</small> "vesimchat olam al rosham" veen hassimcha guf kede shettanuach al harosh. kach atara sheamru chachamim kan hi hayedia. umahu ze sheamru nehenin mizziv hashshechina. sheyyodim umassigin meamittat hakkadosh baruch hu ma sheenam yodim vehem bagguf haafel hashshafal:

Kol nefesh haamura beinyan ze enah hanneshama hatztzericha lagguf ella tzurat hannefesh shehi haddea shehissiga mehabbore kefi kochah vehessegah haddeot hannifradot ushear hammaasim vehi hatztzura shebbearnu inyanah beferek revii mehilchot yesode hattora hi hannikret nefesh beinyan ze. chayyim ellu lefi sheen immahem mavet sheen hammavet ella mimmeorot hagguf veen sham guf nikreu tzeror hachayyim shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 25 29)</small> "vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim". vezehu hassachar sheen sachar lemala mimmennu vehattova sheen achareha tova vehi shehitauu lah kol hanneviim:

Vechamma shemot nikreu lah derech mashal. har Adonai. umekom kadsho. vederech hakkodesh. vechatzrot Adonai. venoam Adonai. veohel Adonai. vehechal Adonai. uvet Adonai. veshaar Adonai. vachachamim karu lah derech mashal letova zo hamezummenet latztzaddikim seudda. vekorin lah bechol makom haolam habba:

Hannekama sheen nekama gedola mimmenna shettikkaret hannefesh velo tizke leotan hachayyim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 lo)</small> "hikkaret tikkaret hannefesh hahi avona bah". veze haavaddon hu shekkorin oto hanneviim derech mashal beer shachat vaavaddon vetafte vaaluka vechol leshon kelaya vehashechata korin lo lefi shehi hakkelaya sheen achareha tekuma vehahefsed sheeno chozer leolam:

Shemma tekal beenecha tova zo utedamme sheen sechar hammitzvot veheyot haadam shalem bedarche haemet ella lihyoto ochel veshote maachalot tovot uvoel tzurot naot velovesh bigde shesh verikma veshochen beohole shen umishtammesh bichle kesef vezahav udevarim haddomim leellu kemo shemmedammin ellu haarviyyim hattippeshim haevilim hashshetufim bezimma. aval hachachamim uvaale dea yedu shekkol haddevarim haellu divre havay vehevel hem veen bahem toelet veenah tova gedola etzlenu baolam hazze ella mippene sheanu baale guf ugeviyya, vechol haddevarim haellu tzarche hagguf hem veen hannefesh mitavva lahem umechammedatan ella mippene tzorech hagguf, kede sheyyimtza cheftzo veyaamod al buryo. uvizman sheen sham guf nimtzeu kol haddevarim haellu betelim. hattova haggedola shettihye bah hannefesh baolam habba en shum derech baolam hazze lehassigah veleda otah. sheen anu yodim baolam hazze ella tovat hagguf velah anu mitavvin. aval otah hattova gedola ad meod veen lah erech betovot haolam hazze ella derech mashal. aval bederech haemet shennaaroch tovat hannefesh baolam habba betovot hagguf baolam hazze bemaachol uvemishte eno chen. ella otah hattova gedola ad en cheker veen lah erech vedimyon. hu sheamar david <small>(Tehillim lo 20)</small> "ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha" vegomer:

Vechamma kama david vehitavva lechayye haolam habba shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 27 13)</small> "lule heemanti lirot betuv Adonai beeretz chayyim". kevar hodiunu hachachamim harishonim shettovat haolam habba en koach baadam lehassigah al buryah veen yodea gadlah veyafyah veatzmah ella hakkadosh baruch hu levaddo. veshekkol hattovot shemmitnabbeim bahem hanneviim leyisrael enan ella lidvarim shebbagguf shennehenin bahen yisrael limot hammashiach bizman shettashuv hammemshala leyisrael. aval tovat chayye haolam habba en lah erech vedimyon velo dimmuha hanneviim kede shello yifchatu otah baddimyon. hu sheyyeshayahu amar <small>(yeshaya sad 3)</small> "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo". kelomar hattova shello raata otah en navi velo raa otah ella elohim, asa otah haelohim laadam shemmechakke lo. amru chachamim kol hanneviim kullan lo nibbeu ella limot hammashiach aval haolam habba ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha:

Ze shekkaru oto chachamim haolam habba lo mippene sheeno matzuy atta veze haolam oved veachar kach yavo oto haolam. en haddavar ken. ella hare hu matzuy veomed shenneemar <small>(Tehillim lo 20)</small> "asher tzafanta lireecha paalta" vegomer. velo kerauhu olam habba ella mippene sheotan hachayyim bain lo laadam achar chayye haolam hazze sheanu kayyamim bo beguf venefesh vezehu hannimtza lechol adam barishona:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 9:
Meachar shennoda shemmattan secharan shel mitzvot vehattova shennizke lah im shamarnu derech Adonai hakkatuv battora hi chayye haolam habba shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 7)</small> "lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim". vehannekama shennokmim min harshaim sheazvu archot hatztzedek hakketuvot battora hi hakkaret shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 lo)</small> "hikkaret tikkaret hannefesh hahi avonah bah". mahu ze shekkatuv bechol hattora kullah im tishmeu yaggia lachem kach <small>(Vayikra 26 14)</small> "veim lo tishmeu" yikre etchem kach. vechol otan haddevarim baolam hazze. kegon sova veraav umilchama veshalom umalchut veshiflut vishivat haaretz vegalut vehatzelachat maase vehefsedo ushear kol divre habberit. kol otan haddevarim emet hayu veyihyu uvizman sheanu osim kol mitzvot hattora yaggiu elenu tovot haolam hazze kullan. uvizman sheanu ovrin alehen tikrena otanu haraot hakketuvot. veaf al pi chen en otan hattovot hem sof mattan secharan shel mitzvot velo otan haraot hem sof hannekama shennokmin meover al kol hammitzvot. ella kach hu hechrea kol haddevarim. hakkadosh baruch hu natan lanu tora zo etz chayyim hi. vechol haose kol hakkatuv bah veyodo dea gemura nechona zoche bah lechayye haolam habba. ulefi godel maasav verov chachmato hu zoche. vehivtichanu battora sheim naase otah besimcha uvetovat nefesh venehge bechachmatah tamid sheyyasir mimmennu kol haddevarim hammonim otanu millaasotah kegon choli umilchama veraav vechayyotze bahen. veyashpia lanu kol hattovot hammachazikot et yadenu laasot hattora kegon sova veshalom veribbuy kesef vezahav. kede shello naasok kol yamenu bidvarim shehagguf tzarich lahen ella neshev penuyim lilmod bachachma velaasot hammitzva kede shennizke lechayye haolam habba. vechen hu omer battora achar shehivtiach betovot haolam hazze <small>(Devarim 6 25)</small> "utzedaka tihye lanu" vegomer. vechen hodianu battora sheim naazov hattora middaat venaasok behavele hazzeman kainyan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 32 15)</small> "vayyishman yeshurun vayyivat", sheddayan haemet yasir min haozvim kol tovot haolam hazze shehen chizzeku yedehem livot umevi alehem kol haraot hammonim otan milliknot haolam habba kede sheyyovdu berisham. hu shekkatuv battora <small>(Devarim 28 47)</small> "tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai" vegomer, <small>(Devarim 28 48)</small> "veavadta et oyvecha asher yeshallechennu Adonai bach". nimtza perush kol otan habberachot vehakkelalot al derech zo, kelomar im avadtem et Adonai besimcha ushemartem darko mashpia lachem habberachot haellu umarchik hakkelalot mikkem ad shettihyu penuyim lehitchakkem battora velaasok bah kede shettizku lechayye haolam habba veyitav lecha leolam shekkullo tov vetaarich yamim leolam shekkullo aroch venimtzetem zochin lishne haolamot, lechayyim tovim baolam hazze hammeviim lechayye haolam habba. sheim lo yikne po chachma umaasim tovim en lo bema yizke shenneemar <small>(Kohelet 9 10)</small> "ki en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bishol". veim azavtem et Adonai ushegitem bemaachol uvemishte uzenut vedome lahem mevi alechem kol hakkelalot haellu umesir kol habberachot ad sheyyichlu yemechem bevehala vafachad velo yihye lachem lev panuy velo guf shalem laasot hammitzvot kede shettovdu mechayye haolam habba venimtza sheibbadtem shene olamot. shebbizman sheadam tarud baolam hazze becholi uvemilchama ureavon eno mitassek lo bachachma velo bamitzvot shebbahen zochin lechayye haolam habba:
Umippene ze nitauu kol yisrael neviehem vechachmehem limot hammashiach kede sheyyanuchu mimmalchuyyot sheenan menichot lahen laasok battora uvammitzvot kahogen. veyimtzeu lahem margoa veyirbu bechachma kede sheyyizku lechayye haolam habba. lefi shebbeotan hayyamim tirbe haddea vehachachma vehaemet shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 11 9)</small> "ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai". veneemar <small>(yirmeya lo 33)</small> "velo yelammedu ish et achiv veish et reehu". veneemar <small>(Yechezkel 36 26)</small> "vahasiroti et lev haeven mibbesarchem". mippene sheoto hammelech sheyyaamod mizzera david baal chachma yihye yeter mishshelomo. venavi gadol hu karov lemoshe rabbenu. ulefichach yelammed kol haam veyore otam derech Adonai. veyavou kol haggoyim leshamo shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 2 2)</small> "vehaya beacharit hayyamim nachon yihye har bet Adonai berosh heharim". vesof kol hassachar kullo vehattova haacharona sheen lah hefsek vegeraon hu chayye haolam habba. aval yemot hammashiach hu haolam hazze veolam keminhago holech ella shehammalchut tachazor leyisrael. uchevar amru chachamim harishonim en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud malchuyyot bilvad:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 10:
Al yomar adam hareni ose mitzvot hattora veosek bechachmatah kede sheakabbel kol habberachot hakketuvot bah o kede sheezke lechayye haolam habba, veefrosh min haaverot shehizhira tora mehen kede sheennatzel min hakkelalot hakketuvot battora o kede shello ekkaret mechayye haolam habba. en rauy laavod et Adonai al hadderech hazze, shehaoved al derech ze hu oved miyyira veenah maalat hanneviim velo maalat hachachamim. veen ovdim Adonai al derech ze ella amme haaretz vehannashim vehakketannim shemmechannechin otan laavod miyyira ad shettirbe datan veyaavdu meahava:
Haoved meahava osek battora uvammitzvot veholech bintivot hachachma lo mippene davar baolam velo mippene yirat haraa velo kede lirash hattova ella ose haemet mippene shehu emet vesof hattova lavo biglalah. umaala zo hi maala gedola meod veen kol chacham zoche lah. vehi maalat avraham avinu shekkerao hakkadosh baruch hu ohavo lefi shello avad ella meahava. vehi hammaala shetztzivvanu bah hakkadosh baruch hu al yede moshe shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha". uvizman sheyyeehov adam et Adonai ahava haruya miyyad yaase kol hammitzvot meahava:
Vechetzad hi haahava haruya. hu sheyyohav et Adonai ahava gedola yetera azza meod ad shettehe nafsho keshura beahavat Adonai venimtza shoge bah tamid keillu chole choli haahava sheen dato penuya meahavat otah ishsha vehu shoge bah tamid ben beshivto ben bekumo ben beshaa shehu ochel veshote. yeter mizze tihye ahavat Adonai belev ohavav shogim bah tamid kemo shetztzivvanu bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha. vehu sheshshelomo amar derech mashal <small>(Shir HaShirim 2 5)</small> "ki cholat ahava ani". vechol shir hashshirim mashal hu leinyan ze:
Amru chachamim harishonim shemma tomar hareni lamed tora bishvil sheehye ashir bishvil sheekra rabbi bishvil sheakabbel sachar baolam habba. talmud lomar <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "leahava et Adonai". kol ma sheattem osim lo taasu ella meahava. veod amru chachamim bemitzvotav chafetz meod velo bischar mitzvotav. vechen hayu gedole hachachamim metzavvim linvone talmidehem umaskilehem beyichud al tihyu kaavadim hameshammeshim et harav vechulei ella mippene shehu harav rauy leshammesho kelomar ivdu meahava:
Kol haosek battora kede lekabbel sachar o kede shello taggia alav puranut hare ze osek shello lishmah. vechol haosek bah lo leyira velo lekabbel sachar ella mippene ahavat adon kol haaretz shetztzivva bah hare ze osek bah lishmah. veamru chachamim leolam yaasok adam battora vaafillu shello lishmah shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah. lefichach keshemmelammedin et hakketannim veet hannashim uchelal amme haaretz en melammedin otan ella laavod miyyira uchede lekabbel sachar, ad shettirbe datan veyitchakkemu chachma yetera megallim lahem raz ze meat meat umargilin otan leinyan ze benachat ad sheyyassiguhu veyeduhu veyaavduhu meahava:
Davar yadua uvarur sheen ahavat hakkadosh baruch hu niksheret belibbo shel adam ad sheyyishge bah tamid karauy veyaazov kol ma shebbaolam chutz mimmenna. kemo shetztzivva veamar bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha. eno ohev hakkadosh baruch hu ella bedaat sheyyedaehu. veal pi haddea tihye haahava im meat meat veim harebe harebe. lefichach tzarich haadam leyached atzmo lehavin ulehaskil bechachmot utevunot hammodiim lo et kono kefi koach sheyyesh baadam lehavin ulehassig kemo shebbearnu behilchot yesode hattora:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 1: Paamayim bechol yom korin keriat shema, baerev uvabboker. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 7)</small> "uveshachbecha uvekumecha" beshaa shedderech bene adam shochvin veze hu layla. uveshaa shedderech bene adam omdin veze hu yom:

Uma hu kore, shelosha parashiyyot. ellu hen <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" <small>(Bamidbar 15 37)</small> "vayyomer". umakdimin likrot parashat shema mippene sheyyesh bah yichud hashshem veahavato vetalmudo shehu haikkar haggadol shehakkol taluy bo. veachareha vehaya im shamoa sheyyesh bah tziuuy al (zechirat) shear kol hammitzvot. veachar kach parashat <small>(Bamidbar 15 38)</small> "tzitzit" sheggam hi yesh bah tziuuy zechirat kol hammitzvot:

Af al pi sheen mitzvat tzitzit noheget ballayla korin otah ballayla mippene sheyyesh bah zichron yetziat mitzrayim umitzva lehazekir yetziat mitzrayim bayyom uvallayla shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 3)</small> "lemaan tizkor et yom tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyecha". ukeriat shalosh parashiyyot ellu al seder ze hi hannikret keriat shema:

Hakkore keriat shema keshehu gomer pasuk rishon omer belachash baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed vechozer vekore kedarko <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha" ad sofah. velamma korin ken. masoret hi beyadenu shebbeshaa shekkibbetz yaakov avinu et banav bemitzrayim bishat mitato tzivvam vezerzam al yichud hashshem veal derech Adonai shehalach bah avraham veyitzchak aviv veshaal otam veamar lahem banay shemma yesh bachem paslut mi sheeno omed immi beyichud hashshem kainyan sheamar lanu moshe rabbenu <small>(Devarim 29 17)</small> "pen yesh bachem ish o ishsha" vegomer. anu kullam veamru <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad". kelomar shema mimmennu avinu yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. patach hazzaken veamar baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. lefichach nahagu kol yisrael lomar shevach sheshshibbeach bo yisrael hazzaken achar pasuk ze:
Hakkore keriat shema mevarech lefaneha uleachareha. bayyom mevarech shetayim lefaneha veachat leachareha. uvallayla mevarech shetayim lefaneha ushetayim leachareha:

Beracha rishona shellefaneha bayyom yotzer or uvore choshech vechulei uveracha sheniyya ahavat olam ahavtanu. veshel achareha emet veyatztziv. uveracha rishona shellefaneha ballayla maariv aravim vechulei sheniyya lah ahavat olam bet yisrael ammecha ahavta kulei. uveracha rishona shel achareha emet veemuna. sheniyya lah hashekivenu:

Beracha rishona shellefaneha ben bayyom ben ballayla poteach bah bevaruch vechotem bah bevaruch. ushear birchoteha chotem bechol achat mehen bevaruch veen lahem peticha bevaruch. berachot ellu im shear kol habberachot haaruchot befi kol yisrael ezra hassofer uvet dino tikkenum veen adam rashshay lifchot mehem velo lehosif alehem. makom shehitkinu lachtom bevaruch eno rashshay shello lachtom. umakom shehitkinu shello lachtom eno rashshay lachtom. makom shehitkinu shello liftoach bevaruch eno rashshay liftoach. makom shehitkinu liftoach eno rashshay shello liftoach. kelalo shel davar kol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim babberachot hare ze toe vechozer umevarech kammatbea. vechol sheeno omer emet veyatztziv beshacharit veemet veemuna bearvit lo yatza yede chovato:

Hikdim beracha sheniyya livracha rishona ben bayyom ben ballayla ben lefaneha ben leachareha yatza lefi sheen seder babberachot. beshacharit patach yotzer or vesiyyem maariv aravim lo yatza. patach bemaariv aravim vesiyyem beyotzer or yatza. uvaerev patach bemaariv aravim vesiyyem beyotzer or lo yatza. patach beyotzer or vesiyyem bemaariv aravim yatza. shekkol habberachot holchot achar chatimatan:

Eze hu zeman keriat shema ballayla. mitzvatah mishsheat yetziat hakkochavim ad chatzi hallayla. veim avar veicher vekara ad shello ala ammud hashshachar yatza yede chovato shello amru ad chatzot ella kede leharechik adam min happeshia:

Hakkore keriat shema shel arvit achar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar kodem hanetz hachamma lo yatza yede chovato ella im ken haya anus kegon shikkor o chole vechayyotze bahen. veanus shekkara beet ze eno omer hashekivenu:

Vee ze hu zemanna bayyom. mitzvatah sheyyatchil likrot kodem hanetz hachamma kede sheyyigmor likrot ulevarech beracha acharona im hanetz hachamma. veshiur ze kemo [issur] shaa kodem shettaale hashshemesh. veim icher vekara keriat shema achar shettaale hashshemesh yatza yede chovato sheonatah ad sof shalosh shaot bayyom lemi sheavar veicher:

Mi shehikdim vekara keriat shema shel shacharit achar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar af al pi shehishlim kodem shettanetz hachamma yatza yede chovato. uvishat haddechak kegon shehaya mashkim latzet ladderech kore lechattechilla mishsheala ammud hashshachar:

Hakkore achar shalosh shaot bayyom afillu haya anus lo yatza yede chovat keriat shema beonato. ella hare hu kekore battora. umevarech lefaneha uleachareha kol hayyom afillu icher vekara achar shalosh shaot:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 2: Hakkore et shema velo kivven libbo befasuk rishon shehu <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema yisrael" lo yatza yede chovato vehashshear im lo kivven libbo yatza. afillu haya kore battora kedarko o maggiah et happarashiyyot haellu beonat keria yatza vehu shekkivven libbo befasuk rishon:

Kol adam korin kedarkan ben omdin ben mehallechin ben shochvin ben rochvin al gabbe behema. veasur likrot keriat shema vehu muttal ufanav tuchot bakkarka o mushlach al gabbo ufanav lemala. aval kore hu vehu shochev al tziddo. veim haya baal basar harebe veeno yachol lehithappech al tziddo o shehaya chole note meat letziddo vekore:
Mi shehaya mehallech al raglav omed befasuk rishon vehashshear kore vehu mehallech. haya yashen metzaarin oto umeirin oto ad sheyyikra pasuk rishon umikkan veelach im anasattu shena en metzaarin oto:

Mi shehaya osek bimlacha mafsik ad sheyyikra parasha rishona kullah. vechen haummanin betelin mimmelachtan befarasha rishona kede shello tehe keriatan aray, vehashshear kore hu kedarko veosek bimlachto. afillu haya omed berosh hailan o berosh hakkotel kore bimkomo umevarech lefaneha uleachareha:
Haya osek betalmud tora vehiggia zeman keriat shema posek vekore umevarech lefaneha uleachareha. haya osek betzarche rabbim lo yifsok ella yigmor iskehen veyikra im nishar et likrot:

Haya osek baachila o shehaya bammerchatz o shehaya osek betisporet o shehaya mehappech beorot o shehayu oskin baddin gomer veachar kach kore keriat shema. veim haya mityare shemma yaavor zeman keria ufasak vekara hare ze meshubbach:

Mi sheyyarad litbol im yachol laalot ulehitkassot kodem shettanetz hachamma yaale veyitkasse veyikra. veim haya mityare shemma tanetz hachamma kodem sheyyikra yitkasse bammayim shehu omed bahen veyikra. velo yitkasse lo bammayim haraim sherechan ra velo beme hammishre velo bemayim tzelulin mippene sheervato niret bahen. aval mitkasse hu bemayim achurin sheen rechan ra vekore bimkomo:

Hakkore keriat shema lo yirmoz beenav velo yikrotz bisfatav velo yare beetzbeotav kede shello tihye keriato aray. veim asa ken af al pi sheyyatza yede chovato hare ze megunne. vetzarich lehashemia leazno keshehu kore veim lo hishmia leazno yatza. vetzarich ledakdek beotiyyotav veim lo dikdek yatza:

Ketzad yedakdek. yishmor shello yarpe hechazak velo yachazik harafe velo yaniach hannad velo yanid hannach. lefichach tzarich litten revach ben haddevakim ben kol shete otiyyot haddomot sheachat mehen sof teva vehaacheret techillat teva hassemucha lah. kegon bechol levavcha kore bechol veshohe vechozer vekore levavcha. vechen vaavadtem mehera. hakkanaf petil. vetzarich levaer zayin shel tizkeru. vetzarich lehaarich bedalet shel echad kede sheyyamlichehu bashshamayim uvaaretz uvearba ruchot. vetzarich shello yachtof bachet kede shello yehe keomer e chad:
Kore adam et shema bechol lashon sheyyihye mevinah. vehakkore bechol lashon tzarich lehizzaher middivre shibbush shebbeoto hallashon umedakdek beoto hallashon kemo shemmedakdek bilshon hakkodesh:

Hakkore lemafrea lo yatza. bamme devarim amurim beseder happesukim aval im hikdim parasha lefarasha af al pi sheeno rashshay ani omer sheyyatza lefi sheenah semucha lah battora. kara pasuk vechazar ukerao paam sheniyya hare ze megunne. kara milla achat uchefalah kegon shekkara shema shema meshattekin oto:

Keraah serugin yatza. afillu shaha ben serug leserug kede ligmor et kullah yatza. vehu sheyyikra al hasseder. keraah mitnamnem vehu mi sheeno er velo nirdam beshena yatza. uvilvad sheyyihye er befasuk rishon:

Safek kara keriat shema safek lo kara chozer vekore umevarech lefaneha uleachareha. aval im yada shekkara venistappek lo im berech lefaneha uleachareha o lo berech eno chozer umevarech. kara vetaa yachazor lammakom shettaa. neelam mimmennu ben parasha lefarasha veeno yodea e zo parasha hishlim vee zo tzarich lehatechil chozer lefarasha rishona shehu <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha" vegomer:

Taa beemtza happerek veeno yodea lehechan pasak chozer lerosh happerek. haya kore uchetavtam veeno yodea im hu beuchetavtam shel shema o beuchetavtam shebbivhaya im shamoa chozer leuchetavtam shel shema. veim nistappek lo achar shekkara lemaan yirbu yemechem eno chozer sheal hergel leshono hu holech:

Haya kore ufaga baacherim o pagu bo acherim. im haya ben perek leferek posek umatchil veshoel shelom mi shehu chayyav bichvodo kegon sheppaga beaviv o rabbo o mi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma. umeshiv shalom lechol adam shennatan lo shalom:

Haya kore beemtza happarasha eno posek umatchil lishl ella bishlom mi shehu mityare mimmennu kegon melech o annas vechayyotze bahen. aval mi shehu chayyav bichvodo kegon aviv o rabbo im natan lo shalom techilla posek umeshiv lo shalom:

Veellu hen ben happerakim. ben beracha rishona lashsheniyya. ben sheniyya lishma. ben shema livhaya im shamoa. ben vehaya im shamoa levayyomer. ben happerakim haellu shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv shalom lechol adam. aval ben vayyomer leemet veyatztziv hare ze keemtza happerek velo yafsik ella lishl mippene hayyira ulehashiv mippene hakkavod:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 3: Hakore et shema rochetz yadav bammayim kodem sheyyikra. higgia zeman keriatah velo matza mayim kodem sheyyikra lo yeacher keriatah veyelech levakkesh mayim ella mekanneach yadav beafar o bitzror o bekora vechayyotze bahen vekore:

En korin lo bevet hammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse af al pi sheen bo tzoa velo bevet hakkevarot velo betzad hammet atzmo veim hirchik arba ammot min hakkever o min hammet muttar likrot. vechol mi shekkara bemakom sheen korin bo chozer vekore:

Bet hakkisse hechadash shehuchan vaadayin lo nishtammesh bo muttar likrot keriat shema lenegdo aval lo betocho. merchatz hechadash muttar likrot betocho. hayu shene battim zimmen echad mehem levet hakkisse veamar al hashsheni veze. hare hashsheni safek im hizmino lechach im lo. lefichach en korin bo lechattechilla veim kara yatza. amar gam ze hare shenehem mezummanin veen korin bahen. chatzar hammerchatz vehu hammakom shebbene adam omdin bo levushin muttar likrot bo keriat shema:

Velo keriat shema bilvad ella kol inyan shehu middivre hakkodesh asur leamro bevet hammerchatz uvevet hakkisse vaafillu amaro bilshon chol. velo leamro bilvad ella afillu lehareher belibbo bedivre tora bevet hakkisse uvevet hammerchatz uvimkom hattinofet vehu hammakom sheyyesh bo tzoa ume raglayim asur:

Devarim shel chol muttar leamran bilshon kodesh bevet hakkisse. vechen hakkinnuyim kegon rachum vechannun veneeman vechayyotze bahen muttar leamran bevet hakkisse. aval hashshemot hameyuchadim vehen hashshemot sheenan nimchakin asur lehazekiran bevet hakkisse uvevet hammerchatz yashan. veim nizdammen lo lehaferish min davar haasur bevet hammerchatz o bevet hakkisse mafrish vaafillu bilshon kodesh uveinyene kodesh:

Tzoat haadam vetzoat kelavim vachazirin bizman sheyyesh betochan orot vechol tzoa sherechah ra kegon ellu asur likrot keriat shema kenegdan. vechen keneged me raglayim shel adam. aval me raglayim shel behema korin kenegdan. katan sheeno yachol leechol kezayit dagan bichde sheyyochal haggadol kishlosha betze dagan en marchikin lo mitztzoato velo mimme raglav:

Hayta tzoa yevesha kecheres asur likrot kenegdah. veim hayta yevesha yoter mecheres ad sheim zerakah titparech hare hi keafar umuttar likrot kenegdah. me raglayim shennivleu bakkarka im hayu martivin hayyad asur likrot kenegdan veim lav muttar:

Kamma yarchik adam mitztzoa umimme raglayim veachar kach yikra, arba ammot. bamme devarim amurim bizman shehem millaachorav o mitztziddav aval im hayu keneged panav marchik mehen ad shello yire otan veachar kach yikra:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya immahen babbayit bemakom shave aval im haya sham makom gavoah mehen asara tefachim o namuch mehem asara tefachim yoshev betzad hammakom vekore shehare nifsak benehem. vehu shello yaggia lo reach ra. vechen im kafa keli al hatztzoa o al meme raglayim af al pi shehen immo babbayit hare ellu kikvurin umuttar likrot kenegdan:

Haya beno uven hatztzoa mechitztza shel zechuchit af al pi shehu roe otah meachare hazzechuchit muttar likrot betziddah. natan reviit mayim letoch me raglayim shel paam achat muttar likrot immahen betoch arba ammot:

Hayta tzoa beguma omed besandalo al hagguma vekore. vehu shello yihye sandalo nogea bah. hayta kenegdo tzoa meuta beyoter kemo tippa rokek aleha rok ave ad shettitkasse vekore. hayta netishat tzoa al besaro o yadav metunnafot mibbet hakkisse velo haya lahen reach ra kelal mippene katnan o yavshutan muttar likrot lefi sheen lahen reach ra. aval im hayta bimkomah af al pi sheenah niret keshehu omed hoil veniret keshehu yoshev asur likrot ad sheyyekanneach yafe yafe mippene shehatztzoa lacha hi veyesh lah reach ra. vechamma geonim horu sheasur lo likrot im hayu yadav metunnafot vechach rauy laasot:

Reach ra sheyyesh lo ikkar marchik 4 ammot vekore im pasak hareach. veim lo pasak hareach marchik ad makom sheppasak hareach. vesheen lo ikkar kegon mi sheyyatza mimmennu ruach millematta marchik ad makom shettichle hareach vekore. geraf shel rei vaavit shel meme raglayim asur likrot keriat shema kenegdan veaf al pi sheen bahen kelum veen lahem reach ra mippene shehem kevet hakkisse:
Tzoa overet kegon shehayta shata al pene hammayim asur likrot kenegdah. ufi chazir ketzoa overet dami veasur likrot kenegdo ad sheyyaavru mimmennu arba ammot:

Haya kore vehiggia limkom hattinnofet lo yanniach yado al piv veyikra ella yafsik ad sheyyaavor meoto makom. vechen hakkore sheyyatzta mimmennu ruach millematta yafsik ad shettichle baashah vechozer likriato. vechen bedivre tora. yatzta ruach mechavero af al pi shemmafsik likriat shema eno posek ledivre tora:

Haya kore keriat shema bevayit venistappek lo im yesh sham tzoa o meme raglayim o en sham hare ze muttar likrot. haya kore baashpa venistappek lo im yesh sham tzoa o en sham lo yikra ad sheyyivdok shechezkat haashpa shehi mekom hattinnofet. aval sefek me raglayim afillu baashpa muttar likrot:

Keshem sheasur likrot keneged tzoa ume raglayim ad sheyyarchik kach asur likrot keneged haerva ad sheyyachazir panav. afillu kuti o katan lo yikra keneged ervatan afillu mechitztza shel zechuchit mafseket hoil vehu roe otah asur likrot ad sheyyachazir panav. vechol guf haishsha erva lefichach lo yistakkel beguf haishsha keshehu kore vaafillu ishto. veim haya megulle tefach miggufah lo yikra kenegdah:

Ucheshem shehu asur keneged ervat acherim kach hu asur likrot keneged ervato velo yikra keshehu arom ad sheyyechasse ervato. hayta chagora shel beged o or o sak al matnav af al pi sheshshear gufo arom muttar lo likrot keriat shema vehu shello yihye akevo nogea beervato. haya yashen betallito vehaya arom chotzetz betallito mittachat libbo vekore. aval lo yachotz tzavvaro veyikra mippene shellibbo roe et haerva venimtza kemi shekkore belo chagora:

Shenayim shehayu yeshenim betallit achat kol echad mehen asur likrot af al pi sheyyechasse mittachat libbo ad shettehe tallit mafseket benehen ad shello yigga besar ze bivsar ze mimmatnav ulematta. veim haya yashen im ishto o banav uvene beto hakketannim hare gufan kegufo veeno margish mehen. lefichach af al pi shebbesaro nogea bahem machazir panav vechotzetz mittachat libbo vekore:

Ad ematay hem ketannim leinyan ze ad sheyyehe hazzachar ben shetem esre shana veyom echad vehannekeva bat achat esre shana veyom echad vehu sheyyehe tavnitam ketavnit gedolim <small>(Yechezkel 16 7)</small> "shadayim nachonu usearech tzimmeach". veachar kach lo yikra ad shettafsik tallit benehen. aval im adayin lo hayu shadayim nachonu usearech tzimmeach kore immahen bekeruv basar veeno tzarich hefsek ad sheyyihye hazzachar ben 13 shana veyom echad vehannekeva bat shetem esre shana veyom echad:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 4: Nashim vaavadim uketannim peturim mikkeriat shema. umelammedin et hakketannim likrotah beonatah umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha kede lechannechan bemitzvot. mi shehaya libbo tarud venechpaz lidvar mitzva patur mikkol hammitzvot umikkeriat shema. lefichach chatan shennasa betula patur mikkeriat shema ad sheyyavo aleha. lefi sheen dato penuya shemma lo yimtza lah betulim. veim shaha ad motzae shabbat velo baal chayyav likrot mimmotzae shabbat veelach shehare nitkarra dato velibbo gas bah af al pi shello baal:
Aval hannose et habbeula af al pi sheosek bemitzva chayyav likrot hoil veen lo davar shemmevalbel dato. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi shemmet lo met shehu chayyav lehitabbel alav patur mikkeriat shema ad sheyyikberennu mippene sheen dato penuya likrot. veim haya meshammer et hammet af al pi sheeno meto patur mikkeriat shema. veim hayu hashshomrim shenayim haechad meshammer vehashsheni nishmat lemakom acher vekore vechozer umeshammer venishmat haacher vekore. vechen hachofer kever lemet patur mikkeriat shema:

En motziin et hammet lekavro samuch lizman keriat shema ella im ken haya adam gadol. veim hitchilu vehotziu vehiggia zeman hakkeria vehen melavvin et hammet. kol sheyyesh lammitta tzorech bahen kegon nose hammitta vechillufehen vechillufe chillufehen ben shehayu lifne hammitta ben shehayu leachar hammitta peturin. ushear hamelavvin sheen lammitta tzorech bahen chayyavin:

Hayu asukim behesped vehiggia zeman keriat shema bizman shehammet munnach lifnehen nishmatim echad echad vekorin vechozrin lahesped. en hammet muttal lifnehem kol haam korin keriat shema vehaavel yoshev vedomem lefi sheeno chayyav likrot ad sheyyikbor et meto:

Kavru et hammet vechazru haavelim lekabbel tanchumin vechol haam holchim acharehem mimmekom hakkever lammakom sheomdim bo haavelim laasot shura lekabbel tanchumin. im yecholin haam lehatechil veligmor afillu pasuk echad kodem sheyyaggiu lashshura yatchilu veim lav lo yatchilu ella yenachamu et haavelim veachar sheyyippatru mehen yatchilu likrot. bene adam haomdin bashshura, happenimiyyim shehen roin pene haavelim peturin mikkeriat shema vehachitzonim hoil veenan roin et haavelim chayyavin bikriat shema bimkoman:

Kol mi shehu patur millikrot keriat shema im ratza lehachamir al atzmo likrot kore. vehu shettehe dato penuya alav. aval im haya ze happatur millikrot mevohal eno rashshay likrot ad shettityashshev dato alav:

Kol hattemein chayyavin bikriat shema umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha vehen betumatan. af al pi sheefshar lahen laalot mittumatan bo bayyom kegon hannogin besheretz o benidda vezava umishkavah vechayyotze bahen. veezra uvet dino tikkenu shello yikra bedivre tora baal keri levaddo vehotziuhu mikkelal shear hattemein ad sheyyitbol. velo pashta takkana zo bechol yisrael velo haya koach berov hatztzibbur laamod bah lefichach batla. uchevar nahagu kol yisrael likrot battora velikrot keriat shema vehen baale kerayin lefi sheen divre tora mekabbelin tuma ella omdin betohoratan leolam shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 23 29)</small> "halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai" ma esh enah mekabbelet tuma af divre tora enam mekabbelin tuma:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Mitzvat ase lehitpallel bechol yom shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 25)</small> "vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem". mippi hashshemua lamdu sheavoda zo hi tefilla shenneemar <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "uleavdo bechol levavchem" amru chachamim e zo hi avoda shebballev zo tefilla. veen minyan hattefillot min hattora. veen mishne hattefilla hazzot min hattora. veen lattefilla zeman kavua min hattora:

Ulefichach nashim vaavadim chayyavin bitfilla lefi shehi mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama ella chiyyuv mitzva zo kach hu sheyyehe adam mitchannen umitpallel bechol yom umaggid shivcho shel hakkadosh baruch hu veachar kach shoel tzerachav shehu tzarich lahem bevakkasha uvitchinna veachar kach noten shevach vehodaya laAdonai al hattova shehishpia lo kol echad lefi kocho:

Im haya ragil marbe bitchinna uvakkasha veim haya aral sefatayim medabber kefi yechalto uvechol et sheyyirtze. vechen minyan hattefillot kol echad kefi yechalto. yesh mitpallel paam achat beyom. veyesh mitpallelin peamim harebe. vehakkol yihyu mitpallelin nochach hammikdash bechol makom sheyyihye. vechen haya haddavar tamid mimmoshe rabbenu vead ezra:

Kevan sheggalu yisrael bime nevuchadnetztzar harasha nitarvu befaras veyavan ushear haummot venoldu lahem banim beartzot haggoyim veotan habbanim nitbalbelu sefatam vehayta sefat kol echad veechad meorevet milleshonot harebe vechevan shehaya medabber eno yachol ledabber kol tzarko belashon achat ella beshibbush shenneemar <small>(Nechemya 13 24)</small> "uvenehem chatzi medabber ashdodit" vegomer <small>(Nechemya 13 24)</small> "veenam makkirim ledabber yehudit vechilshon am veam". umippene ze keshehaya echad mehen mitpallel tiktzar leshono lishl chafatzav o lehaggid shevach hakkadosh baruch hu bilshon hakkodesh ad sheyyearvu immah leshonot acherot. vechevan sheraa ezra uvet dino kach amdu vetikkenu lahem shemone esre berachot al hasseder. shalosh rishonot shevach laAdonai veshalosh acharonot hodaya. veemtzaiyyot yesh bahen sheelat kol haddevarim shehen kemo avot lechol cheftze ish vaish uletzarche hatztzibbur kullan, kede sheyyihyu aruchot befi hakkol veyilmedu otan vetihye tefillat ellu haillegim tefilla shelema kitfillat baale hallashon hatztzecha. umippene inyan ze tikkenu kol habberachot vehattefillot mesuddarot befi kol yisrael kede sheyyehe inyan kol beracha aruch befi hailleg:

Vechen tikkenu sheyyehe minyan hattefillot keminyan hakkarbanot. shete tefillot bechol yom keneged shene temidin. vechol yom sheyyesh karban musaf tikkenu bo tefilla shelishit keneged karban musaf. utefilla shehi keneged tamid shel boker hi hannikret tefillat hashshachar. utefilla shekkeneged tamid shel ben haarbayim hi hannikret tefillat mincha utefilla shekkeneged hammusafin hi nikret tefillat hammusafin:

Vechen hitkinu sheyyehe adam mitpallel tefilla achat ballayla shehare evre tamid shel ben haarbayim mitakkelin veholchin kol hallayla shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "hi haola" vegomer, kainyan shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 55 18)</small> "erev vavoker vetzohorayim asicha veeheme vayyishma koli". veen tefillat arvit chova kitfillat shacharit umincha. veaf al pi chen nahagu kol yisrael bechol mekomot moshvotehem lehitpallel arvit vekibbeluha alehem kitfillat chova:

Vechen tikkenu tefilla achar tefillat mincha samuch lishkiat hachamma beyom hattaanit bilvad kede lehosif techinna uvakkasha mippene hattaanit vezo hi hattefilla hannikret tefillat neila kelomar ninalu shaare shamayim bead hashshemesh venistera, lefi sheen mitpallelin otah ella samuch lishkiat hachamma:

Nimtzeu hattefillot bechol yom shalosh. arvit veshacharit umincha. uvashshabbatot uvemoadim uverashe chodashim arba. shalosh shel kol yom utefillat hammusafin. uveyom hakkippurim chamesh. arba ellu utefillat neila:

Tefillot ellu en pochatin mehen aval mosifin alehem. im ratza adam lehitpallel kol hayyom kullo harshut beyado. vechol otan hattefillot sheyyosif kemo makriv nedavot. lefichach tzarich sheyyechaddesh davar bechol beracha uveracha min haemtzaiyyot meen habberachot. veim chiddesh afillu bivracha achat dayyo kede lehodia shehi nedava velo chova. veshalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot leolam en mosifin bahen velo pochatin mehen veen meshannin bahen davar:

En hatztzibbur mitpallelin tefillat nedava lefi sheen hatztzibbur meviin karban nedava. velo yitpallel afillu yachid musaf shetayim achat chovat hayyom veachat nedava lefi sheen mitnaddevin karban musaf. veyesh min haggeonim mi shehora sheasur lehitpallel tefillat nedava beshabbatot veyamim tovim lefi sheen makrivin bahen nedava ella chovat hayyom bilvad:

Vime rabban gamliel rabbu haeppikorosin beyisrael vehayu metzerim leyisrael umesitin otan lashuv meachare hashshem. vechevan sheraa shezzo gedola mikkol tzarche bene adam amad hu uvet dino vehitkin beracha achat shettihye bah sheela millifne hashshem leabbed haeppikorosin vekava otah battefilla kede shettihye arucha befi hakkol. nimtzeu kol habberachot shebbattefilla tesha esre berachot:

Bechol tefilla shebbechol yom mitpallel adam tesha esre berachot ellu al hasseder. bamme devarim amurim keshemmatza dato mechuvvenet uleshono temaher likrot. aval im haya tarud vedachuk o shekkatzra leshono mehitpallel yitpallel shalosh rishonot uveracha achat meen kol haemtzaiyyot veshalosh acharonot veyetze yede chovato:

Vezohi habberacha shettikkenu meen kol haemtzaiyyot. havinenu Adonai elohenu ladaat et derachecha umol et levavenu leyiratcha lesoleach heye lanu lihyot geulim rachakenu mimmachov vedashnenu veshakkenenu binot artzecha unefotzim mearba tekabbetz vehattoim bedatecha yishshaftu veal harshaim tanif yadcha veyismechu tzaddikim bevinyan irecha uvetikkun hechalecha uvitzmichat keren ledavid avdecha uvaarichat ner leven yishshay meshichecha terem nikra atta taane kaddavar shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 65 24)</small> "vehaya terem yikrau vaani eene od hem medabberim vaani eshma" ki atta hu one bechol et pode umatztzil mikkol tzuka baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla:

Bamme devarim amurim bimot hachamma. aval bimot haggeshamim eno mitpallel havinenu mippene shetztzarich lomar sheela bevirkat hashshanim. vechen bemotzae shabbatot veyamim tovim eno mitpallel havinenu mippene shetztzarich lomar havedala bechonen haddaat:

Uveshabbatot uveyamim tovim mitpallel sheva berachot bechol tefilla utefilla mearba tefillot shel oto hayyom. shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot uveracha emtzait meen oto hayyom. beshabbatot chotmin bivracha emtzait mekaddesh hashshabbat. uvargalim chotem bah mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim. veim haya shabbat veyom tov chotmim bah mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim. berosh hashshana chotmin bah melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veyom hazzikkaron. veim haya shabbat chotem bah melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veyom hazzikkaron:

Bamme devarim amurim bitfillat arvit veshacharit umincha. aval tefillat hammusafin shel rosh hashshana mitpallel tesha berachot shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot shel kol yom veshalosh emtzaiyyot. rishona min haemtzaiyyot inyanah malchuyyot. sheniyya zichronot. shelishit shofarot. vechotem bechol achat mehen meinyanah:

Beyom hakkippurim mitpallel bechol tefilla mechamesh tefillot sheva berachot. shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot veemtzaiyyot meen hayyom. vechotem bechol achat mehen melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veyom hakkippurim. veim chal lihyot beshabbat chotem bechol tefilla mehen melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veyom hakkippurim:

Bamme devarim amurim beyom tzom shel kol shana veshana aval beyom tzom shel shenat hayyovel mitpallel tefillat hammusafim tesha berachot kemo shehitpallel bemusaf rosh hashshana vehem otan habberachot atzman lo pachot velo yoter veen mitpallelin otan ella bizman shehayyovel noheg:

Bechol tefilla mehattefillot poteach kodem livracha rishona <small>(Tehillim 51 17)</small> "Adonai sefatay tiftach ufi yaggid tehillatecha". ucheshehu chotem besof hattefilla omer <small>(Tehillim 19 15)</small> "yihyu leratzon imre fi" vegomer veachar kach tzoed laachorav:

Berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed mitpallel arvit shacharit umincha tesha esre berachot kishar hayyamim veomer baavoda elohenu velohe avotenu yaale veyavo. bemusaf bechullo shel moed mitpallel tefillat hammusaf kemo shemmitpallel beyom tov. uverashe chodashim mitpallel sheva berachot shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot veemtzait meen karban rosh chodesh vechotem bah mekaddesh yisrael verashe chodashim:

Shabbat shechala bechullo shel moed vechen rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat mitpallel arvit veshacharit umincha sheva berachot kishar hashshabbatot veomer yaale veyavo baavoda. bemusaf matchil bivracha emtzait beinyan shabbat umashlim beinyan shabbat veomer kedushshat hayyom beemtza beracha vechotem bah berashe chodashim mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael verashe chodashim. uvechullo shel moed chotem bah kemo shehu chotem beyom tov shechal lihyot beshabbat:

Veyom tov shechal lihyot beechad beshabbat mitpallel bivracha reviit ballayla vattodienu mishpete tzidkecha vattelammedenu laasot chukke retzonecha vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu kedushshat shabbat uchevod moed vachagigat haregel ben kedushshat shabbat likdushshat yom tov hivdalta veet yom hashshevii mishsheshet yeme hammaase hikdashta (vehivdalta vehikdashta et ammecha yisrael bikdushshatcha) vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu moadim lesimcha chaggim uzemannim lesashon vechulei. uvemotzae shabbat uvemotzae yom tov shel kol hashshana mavdil beatta chonen af al pi shehu mavdil al hakkos:
Bachanukka uvefurim mosifin behodaa al hannissim. shabbat shechala lihyot bachanukka mazkir al hannissim bemusaf kemo shemmazkir bishar tefillot:

Bime hattaanit afillu yachid shehitanna mosif beshomea tefilla anenu vechulei. usheliach tzibbur omrah beracha bifne atzmah ben goel lerofe vechotem bah haone beet tzara (umoshia). venimtza mitpallel esrim berachot. betisha beav mosifin bevone yerushalayim rachem Adonai elohenu alenu veal yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal hair haavela kulei:

Kol yemot haggeshamim omer bivracha sheniyya morid haggeshem uvimot hachamma morid hattal. meematay omer morid haggeshem mittefillat hammusafin shel yom tov haacharon shel chag ad tefillat shacharit shel yom tov harishon shel pesach. umittefillat hammusafin shel yom tov harishon shel pesach omer morid hattal:

Mishshiva yamim bemarcheshvan shoalin et haggeshamim bevirkat shanim kol zeman shemmazkir haggeshem. bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael. aval beshinar uvesureya uvemitzrayim uvammekomot hassemuchot leellu vehaddomin lahen shoalin et haggeshamim beyom shishshim achar tekufat tishre:

Mekomot shehen tzerichin ligshamim bimot hachamma kegon iyye hayyam harchokim shoalin et haggeshamim beet shehen tzerichin lahen beshomea tefilla. umekomot shehen osin yom tov shene yamim omer morid haggeshem bitfillat musaf shel yom rishon shel shemini atzeret umitpallel veholech kol yemot haggeshamim:

Kol hashshana kullah chotem bivracha shelishit hael hakkadosh uvevirkat ashte esre melech ohev tzedaka umishpat uvaaseret hayyamim shemmerosh hashshana ad motzae yom hakkippurim chotem bashshelishit hammelech hakkadosh uveashte esre hammelech hammishpat:

Yesh mekomot shennahagu lehosif baaseret yamim ellu bivracha rishona zachrenu lechayyim kulei uvashsheniyya mi chamocha av harachamim vechulei uvehodaa zechor rachamecha vechulei umosifin bivracha acharona besefer chayyim vechulei. vechen yesh mekomot shennahagu lehosif baaseret yamim ellu bivracha shelishit uvechen ten pachdecha uvechen vechulei aval berosh hashshana uveyom hakkippurim minhag pashut hu lehosif bashshelishit uvechen ten pachdecha vechulei:

Tefilat hashshachar mitzvatah sheyyatchil lehitpallel im hanetz hachamma uzemannah ad sof shaa reviit shehi shelishit hayyom. veim avar o taa vehitpallel achar arba ad chatzot hayyom yatza yede chovat tefilla. aval lo yatza yede chovat tefilla bizmannah. shekkeshem shettefilla mitzva min hattora kach mitzva middivrehem lehitpallel otah bizmannah kemo shettiknu lanu chachamim uneviim:

Kevar amarnu shettefillat hammincha keneged tamid shel ben haarbayim tikkenu zemannah. ulefi shehaya hattamid karev bechol yom betesha shaot umechetza tikkenu zemannah mittesha shaot umechetza vehi hannikret mincha ketanna. ulefi shebbeerev happesach shechal lihyot beerev shabbat hayu shochatin et hattamid beshesh shaot umechetza, amru shehammitpallel meachar shesh shaot umechetza yatza. umishshehiggia zeman ze higgia zeman chiyyuvah vezo hi hannikret mincha gedola:

Nahagu anashim harebe lehitpallel gedola uketanna vehaachat reshut. vehoru miktzat haggeonim sheen rauy lehitpallel reshut ella haggedola. vechen haddin noten mippene shehi keneged davar sheeno tadir bechol yom. veim hitpallel haggedola chova lo yitpallel ketanna ella reshut:

Ha lamadta shezzeman mincha gedola mishshesh shaot umechetza ad tesha shaot umechetza. uzeman mincha ketanna mittesha shaot umechetza ad sheyyishshaer min hayyom shaa urevia. veyesh lo lehitpallel otah ad shettishka hachamma:
Tefillat hammusafin zemannah achar tefillat hashshachar ad sheva shaot bayyom. vehammitpallel otah achar sheva shaot af al pi sheppasha yatza yede chovato mippene shezzemannah kol hayyom:
Tefillat haerev af al pi sheenah chova hammitpallel otah zemannah mittechillat hallayla ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. vtfillat neila zemanna kede sheyyashlim otah samuch lishkiat hachamma:

Hammitpallel tefilla kodem zemannah lo yatza yede chovato vechozer umitpallel otah bizmannah. veim hitpallel tefillat shacharit bishat haddechak achar sheala ammud hashshachar yatza. veyesh lo lehitpallel tefillat arvit shel lele shabbat beerev shabbat kodem shettishka hachamma. vechen yitpallel arvit shel motzae shabbat beshabbat lefi shettefillat arvit reshut en medakdekin bizmannah. uvilvad sheyyikra keriat shema bizmannah achar tzet hakkochavim:

Kol mi sheavar alav zeman tefilla velo hitpallel bemezid en lo takkana veeno meshallem. beshogeg o shehaya anus o tarud meshallem otah tefilla bizman tefilla hassemucha lah. umakdim tefilla shebbizmannah veachareha mitpallel et hattashlumin:

Ketzad. taa velo hitpallel shacharit veavar chatzi hayyom yitpallel mincha shetayim. rishona tefillat mincha vehashsheniyya tashlume shacharit. taa velo hitpallel mincha ad sheshshaka hachamma yitpallel arvit shetayim. rishona arvit usheniyya tashlume mincha. taa velo hitpallel arvit ad sheala ammud hashshachar mitpallel shacharit shetayim. rishona shacharit vehashsheniyya tashlume arvit:

Taa velo hitpallel lo tefilla zo velo tefilla hassemucha lah eno meshallem ella acharona bilvad. ketzad. taa velo hitpallel lo shacharit velo mincha mitpallel arvit shetayim rishona arvit vehaacharona tashlume mincha. aval shacharit en lah tashlumin shekkevar avar zemannah. vechen bishar tefillot:
Hayu lefanav shete tefillot shel mincha veshel musafin mitpallel shel mincha veachar kach mitpallel shel musafin. veyesh mi shemmore sheen osin betzibbur ken kede shello yitu:
Chamishsha devarim meakkevin et hattefilla af al pi shehiggia zemanna. tohorat yadayim. vechissuy haerva. vetohorat mekom tefilla. udevarim hachofzim oto. vechavvanat hallev:

Tohorat yadayim ketzad. rochetz yadav bemayim ad happerek veachar kach yitpallel. haya mehallech badderech vehiggia zeman tefilla velo haya lo mayim. im haya beno uven hammayim arbaa milin shehem shemonat alafim amma holech ad mekom hammayim verochetz veachar kach yitpallel. haya beno uven hammayim yoter al ken mekanneach yadav bitzror o beafar o bekora umitpallel:

Bamme devarim amurim lefanav aval im haya mekom hammayim laachorav en mechayyevin oto lachazor laachorav ella ad mil. aval im avar min hammayim yoter eno chayyav lachazor ella mekanneach yadav umitpallel. bamme devarim amurim sheeno metaher litfilla ella yadav bilvad, bishar tefillot chutz mittefillat shacharit. aval shacharit rochetz panav yadav veraglav veachar kach yitpallel. veim haya rachok min hammayim mekanneach yadav bilvad veachar kach yitpallel:

Kol hattemein rochatzin yedehen bilvad kithorin umitpallelim. af al pi sheefshar lahem litbol velaalot mittumatan en hattevila meakkevet. uchevar bearnu sheezra tikken shello yikra baal keri bilvad bedivre tora ad sheyyitbol. uvet din sheamdu achar ken hitkinu af litfilla shello yitpallel baal keri bilvad ad sheyyitbol. velo mippene tuma vetohora nagu bah ella kede shello yihyu talmide chachamim metzuyim etzel neshotehen ketarnegolim. umippene ze tikkenu tevila levaal keri levaddo vehotziuhu mikkelal hattemein:

Lefichach hayu omrin bizman takkana zo sheafillu zav sheraa keri venidda sheppalta shichvat zera umeshammeshet sheraata dam nidda tzerichin tevila likriat shema vechen litfilla mippene hakkeri af al pi shehem temein. vechen haddin noten sheen tevila zo mippene tohora ella mippene haggezera shello yihyu metzuyin etzel neshotehen tamid. uchevar batla gam takkana zo shel tefilla lefi shello pashta bechol yisrael velo haya koach batztzibbur laamod bah:

Minhag pashut beshinar uvisfarad sheen baal keri mitpallel ad sherochetz kol besaro bemayim mishshum <small>(Amos 4 12)</small> "hikkon likrat elohecha yisrael". bamme devarim amurim bevari o bechole shebbaal. aval chole sheraa keri leanso patur min harchitza veen baze minhag. vechen zav sheraa keri venidda sheppalta shichvat zera en bahen minhag ella mekannechin atzman verochatzin yedehen umitpallelin:

Kissuy haerva ketzad. af al pi shekkissa ervato kederech shemmechassin likriat shema lo yitpallel ad sheyyechasse et libbo. veim lo kissa libbo o shenneenas veen lo bema yechasse hoil vechissa ervato vehitpallel yatza. ulechattechilla lo yaase:

Tohorat mekom hattefilla ketzad. lo yitpallel bimkom hattinnofet velo bammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse velo baashpa velo bemakom sheeno bechezkat tohora ad sheyyivdekennu. kelalo shel davar kol makom sheen korin bo keriat shema en mitpallelin bo. ucheshem shemmarchikin mitztzoa umimme raglayim vereach ra umin hammet umeriyyat haerva likriat shema kach marchikin litfilla:

Hammitpallel umatza tzoa bimkomo hoil vechata mippene shello badak ad shello hitpallel chozer umitpallel bemakom tahor. haya omed bitfilla umatza tzoa kenegdo im yachol lehallech lefanav kede sheyyizrekenna leacharav arba ammot yehallech veim lav yesallekenna latztzedadin. veim eno yachol yafsik. gedole hachachamim lo hayu mitpallelim bevayit sheyyesh bo shechar velo bevayit sheyyesh bo mureyays beet ippusho mippene sherecho ra af al pi shehammakom tahor:

Devarim hachofzim oto ketzad. im haya tzarich linkavav lo yitpallel. vechol hatztzarich linkavav vehitpallel tefillato toeva vechozer umitpallel achar sheyyaase tzerachav. veim yachol lehaamid atzmo kede parsa tefillato tefilla. veaf al pi chen lechattechilla lo yitpallel ad sheyyivdok atzmo yafe yafe veyivdok nekavav veyasir kicho venio vechol haddavar hattordo veachar kach yitpallel:

Mi sheggihek ufihek venitattesh bitfillato im lirtzono hare ze megunne. veim badak gufo kodem sheyyitpallel uva leanso en bechach kelum. nizdammen lo rok bitfillato mavlio betallito o bevigdo. veim haya mitztaer bechach zorko beyado laachorav kede shello yitztaer battefilla venimtza tarud. yatza mimmennu ruach millematta keshehu omed bitfilla shello ledato shohe ad shettichle haruach vechozer litfillato:

Bikkesh lehotzi ruach millematta venitztaer harebe veeno yachol lehaamid atzmo mehallech leacharav arba ammot umamtin ad shettichle haruach. veomer ribbon kol haolamim yetzartanu nekavim nekavim chalulim chalulim galuy veyadua lefanecha cherpatenu uchelimmatenu cherpa uchelimma bechayyenu tolea verimma bemitatenu vechozer limkomo umitpallel:
Haya omed bitfilla venatfu me raglav al birkav mamtin ad sheyyichlu hammayim vechozer lammakom sheppasak. veim shaha kede ligmor et hattefilla chozer larosh:

Vechen hammashtin mayim shohe kede hilluch 4 ammot veachar kach yitpallel. umishshehitpallel shohe achar tefillato kede hilluch arba ammot veachar kach mashtin kede sheyyifsok divre hattefilla mippiv:

Kavvanat hallev ketzad. kol tefilla sheenah bechavvana enah tefilla. veim hitpallel belo kavvana chozer umitpallel bechavvana. matza dato meshubbeshet velibbo tarud asur lo lehitpallel ad shettityashshev dato. lefichach habba min hadderech vehu ayef o metzer asur lo lehitpallel ad shettityashshev dato. amru chachamim yishhe shelosha yamim ad sheyyanuach vetitkarer dato veachar kach yitpallel:

Ketzad hi hakkavvana. sheyyefanne et libbo mikkol hammachashavot veyire atzmo keillu hu omed lifne hashshechina. lefichach tzarich leshev meat kodem hattefilla kede lechavven et libbo veachar kach yitpallel benachat uvetachanunim velo yaase tefillato kemi shehaya nose massooy umashlicho veholech lo. lefichach tzarich leshev meat achar hattefilla veachar kach yippater. chasidim harishonim hayu shohin shaa achat kodem tefilla veshaa achat leachar tefilla umaarichin bitfilla shaa:

Shikkor al yitpallel mippene sheen lo kavvana. veim hitpallel tefillato toeva. lefichach chozer umitpallel kesheyyitroken mishshichruto. shatuy al yitpallel veim hitpallel tefillato tefilla. e ze shikkor ze sheeno yachol ledabber lifne hammelech. shatuy yachol ledabber bifne hammelech veeno mishtabbesh. af al pi chen hoil veshata reviit yayin lo yitpallel ad sheyyasir yeno mealav

Vechen en omdin lehitpallel lo mittoch sechok velo mittoch kallut rosh velo mittoch sicha velo mittoch meriva velo mittoch kaas ella mittoch divre tora. velo mittoch din vahalacha af al pi shehem divre tora kede shello yehe libbo tarud bahalacha. ella mittoch divre tora sheen bah iyyun kegon halachot pesukot:

Tefillot happerakim kegon tefillat musaf rosh chodesh utefillat moadot tzarich lehasedir tefillato veachar kach omed umitpallel kede shello yikkashel bah. haya mehallech bimkom sakkana kegon mekom gedude chayyot velistim vehiggia zeman tefilla mitpallel beracha achat. vezo hi. tzarche ammecha yisrael merubbim vedatam ketzara. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettitten lechol echad veechad kede parnasato ulechol geviyya ugeviyya de machsorah vehattov beenecha ase baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla. umitpallel otah badderech keshehu mehallech, veim yachol laamod omed. ucheshehu maggia leyishshuv vetitkarer dato chozer umitpallel tefilla ketakkanatah tesha esre berachot:

Shemona devarim tzarich hammitpallel lehizzaher bahen velaasotan. veim haya dachuk o neenas o sheavar velo asa otan en meakkevin. veellu hen. amida. venochach hammikdash. vetikkun hagguf. vetikkun hammalbushim. vetikkun hammakom. vehashevayat hakkol. vehakkeria. vehishtachavaya:

Amida ketzad. en mitpallel ella meummad. haya yoshev bisfina o baagala im yachol laamod yaamod. veim lav yeshev bimkomo veyitpallel. chole mitpallel afillu shochev al tziddo vehu sheyyachol lechavven et dato. vechen hatztzame veharaev hare hen bichlal cholim im yesh bo yecholet lechavven et dato yitpallel veim lav al yitpallel ad sheyyochal veyishte. haya rochev al habbehema af al pi sheyyesh lo mi sheyyochaz behemto lo yered ella yeshev bimkomo veyitpallel kede shettehe dato meyushshevet alav:

Nochach hammikdash ketzad. haya omed bechutza laaretz machazir panav nochach eretz yisrael umitpallel. haya omed baaretz mechavven et panav keneged yerushalayim. haya omed birushalayim mechavven panav keneged hammikdash. haya omed bammikdash mechavven panav keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim. suma umi shello yachol lechavven et haruchot vehamehallech bisfina yechavven et libbo keneged hashshechina veyitpallel:

Tikkun hagguf ketzad. keshehu omed bitfilla tzarich lechavven et raglav zo betzad zo venoten enav lematta keillu hu mabbit laaretz. veyihye libbo panuy lemala keillu hu omed bashshamayim umanniach yadav al libbo kefutin hayemanit al hassemalit veomed keeved lifne rabbo beema beyira vafachad. velo yanniach yadav al chalatzav:

Tikkun hammalbushim ketzad. metakken malbushav techilla umetzayyen atzmo umehadder shenneemar hishtachavu laAdonai behaderat kodesh. velo yaamod bitfilla baafunedato, velo berosh megulle, velo beraglayim megullot im derech anshe hammakom shello yaamdu bifne haggedolim ella bevatte haraglayim. uvechol makom lo yeechoz tefillin beyado vesefer tora bizroo veyitpallel mippene shellibbo tarud bahen. velo yeechoz kelim umaot beyado. aval mitpallel hu velulav beyado bimot hechag mippene shehu mitzvat hayyom. haya massoy al rosho vehiggia zeman tefilla im haya pachot mearbaa kabbin mafshilo laachorav umitpallel bo. haya arbaa kabbin mannicho al gabbe karka veachar kach yitpallel. derech kol hachachamim vetalmidehem shello yitpallelu ella keshehen atufim:

Tikkun hammakom ketzad. yaamod bemakom namuch veyachazir panav lakkotel. vetzarich liftoach challonot o petachim keneged yerushalayim kede lehitpallel kenegdan shenneemar <small>(Daniel 6 11)</small> "vechavvin petichan le beillite" vegomer. vekovea makom litfillato tamid. veen mitpallel bechurba velo achore bet hakkeneset ella im ken hechezir panav levet hakkeneset. veasur leshev betzad haomed bitfilla o laavor lefanav ad sheyyarchik mimmennu arba ammot:

Lo yaamod bemakom gavoah shelosha tefachim o yoter veyitpallel. velo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe safsal velo al gabbe kisse. haya binyan gavoah im yesh bo arba ammot al arba ammot shehu shiur habbayit hare hu kaaliyya umuttar lehitpallel bo. vechen im haya mukkaf mechitztzot mikkol ruchotav af al pi sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot muttar lehitpallel bo mippene sheen gavho nikkar shehare chalak reshut leatzmo:

Haummanin shehayu osin melacha berosh hailan o berosh hannidbach o berosh hakkotel vehiggia zeman tefilla yordin lematta umitpallelin vechozrin limlachtan. veim hayu berosh hazzayit o berosh hatteena mitpallelin bimkoman mippene shettarchan merubbe. uma hen mitpallelin. im hayu osin bisuddatan bilvad mitpallelin shalosh tefillot shel tisha asar berachot. hayu osin bischaran mitpallelin havinenu. uven kach uven kach en yordin lifne hatteva veen nosin et kappehen:

Hashevayat hakkol ketzad. lo yagbiah kolo bitfillato velo yitpallel belibbo ella mechattech haddevarim bisfatav umashmia leaznav belachash. velo yashmia kolo ella im ken haya chole o sheeno yachol lechavven et libbo ad sheyyashmia kolo, hare ze muttar. uvilvad shello yehe betzibbur kede shello tittaref datan mikkolo:

Keria ketzad. hammitpallel korea chamesh keriot bechol tefilla utefilla. bivracha rishona battechilla uvassof. uvehodaya battechilla uvassof. uchesheggomer hattefilla korea ufosea shalosh pesiot laachorav. ucheshehu korea noten shalom missemol atzmo veachar kach mimin atzmo veachar kach magbiah rosho min hakkeria. ucheshehu korea bearba hakkeriot korea bevaruch ucheshehu zokef zokef bashshem. bamme devarim amurim behedyot. aval kohen gadol korea bitchillat kol beracha uvesof kol beracha. vehammelech kevan sheshshacha barishona eno magbiah rosho ad sheggomer kol tefillato:

Velamma noten shalom lismolo techilla. mippene shessemolo hu yamin shekkeneged panav. kelomar keshehu omed lifne hammelech noten shalom limin hammelech veachar kach lismol hammelech. vekavu sheyyippater min hattefilla kemo shenniftarin millifne hammelech:
Kol hakkeriot haellu tzarich sheyyichra bahen ad sheyyitpakkeku kol chulyot shebbashshidra veyaase atzmo kekeshet. veim shacha meat vetzier atzmo venire kechorea bechol kocho eno choshesh:

Hishtachavaya ketzad. achar shemmagbiah rosho mikkeria chamishit yeshev laaretz venofel al panav artza umitchannen bechol hattachanunim sheyyirtze. keria haamura bechol makom al birkayim. kida al appayim. hishtachavaya ze pishshut yadayim veraglayim ad shennimtza muttal al panav artza:

Keshehu ose nefilat panim achar tefilla yesh mi shehu ose kida veyesh mi shehu ose hishtachavaya. veasur laasot hishtachavaya al haavanim ella bammikdash kemo shebbearnu behilchot avodat kochavim. veen adam chashuv rashshay lippol al panav ella im ken hu yodea beatzmo shehu tzaddik kihoshua. aval matte panav meat veeno kovesh otan bakkarka. umuttar leadam lehitpallel bemakom ze velippol al panav bemakom acher:

Minhag pashut bechol yisrael sheen nefilat appayim beshabbatot uvemoadim velo berosh hashshana velo berashe chodashim uvachanukka uvefurim velo bemincha shel arve shabbatot veyamim tovim velo bearvit shebbechol yom. veyesh yechidim shennoflim al penehem bearvit. uveyom hakkippurim bilvad noflim al penehem bechol tefilla utefilla mippene shehu yom techinna uvakkasha vetaanit:

Asur lo leadam laavor achore bet hakkeneset beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelin ella im ken haya nose massooy, o shehaya levet hakkeneset shene petachim bishne ruchot, sheharoe omer shemma yelech veyikkanes mippetach haacher. vechen im haya bair shene batte kenesiyyot yomar haroe shemma yelech levet hakkeneset haragil bo. veim yesh lo tefillin berosho muttar lo laavor veaf al pi sheen sham echad mikkol ellu shehattefillin mochichin alav shehu rodef achar mitzvot veeno mimmevattele tefilla:

Hammitpallel im hatztzibbur lo yaarich et tefillato yoter midday aval beno leven atzmo harshut beyado. veim ba lomar achar tefillato afillu keseder vidduy yom hakkippurim omer. vechen im ratza lehosif bechol beracha uveracha min haemtzaiyyot meen habberacha mosif:

Ketzad. haya lo chole mevakkesh alav rachamim bevirkat cholim kefi tzachut leshono. haya tzarich lefarnasa mosif techinna uvakkasha bevirkat hashshanim. veal derech ze bechol achat mehen. veim ratza lishol kol tzerachav beshomea tefilla shoel. aval lo yishal lo beshalosh rishonot velo beshalosh acharonot:

Asur lo leadam sheyyitom kelum o sheyyaase melacha meachar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar ad sheyyitpallel tefillat shacharit. vechen lo yashkim lefetach chavero lishl bishlomo kodem sheyyitpallel tefillat shacharit. velo yetze badderech kodem sheyyitpallel. aval toem veose melacha kodem sheyyitpallel musaf vekodem mincha. aval eno soed samuch lammincha:

Kevan shehiggia zeman mincha gedola lo yikkanes lammerchatz afillu lehazzia ad sheyyitpallel shemma yitallef veyibbatel min hattefilla. velo leechol afillu achilat aray shemma yimmashech baachila. velo ladun afillu bigmar din shemma yissater haddin veyimmashech veyibbatel min hattefilla. vechen lo yeshev lifne hassappar lisapper afillu tisporet hedyot ad sheyyitpallel shemma yishshaver hazzug. velo yikkanes levurseki samuch lammincha ad sheyyitpallel shemma yire hefsed bimlachto veyitassek bah veyitakkev min hattefilla. veim hitchil beachat meellu lo yafsik ella gomer veachar kach mitpallel tefillat mincha:
