Meematay hatechalat tisporet mishsheyyanniach maaforet shel sapparin al birkav. umeematay hatechalat merchatz mishsheyyifshot habbeged hassamuch livsaro. umeematay hatechalat habburseki mishsheyyikshor beged ben ketefav kemo shehaummanin osin. umeematay hatechalat achila, livne eretz yisrael mishsheyyittol yadav velivne bavel mishsheyyattir chagoro. umeematay hatechalat haddin mishsheyyitattefu haddayyanim veyeshvu. veim hayu yoshvin mishsheyyatchilu baale dinin liton:

Af al pi shettefillat arvit reshut lo yavo adam mimmelachto veyomar ochal meat veishan kima veachar kach etpallel, shemma teenos oto shena venimtza yashen kol hallayla, ella mitpallel arvit veachar kach ochel veshote o yashen. umuttar lehistapper velikkanes lammerchatz samuch leshacharit mippene shello gazru ella samuch lammincha shehu davar hammatzuy sherov haam nichnasin sham bayyom. aval bashshachar davar sheeno matzuy lo gazru bo:

Mi shehaya osek betalmud tora vehiggia zeman hattefilla posek umitpallel. veim hayta torato ummanuto veeno ose melacha kelal vehaya osek battora bishat tefillato eno posek, shemmitzvat talmud tora gedola mimmitzvat tefilla. vechol haosek betzarche rabbim keosek bedivre tora:

En hammitpallel mafsik tefillato ella mippene sakkanat nefashot bilvad. vaafillu melech yisrael shoel bishlomo lo yeshivennu. aval posek hu lemelech oved kochavim shemma yahargennu. haya omed battefilla veraa melech ovde kochavim o annas ba kenegdo yekatztzer veim eno yachol yafsik. vechen im raa nechashim veakrabbim baim kenegdo im higgiu elav vehaya darkan beotan hammekomot shehen memitin posek uvoreach. veim lo haya darkan lehamit eno posek:
Nashim vaavadim uketannim chayyavim bitfilla. vechol ish sheppatur mikkeriat shema patur min hattefilla. vechol hamelavvin et hammet af al pi sheen lammitta tzorech bahen peturin min hattefilla:

Keshettikkennu chachamim divre tefillot ellu tikkenu berachot acherot levarech otan bechol yom, ellu hen. kesheyyikkanes adam lemittato lishon ballayla mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammappil chevle shena al enay vehammashkia shenat tardema vehammeir leishon bat ayin. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettatztzileni miyyetzer ra umippega ra veal yevahaluni chalomot raim velo hirhurim raim utehe mittati shelema lefanecha vetaamideni mimmenna lechayyim uleshalom vehaira enay pen ishan hammavet. baruch atta Adonai hammeir laolam kullo bichvodo:

Vekore parasha rishona mikkeriat shema veyashen. vaafillu ishto yeshena immo (kore pasuk rishon o pesuke rachamim veachar kach yishan). veim anasattu shena kore afillu pasuk rishon o pesuke rachamim veachar kach yishan:

Beshaa sheyyikatz besof shenato mevarech vehu al mittato kach. elohay neshama shennatatta bi tehora atta beratah veatta yetzartah veatta nefachtah bi veatta meshammerah bekirbi veatta atid littelah mimmenni veatta atid lehachazirah bi leatid lavo. kol zeman shehanneshama teluya bekirbi mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay ribbon kol hammaasim baruch atta Adonai hammachazir neshamot lifgarim metim:

Kesheshshomea kol hattarnegolim mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hannoten lassechvi vina lehavechin ben yom uven layla. keshellovesh begadav mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam malbish arumim. keshemmanniach sedino al rosho mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam oter yisrael betifara. keshemmaavir yadav al enav mevarech pokeach ivrim. kesheyyeshev al mittato mevarech mattir asurim. keshemmorid raglav min hammitta umannicham al gabbe karka mevarech roka haaretz al hammayim. kesheomed mevarech zokef kefufim. keshennotel yadav mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al netilat yadayim. kesherochetz panav mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammaavir chevle shena meenay utenuma meafappay, yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay velohe avotay shettargileni lidvar mitzva veal targileni lidvar avera veavon vetashlet bi yetzer tov veal yishlot bi yetzer ra utechazzekeni bemitzvotecha veten chelki betoratecha vetitteneni lechen ulechesed ulerachamim beenecha uveene chol roay vetigmeleni chasadim tovim, baruch atta Adonai gomel chasadim tovim:

Vechol zeman sheyyikkanes levet hakkisse omer kodem sheyyikkanes hitkabbedu mechubbadim kedoshim mesharte elyon izruni izruni shimruni shimruni hametinu li ad sheekkanes veetze shezze darkan shel bene adam. veachar sheyyatza mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher yatzar et haadam bechachma uvara vo nekavim nekavim chalulim chalulim galuy veyadua lifne chisse chevodecha sheim yissatem echad mehem o im yippateach echad mehem i efshar lehitkayyem afillu shaa achat baruch atta Adonai rofe chol basar umafli laasot:

Keshchoger chagoro mevarech ozer yisrael bigvura. keshellovesh nealav mevarech sheasita li kol tzarki. keshemmehallech latzet ladderech mevarech hammechin mitzade gaver. umevarech adam bechol yom baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shello asani goy. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shello asani ishsha. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shello asani aved:

Shemone esre berachot ellu en lahem seder ella mevarech kol achat mehen al davar shehabberacha bishvilo bishato. ketzad. hare shechagar chagoro vehu al mittato mevarech ozer yisrael bigvura. shama kol hattarnegol mevarech hannoten lassechvi vina. vechol beracha mehen shello nitchayyev bah eno mevarech otah:

Ketzad. lan bichsuto eno mevarech kesheomed malbish arumim. halach yachef eno mevarech sheasita li kol tzarki. beyom hakkippurim uvetisha beav sheen sham rechitza eno mevarech al netilat yadayim velo hammaavir chevle shena. im lo nichnas levet hakkisse eno mevarech asher yatzar et haadam. vechen shear berachot ellu:

Nahagu haam berov arenu levarech berachot ellu zo achar zo bevet hakkeneset ben nitchayyevu bahen ben lo nitchayyevu bahen. vetaut hu veen rauy laasot ken velo yevarech beracha ella im ken nitchayyev bah:

Hammashkim likro battora kodem sheyyikra keriat shema ben kara battora shebbichtav ben kara battora shebbeal pe notel yadav techilla umevarech shalosh berachot veachar kach kore. veellu hen. asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al divre tora. vehaarev na Adonai elohenu et divre toratcha befinu uvefippiyyot ammecha kol bet yisrael venihye anachnu vetzeetzaenu vetzeetzae ammecha yode shemecha veoske toratecha lishmah baruch atta Adonai hamelammed tora leammo yisrael. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar banu mikkol haammim venatan lanu et torato baruch atta Adonai noten hattora:

Bechol yom chayyav adam levarech shalosh berachot ellu veachar kach kore meat middivre tora. venahagu haam likro <small>(Bamidbar 6 22 27)</small> "birkat kohanim". veyesh mekomot shekkorin <small>(Bamidbar 28 2)</small> "tzav et bene yisrael". veyesh mekomot shekkorin shetehen. vekorin perakim o halachot min hammishna umin habberaytot:

Veshibbechu chachamim lemi shekkore zemirot missefer tehillim bechol yom vayom mi<small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" ad sof hassefer. uchevar nahagu likrot pesukim lifnehem uleacharehem vetikkenu beracha lifne hazzemirot vehi baruch sheamar uveracha leacharehem vehi yishtabbach. veachar kach mevarech al keriat shema vekore keriat shema:

Yesh mekomot shennahagu bahen likrot bechol yom achar shemmevarchin yishtabbach <small>(Shemot 15 1 19)</small> "shirat hayyam" veachar kach mevarchin al shema. veyesh mekomot shekkorin <small>(Devarim 32 1 43)</small> "shirat haazinu". veyesh yechidim shekkorin shete hashshirot hakkol lefi hamminhag:

Chayyav adam levarech mea berachot ben hayyom vehallayla. uma hen mea berachot ellu. 23 berachot shemmaninu beferek ze. vesheva berachot shel keriat shema shel shacharit vearvit lefaneha uleachareha. ucheshemmitattef batztzitzit mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehitattef betzitzit. ucheshellovesh tefillin mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehaniach tefillin. veshalosh tefillot shebbechol tefilla mehen shemone esre berachot hare shemonim veshesh berachot. ucheshehu ochel shete seuddot shel yom vehallayla mevarech arba esre berachot. sheva bechol seudda. achat kesheyyittol yadav techilla. veal hammazon achat battechilla veshalosh bassof veal hayyayin lefanav uleacharav hare sheva berachot hare mea berachot ben hakkol:

Bazzeman hazze shettikkenu birkat haeppikorosin battefilla vehosifu hattov vehammetiv bevirkat hammazon nimtzeu chamesh berachot yeterot. beshabbatot veyamim tovim shehattefilla sheva berachot, vechen im lo nitchayyev bishar hayyamim bechol habberachot haellu kegon shello yashan kol hallayla velo hittir chagoro velo nichnas levet hakkisse vechayyotze beellu, tzarich lehashelim mea berachot min happerot:
Ketzad. ochel meat yarak umevarech lefanav uleacharav vechozer veochel meat mipperi ze umevarech lefanav uleacharav umone kol habberachot ad shemmashlim mea bechol yom:

Seder tefillot kach hu. bashshachar mashkim adam umevarech berachot ellu. vekore hazzemirot umevarech lifnehem uleacharehem. vekore achar kach shema umevarech lefaneha uleachareha. umedalleg kedushsha min habberacha rishona shellefaneha sheen hayyachid omer kedushsha. ucheshehu chotem gaal yisrael miyyad yaamod kede sheyyismoch geulla litfilla umitpallel meummad kemo sheamarnu. uchesheyyashlim yeshev veyippol al panav umitchannen umagbiah rosho umitchannen meat vehu yoshev bedivre tachanunim. veachar kach yikra <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" (meyushshav) veyitchannen kefi kocho veyippater lemaasav:

Uvitfillat hammincha matchil likro <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" meyushshav veachar kach omed umitpallel tefillat hammincha ucheshemmashlim nofel al panav umitchannen umagbiah rosho veyitchannen kefi kocho veyippater lemaasav. uvitfillat haerev kore keriat shema umevarech lefaneha uleachareha vesomech geulla litfilla umitpallel meummad uchesheyyashlim yeshev meat veyippater. vehammitchannen achar tefillat arvit hare ze meshubbach. veaf al pi shemmevarech hashekivenu achar gaal yisrael enah hefsek ben geulla litfilla vahare shetehen kivracha achat arukka:

Tefillat hatztzibbur nishmaat tamid vaafillu hayu bahen chotim en hakkadosh baruch hu moes bitfillatan shel rabbim. lefichach tzarich adam leshattef atzmo im hatztzibbur. velo yitpallel beyachid kol zeman sheyyachol lehitpallel im hatztzibbur. uleolam yashkim adam veyaariv levet hakkeneset sheen tefillato nishmaat bechol et ella bevet hakkeneset. vechol mi sheyyesh lo bet hakkeneset beiro veeno mitpallel bo im hatztzibbur nikra shachen ra:

Umitzva larutz levet hakkeneset shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 6 3)</small> "veneda nirdefa ladaat et Adonai". uchesheyyetze mibbet hakkeneset al yafsia pesia gassa ella yelech meat meat. uchesheyyikkanes bevet hakkeneset yikkanes shiur shene petachim veachar kach yitpallel lekayyem ma shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 8 34)</small> "lishmor mezuzot petachay":

Bet hammidrash gadol mibbet hakkeneset. vachachamim gedolim af al pi shehayu lahem beiram batte kenesiyyot harebe lo hayu mitpallelin ella bemakom shehayu oskin sham battora vehu sheyyitpallel sham tefillat hatztzibbur:

Vechetzad hi tefillat hatztzibbur. yihye echad mitpallel bekol ram vehakkol shomim. veen osin ken befachot measara gedolim uvene chorin. usheliach tzibbur echad mehem. vaafillu hayu miktzatan shekkevar hitpallelu veyatzu yede chovatan mashlimin lahem laasara. vehu sheyyihyu rov haasara shello hitpallelu. vechen en omrim kedushsha velo korin battora umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha velo maftirin banneviim ella baasara:

Vechen lo yihye echad mevarech birkat shema vehakkol shomim veonin acharav amen ella baasara. veze hu hannikra pores al shema. veen omrim kaddish ella baasara. veen hakkohanim nosim yedehem ella baasara vehakkohanim min hamminyan. shekkol asara miyyisrael hem hannikraim eda shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 14 27)</small> "ad matay laeda haraa hazzot" vegomer vehayu asara shehare yatzu yehoshua vechalev:

Vechol devar kedushsha lo yehe ella betoch haeda miyyisrael shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 32)</small> "venikdashti betoch bene yisrael". vechol ellu haddevarim im hitchilu bahem baasara vehalchu miktzatam af al pi sheen rashshain yigmeru hashshear:

Vetzarich lihyot kullam bemakom echad usheliach tzibbur immahem bemakom echad. chatzer ketanna shennifretza bimloah lechatzer gedola vehayu tisha baggedola veyachid bakketanna mitztarfin. tisha bakketanna veyachid baggedola en mitztarfin. tzibbur baggedola usheliach tzibbur bakketanna yotzin yede chovatan. tzibbur bakketanna usheliach tzibbur baggedola en yotzin yede chovatan shehare hu muflag mehem veeno immahem bemakom echad mippene sheyyesh baggedola passin mikkan umikkan hare hi kemo mufleget min hakketanna veen hakketanna mufleget min haggedola ella hare hi kekeren zavit shellah:

Vechen im hayta tzoa baggedola asur lehitpallel velikrot keriat shema bakketanna. hayta tzoa bakketanna muttar lehitpallel velikrot keriat shema baggedola im lo haya sham reach ra mippene shehi mufleget mimmenna:

Sheliach tzibbur motzi et harabbim yede chovatan. ketzad. beshaa shehu mitpallel vehem shomin veonin amen achar kol beracha uveracha hare hen kemitpallelin. bamme devarim amurim kesheeno yodea lehitpallel aval hayyodea eno yotze yede chovato ella bitfillat atzmo:

Bamme devarim amurim bishar yemot hashshana chutz merosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim shel shenat hayyovel. aval bishne yamim ellu sheliach tzibbur motzi et hayyodea keshem shemmotzi mi sheeno yodea mippene shehem berachot arukkot veen rov hayyodim otan yecholin lechavven datan kishliach tzibbur. lefichach im ratza hayyodea lismoch bishne yamim ellu al tefillat shatz lehotzio yede chovato harshut beyado:

En memannin sheliach tzibbur ella gadol shebbatztzibbur bechachmato uvemaasav. veim haya zaken hare ze meshubbach beyoter. umishtaddelin lihyot sheliach tzibbur adam shekkolo arev veragil likrot. umi shello nitmalle zekano af al pi shehu chacham gadol lo yehe shatz mippene kevod tzibbur. aval pores hu al shema mishsheyyavi shete searot achar shelosh esre shanim:

Vechen hailleg kegon mi shekkore lealef ayin o leayin alef vechol mi sheeno yachol lehotzi et haotiyyot ketikkunan en memannin oto sheliach tzibbur. veharav memanne echad mittalmidav lehitpallel lefanav betzibbur. hassuma pores al shema venaase sheliach tzibbur. aval mi shekketefav megullot af al pi shehu pores al shema eno naase sheliach tzibbur litfilla ad sheyyihye atuf:

Seder tefillot hatztzibbur kach hu. bashshachar kol haam yoshvim usheliach tzibbur yored lifne hatteva veomed beemtza haam umatchil veomer kaddish vechol haam onim amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach lealam ulealme almayya bechol kochan. veonin amen besof kaddish. veachar kach omer barchu et Adonai hamevorach vehem onim baruch Adonai hamevorach leolam vaed. umatchil ufores al shema bekol ram vehem onim amen achar kol beracha uveracha. vehayyodea levarech velikrot immo kore ad shemmevarech gaal yisrael:

Vehakkol omdin miyyad umitpallelim belachash. umi sheeno yodea lehitpallel omed veshotek ad sheyyitpallel sheliach tzibbur belachash im shear haam. vechol mi sheyyigmor tefillato im hatztzibbur yafsia shalosh pesiot laachorav veyaamod bammakom shehiggia elav beet sheyyafsia:

Veachar sheyyafsia sheliach tzibbur shalosh pesiot laachorav veyaamod matchil umitpallel bekol ram mittechillat habberachot lehotzi et mi shello hitpallel. vehakkol omdim veshomim veonin amen achar kol beracha uveracha. ben ellu shello yatzu yede chovatan ben ellu shekkevar yatzu yede chovatan:

Veomer kedushsha bivracha shelishit. vechevan shehiggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha yesh reshut lechol echad veechad lachazor bammakom sheamad bo battefilla. uchesheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur lemodim vechorea kol haam shochin meat velo yishchu yoter midday. veomrim modim anachnu lach Adonai elohenu velohe chol basar yotzrenu yotzer bereshit berachot vehodaot leshimcha haggadol vehakkadosh al shehecheyitanu vekiyyamtanu ken techayyenu utechanenu veteesof galuyyotenu lechatzrot kadshecha lishmor chukkecha uleavdecha beemet velaasot retzoncha belevav shalem al sheanu modim lach. vechol haomer modim modim meshattekin oto:

Veachar sheyyashlim kol hattefilla yeshev veyippol al panav veyitte meat hu vechol hatztzibbur veyitchannen vehu nofel. veyeshev veyagbiah rosho hu ushear haam umitchannen meat bekol ram meyushshav. veachar kach yaamod sheliach tzibbur levaddo veomer kaddish paam sheniyya vehem onim kederech sheonin battechilla. veomer <small>(Tehillim 78 38)</small> "vehu rachum" vechulei <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla" vechulei. hu omed vehem yoshvim vehem korim immo. veachar kach omer <small>(yeshaya 59 20)</small> "uva letziyyon goel" vechulei <small>(yeshaya 59 21)</small> "vaani zot" vechulei <small>(Tehillim 22 4)</small> "veatta kadosh" <small>(yeshaya 6 3)</small> "vekara ze el ze veamar kadosh" vegomer hakkedushsha vehem onin <small>(yeshaya 6 3)</small> "kadosh kadosh" shalosh peamim. vechozer vekore hakkedushsha targum veomer <small>(Yechezkel 3 12)</small> "vattissaeni ruach" vechulei vekore oto targum veomer <small>(Shemot 15 18)</small> "Adonai yimloch leolam vaed" vekorehu targum kede lehavin haam:

Veellu happesukim shellifne hakkedushsha veshel achareha im targuman hem hannikrain seder kedushsha. veachar kach mitchannen bedivre tachanunim uvifsuke rachamim veomer kaddish vechol haam onin kedarkan veniftarin:

Mi sheamar betachanunim mi sherichem al kan tzippor shello likkach haem al habbanim o shello lishchot oto veet beno beyom echad yerachem alenu vechayyotze beinyan ze meshattekin oto. mippene shemmitzvot ellu gezerat hakkatuv hen veenan rachamim. sheillu hayu mippene rachamim lo haya mattir lanu shechita kol ikkar. vechen lo yarbe bechinnuyim shel shem veyomar <small>(Devarim 10 17)</small> "hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora" vehechazak vehaammitz vehaizzuz. sheen koach baadam lehaggia besof shevachav. ella omer ma sheamar moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom:

Bemincha omer sheliach tzibbur <small>(Tehillim 84 5)</small> "ashre yoshve betecha" vechulei <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" vechulei kore hu vehaam meyushshav veomed sheliach tzibbur veomer kaddish vehem omdim acharav veonin kedarkan umitpallelin kullam belachash. veachar kach chozer sheliach tzibbur umitpallel bekol ram kederech sheasa beshacharit ad sheyyashlim kol hattefilla. venoflim al penehem umitchannen umagbiah rosho hu vehem. umitchannen meat meyushshav kederech sheasa beshacharit veomed veomer kaddish vechol haam onin kedarkan veniftarin lemaasehem:

Baerev kol haam yoshvin vehu omed veomer <small>(Tehillim 78 38)</small> "vehu rachum" kulei barchu et Adonai hamevorach vechulei vehem onin baruch Adonai hamevorach leolam vaed. umatchil lifros al shema veomer kaddish veachar kach hakkol omdim umitpallelin belachash. ucheshemmashlimin omer kaddish vehem niftarin. veeno chozer lehitpallel bekol ram arvit lefi sheen tefillat arvit chova lefichach lo yevarech berachot levattala sheen kan adam shennitchayyev bahem kede lehotzio yede chovato:

Belele shabbatot chozer shatz achar shemmitpallel belachash im hatztzibbur umitpallel bekol ram. aval eno mitpallel sheva ella beracha achat meen sheva. vechen hu omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora el elyon kone berachamav shamayim vaaretz. magen avot bidvaro mechayye metim bemaamaro hael hakkadosh sheen kamohu hammeniach leammo beshabbat kadsho ki vam ratza lehaniach lahem lefanav naavod beyira vafachad venode lishmo bechol yom tamid meen habberachot el hahodaot adon hashshalom mekaddesh hashshabbat umevarech hashshevii umeniach bikdushsha leam medushshene oneg zecher lemaase vereshit. elohenu velohe avotenu retze na bimnuchatenu vechulei baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat. veomer kaddish veniftarin kol haam:

Velamma tikkenu chachamim ze. mippene sherov haam bain lehitpallel arvit belele shabbatot veyihye sham mi shennitacher lavo velo hishlim tefillato veyishshaer levaddo bevet hakkeneset veyavo lide sakkana. lefichach chozer sheliach tzibbur umitpallel kede sheyyitakkevu kol haam ad sheyyashlim hammitacher veyetze immahem:

Lefichach yom tov shechal lihyot beshabbat o yom hakkippurim o rosh chodesh en sheliach tzibbur hayyored arvit lifne hatteva mazkir inyan hayyom bivracha zo aval chotem bah mekaddesh hashshabbat bilvad lefi shello nitchayyev hayyom bivracha zo:

Beshabbatot veyamim tovim kesheggomer sheliach tzibbur tefillat shacharit bekol ram omer kaddish veachar kach <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" vechulei veomer kaddish. umitpallelin musaf belachash veachar kach mitpallel musaf bekol ram kederech sheasa beshacharit. veomer kaddish achar tefillat musaf vehaam niftarin. veen omrin kedushsha vetachanunim achar tefillat shacharit kishar hayyamim ella omer otah kodem tefillat hammincha. ketzad. kore tehilla ledavid veomer seder hayyom vedivre tachanunim veomer kaddish umitpallelin mincha vechozer umashmia tefillat mincha bekol ram veomer kaddish:
Berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed omer seder kedushsha kodem tefillat musaf. bemotzae shabbat omer seder hayyom gam achar tefillat haerev veomrim kaddish veachar kach mavdil:

Mi shehitpallel velo kivven et libbo yachazor veyitpallel bechavvana. veim kivven et libbo bivracha rishona shuv eno tzarich. mi shettaa beachat mishshalosh berachot harishonot chozer larosh. veim taa beachat mishshalosh berachot acharonot yachazor laavoda. veim taa beachat min haemtzaiyyot chozer litchillat beracha shettaa bah umashlim tefillato al hasseder. vechen sheliach tzibbur shettaa keshehu mitpallel bekol ram al derech zo hu chozer:

Aval im taa sheliach tzibbur keshehu mitpallel belachash ani omer sheeno chozer umitpallel paam sheniyya mippene torach tzibbur ella somech al hattefilla shemmitpallel bekol ram. vehu shello taa beshalosh rishonot sheim taa bahem leolam chozer kemo shehayyachid chozer:

Sheliach tzibbur shettaa venivhal velo yada mehechan yatchil veshaha shaa yaamod acher tachtav. veim taa bevirkat haeppikorsin en mamtinin lo ella miyyad yaamod acher tachtav shemma eppikorsut nizreka bo. vehu shello hitchil bah aval im hitchil bah mamtinin lo shaa. velo yehe hashsheni sarvan beotah shaa:

Umehechan hu matchil, mittechillat beracha shettaa bah rishon im taa beachat min haemtzaiyyot. aval im taa beachat min hashshalosh rishonot matchil hashsheni min harosh. veim taa beachat min haacharonot yatchil hashsheni min haavoda:
Haomer eni yored lifne hatteva mippene shebbegaday tzevuim af bilvanim lo yaavor beotah tefilla. amar eni over mippene sheyyesh beragli sandal af yachef lo yaavor:

Mi shennistappek lo im hitpallel im lo hitpallel eno chozer umitpallel ella im ken mitpallel tefilla zo al daat shehi nedava. sheim ratza yachid lehitpallel kol hayyom tefillat nedava yitpallel. mi shehaya omed bitfilla venizkar shekkevar hitpallel posek vaafillu beemtza beracha. veim hayta tefillat arvit eno posek shello hitpallel otah mittechilla ella al daat sheenah chova:

Mi shettaa vehitpallel shel chol beshabbat lo yatza. veim nizkar vehu betoch hattefilla gomer beracha shehitchil bah vechozer umitpallel shel shabbat. bamme devarim amurim bearvit o beshacharit o bemincha. aval bemusaf posek afillu beemtza habberacha. vechen im hishlim tefilla shel chol al daat shehu musaf chozer umitpallel musaf. echad shabbat veechad yom tov veechad rosh chodesh:

Mi shettaa bimot haggeshamim velo amar morid haggeshem velo morid hattal chozer larosh. veim hizkir hattal eno chozer. veim taa bimot hachamma veamar morid haggeshem chozer larosh. veim lo hizkir tal en machzirin oto, sheen hattal neetzar veen tzarich bakkasha:

Mi sheshshachach sheela bevirkat hashshanim im nizkar kodem shomea tefilla shoel et haggeshamim beshomea tefilla. veim achar shebberech shomea tefilla chozer levirkat hashshanim. veim lo nizkar ad shehishlim kol tefillato chozer larosh umitpallel sheniyya:

Taa velo hizkir yaale veyavo im nizkar kodem sheyyashlim tefillato chozer laavoda umazkir. veim nizkar achar shehishlim tefillato chozer larosh. veim haya ragil lomar tachanunim achar tefillato venizkar achar shehishlim tefillato kodem sheyyaakor raglav chozer laavoda:
Bamme devarim amurim bechullo shel moed o beshacharit uvemincha shel rashe chodashim. aval arvit shel rosh chodesh im lo hizkir eno chozer:

Kol makom shehayyachid chozer umitpallel shatz chozer umitpallel im taa kemoto beet shemmitpallel bekol ram. chutz mishshacharit shel rosh chodesh sheim shachach shatz velo hizkir yaale veyavo ad shehishlim tefillato en machzirin oto mippene torach tzibbur. shehare tefillat hammusafin lefanav shehu mazkir bah rosh chodesh:

Asara yamim shemmerosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim taa vechatam bahem bivracha shelishit hael hakkadosh chozer larosh. taa vechatam beashte esre melech ohev tzedaka umishpat chozer litchillat habberacha vechotem bah hammelech hammishpat umitpallel veholech al hasseder. veim lo nizkar ella ad shehishlim kol tefillato chozer larosh. echad yachid veechad sheliach tzibbur:

Taa velo hizkir havedala bechonen haddaat mashlim tefillato veeno tzarich lachazor. vechen mi shello hizkir al hannissim bachanukka uvefurim vaanenu bitfillat taanit eno chozer umitpallel. echad yachid veechad sheliach tzibbur. veim nizkar kodem sheyyaakor et raglav omer anenu ki atta shomea tefilla pode umatztzil bechol et tzara vetzuka <small>(Tehillim 19 15)</small> "yihyu leratzon imre fi" vegomer:

Shachach velo hitpallel mincha beerev shabbat yitpallel arvit shetayim shel shabbat. vechen beyom tov. shachach velo hitpallel mincha beshabbat o beyom tov mitpallel bemotzaehen arvit shetayim shel chol. mavdil barishona veeno mavdil bashsheniyya. veim hivdil bishtehen o lo hivdil beachat mehen yatza. aval im lo hivdil barishona vehivdil bashsheniyya chozer umitpallel tefilla shelishit mippene sheharishona lo alta lo mippene shehikdimah litfillat arvit. vechol hammitpallel shete tefillot afillu shacharit umusaf lo yitpallel zo achar zo ella yishhe ben tefilla litfilla kede shettitchonen dato alav:

Asur lo lammitpallel betzibbur sheyyakdim tefillato litfillat hatztzibbur. hannichnas levet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur shemmitpallelin belachash im yachol lehatechil veligmor ad shello yaggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha yitpallel. veim lav yamtin ad sheyyatchil sheliach tzibbur lehitpallel bekol ram veyitpallel immo belachash milla bemilla ad sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha veone kedushsha im hatztzibbur umitpallel shear tefilla leatzmo. veim hitchil lehitpallel kodem sheliach tzibbur vehiggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha lo yafsik velo yaane kedushsha immahen. vechen lo yaane amen yehe shemeh rabba mevorach vehu beemtza hattefilla veen tzarich lomar bishar habberachot:

Kol makom sheyyesh bo asara miyyisrael tzarich lehachin lo bayit sheyyikkansu bo litfilla bechol et tefilla umakom ze nikra bet hakkeneset. vechofin bene hair ze et ze livnot lahem bet hakkeneset veliknot lahem sefer tora neviim uchetuvim:

Keshebbonin bet hakkeneset en bonin otah ella begavhah shel ir shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 1 21)</small> "berosh homiyyot tikra". umagbihin otah ad shettehe gevoha mikkol chatzrot hair shenneemar <small>(Ezra 9 9)</small> "uleromem et bet elohenu". veen potchin pitche bet hakkeneset ella bammizrach shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 3 38)</small> "vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma". uvonin bo hechol shemmannichin bo sefer tora. uvonin hechol ze baruach shemmitpallelin kenegdo beotah hair. kede sheyyihyu penehem el mul hahechol kesheyyaamdu litfilla:

Umaamidin bima beemtza habbayit kede sheyyaale aleha hakkore battora o mi asher omer laam divre kibbushin kede sheyyishmeu kullam. ucheshemmaamidin hatteva sheyyesh bah sefer tora maamidin otah baemtza vaachore hatteva kelappe hahechol ufaneha kelappe haam:

Ketzad haam yoshvin bevatte kenesiyyot. hazzekenim yoshvin ufenehen kelappe haam vaachorehem kelappe hahechol. vechol haam yoshvin shura lifne shura ufene hashshura laachore hashshura shellefaneha ad sheyyihyu pene kol haam kelappe hakkodesh uchelappe hazzekenim uchelappe hatteva. uveet sheshsheliach tzibbur omed litfilla omed baaretz lifne hatteva ufanav lifne hakkodesh kishar haam:

Batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot nohagin bahen kavod umechabbedim otan umarbitzin otan. venohagin kol yisrael bisfarad uvammaarav beshinar uveeretz hatztzevi lehadelik ashashiyyot bevatte kenesiyyot ulehatztzia bekarkaan machtzelaot kede leshev alehem. uveare edom yoshvin bah al hakkisot:

Batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot en nohagin bahen kallut rosh kegon sechok vehittul vesicha betela. veen ochlin bahen veen shotin bahen veen neotin bahen veen metayyelin bahen veen nichnasin bahen bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. vachachamim vetalmidehem muttarin leechol velishtot bahen middochak:

Veen mechashshevin bahen cheshbonot ella im ken hayu cheshbonot shel mitzva kegon kuppa shel tzedaka ufidyon shevuyim vechayyotze bahen. veen maspidin bahen ella hesped shel rabbim kegon sheyyihye sham hesped gedole chachme otah hair shekkol haam mitkabbetzin uvain biglalan:

Haya levet hakkeneset o levet hammidrash shene petachin lo yaasennu kappandarya kede sheyyikkanes befetach ze veyetze bappetach shekkenegdo lekarev hadderech. sheasur likkanes bahen ella lidvar mitzva:

Mi shetztzarich likkanes levet hakkeneset likrot tinok o chavero yikkanes veyikra meat o yomar shemua veachar kach yikra chavero kede shello yikkanes bishvil chafatzav bilvad. veim eno yodea yomar letinok min hattinokot kera li happasuk sheatta kore bo. o yishhe meat bevet hakkeneset veachar kach yetze. shehayeshiva sham meiske hammitzvot hi shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 84 5)</small> "ashre yoshve vetecha" vegomer:

Mi shennichnas lehitpallel o likrot muttar lo latzet bappetach shekkenegdo kede lekarev et hadderech. umuttar laadam likkanes levet hakkeneset bemaklo beminalo uvaafundato uvaavak sheal raglav. veim haya tzarich larok yarok bevet hakkeneset:

Batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot shecharvu bikdushshatan hen omdot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 26 lo)</small> "vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem" af al pi shehen shommin bikdushshatan hen omdin. ucheshem shennohagin bahen kavod beyishshuvan kach nohagin bahen bechurbanam chutz mikkibbud veribbutz sheen mechabbedin otan veen marbitzin otan. alu bahen asavim tolshin otam umannichin otan bimkoman kede sheyyiru otan haam veteor rucham veyivnum:

En sotrin bet hakkeneset kede livnot acher bimkomo o bemakom acher. aval bonin acher veachar kach sotrin ze. shemma yeera lahem ones velo yivnu. afillu kotel echad mimmennu bone hechadash betzad hayyashan veachar kach soter hayyashan:

Bamme devarim amurim shello charvu yesodotav o shello natu ketalav lippol. aval im charvu yesodotav o shennatu ketalav lippol sotrin oto miyyad umatchilin livnot bimhera bayyom uvallayla shemma tidchok hashshaa veyishshaer charev:

Muttar laasot bet hakkeneset bet hammidrash. aval bet hammidrash asur laasoto bet hakkeneset. shekkedushshat bet hammidrash yetera al kedushshat bet hakkeneset umaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. vechen bene hair shemmachru bet hakkeneset yesh lahen likkach bedamav teva. machru teva yesh lahen likkach bedameha mitpachot o tik lesefer tora. machru mitpachot o tik lokchim bedamav chummashim. machru chummashin lokchin bedamav sefer tora. aval im machru sefer tora en lokchin bedamav ella sefer tora acher sheen sham kedushsha lemala mikkedushshat sefer tora. vechen bemotareha:

Vechen im gavu haam maot livnot bet hammidrash o levet hakkeneset o liknot teva o mitpachot vetik o sefer tora veratzu leshannot kol ma sheggavu. en meshannin otan ella mikkedushsha kalla likdushsha chamura mimmenna. aval im asu ma sheggavu laasot vehotiru meshannin hammotar lechol ma sheyyirtzu. vechol kele bet hakkeneset kevet hakkeneset. parochet sheal haaron shemmannichim bo hassefarim kemitpechot hassefarim. veim hitnu alehem hare hen kefi hattenay:

Bamme devarim amurim shemmuttar limkor bet hakkeneset, bevet hakkeneset shel kefarim shello asu oto ella al daat bene hakkefar levaddam sheyyihye lahem lehitpallel bo sheim ratzu kullam lemachro muttarin. aval bet hakkeneset shel kerakkin hoil veal daat kol anshe haolam naasa sheyyavo veyitpallel bo kol habba el hammedina naasa shel kol yisrael veen mochrin oto leolam:

Bene hakkefar sheratzu limkor bet hakkeneset shellahen o livnot bedamav bet hakkeneset acher o liknot bedamav teva o sefer tora tzerichin lehatenot al hallokeach shello laasot oto lo merchatz velo burseki. vehu hammakom shemmeabbedin bo et haorot. velo bet hattevila velo bet hammayim. veim hitnu shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair bishat mechira sheyyehe hallokeach muttar laasot bo kol ellu muttar:

Vechen im hitnu shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair al motar haddamim sheyyihyu chullin hare hen chullin. ucheshellokchin haddamim uvonin mehen bet hakkeneset acher o sheyyiknu mehem teva o mitpachot vetik o chummashin o sefer tora hashshear yehe chullin kemo shehitnu veyaasu bahen ma sheyyirtzu:
Vechen im kibbelu alehen kol anshe hair o rubbam adam echad. kol ma sheasa asuy vehu mocher venoten levaddo kefi ma sheyyire veyatne kefi ma sheyyire:

Keshem shemmuttar lahem limkor bet hakkeneset kach notnin oto bemattana. sheillu lo haya lahem latztzibbur hanaya bemattana zo lo netanuhu. aval lo maskirin oto velo memashkenin oto. vechen keshessotrin batte kenesiyyot livnotan muttarin limkor ulehachalif velatet bemattana hallevenim vehaetzim veheafar shellahen. aval lehalevotan asur sheen hakkedushsha ola mehen ella bedamim o bahanaya shehi kedamim:

Rechovah shel ir af al pi shehaam mitpallelin bo betaaniyyot uvemaamadot mippene shehakkibbutz rav veen batte kenesiyyot mechilin otan en bo kedushsha mippene shehu aray velo nikba litfilla. vechen battim vachatzerot shehaam mitkabbetzin bahem litfilla en bahem kedushsha mippene shello kavu otam litfilla bilvad ella aray mitpallelim bahen keadam shemmitpallel betoch beto:

Moshe rabbenu tikken lahem lisrael sheyyehu korin battora barabbim beshabbat uvesheni uvachamishi beshacharit kede shello yishhu shelosha yamim belo shemiat tora. veezra tikken sheyyehu korin ken bemincha bechol shabbat mishshum yoshve keranot. vegam hu tikken sheyyehu korin besheni uvachamishi shelosha bene adam velo yikreu pachot measara pesukim:

Veellu hen hayyamim shekkorin bahem battora betzibbur. beshabbatot uvemoadim uverashe chodashim uvetaaniyyot uvachanukka uvefurim uvesheni vachamishi shebbechol shavua veshavua. veen maftirin banneviim ella beshabbatot veyamim tovim vetisha beav bilvad:

En korin battora betzibbur befachot measara anashim gedolim bene chorin. veen korin pachot measara pesukim. vaydabber ole min hamminyan. velo yihyu hakkorin pachot mishshelosha anashim. veen matchilin befarasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim. veen meshayyerin befarasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim. velo yikra hakkore pachot mishshelosha pesukim:
Shelosha shekkaru asara pesukim shenayim korin shelosha shelosha veechad arbaa. uven shehaya hakkore arbaa rishon o acharon o emtzai hare ze meshubbach:

Kol echad veechad min hakkorin poteach sefer tora umabbit lammakom shehu kore bo. veachar kach omer barchu et Adonai hamevorach vechol haam onin baruch Adonai hamevorach leolam vaed [ ]. vechozer umevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar banu mikkol haammim venatan lanu et torato baruch atta Adonai noten hattora. vechol haam onin amen. veachar kach kore ad sheyyashlim likrot vegolel hassefer umevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher natan lanu torato torat emet vechayye olam nata betochenu baruch atta Adonai noten hattora:

En hakkore battora rashshay likrot battora ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur. kara vetaa afillu bedikduk ot achat machzirin oto ad sheyyikraenna bedikduk. velo yikreu shenayim battora ella haechad levaddo. kara venishtattek yaamod acher tachtav veyatchil mimmakom shehitchil harishon shennishtattek umevarech bassof:

En hakkore rashshay likrot ad sheyyomar lo gadol shebbatztzibbur likrot. vaafillu chazzan hakkeneset o rosh hakkeneset eno kore meatzmo ad sheyyomru lo hatztzibbur o gadol shebbahem likrot. vetzarich echad laamod immo bishat keria kederech chazzan haomed im hakkorin:

Hakkore yesh lo ledalleg mimmakom lemakom beinyan echad kegon <small>(Vayikra 16 1)</small> "achare mot" v<small>(Vayikra 23 27)</small> "ach beasor" shebbefarashat <small>(Vayikra 21 1)</small> "emor el hakkohanim". vehu shello yikra al pe sheasur likrot shello min hakketav afillu teva achat. velo yishhe bedillug ella kede sheyyashlim hatturgeman targum happasuk:

Kevan shehitchil hakkore likrot battora asur lesapper afillu bidvar halacha ella hakkol shomin veshotkin umesimin libbam lema shehu kore shenneemar <small>(Nechemya 8 3)</small> "veazne chol haam el sefer hattora". veasur latzet min hakkeneset beshaa shehakkore kore. umuttar latzet ben ish leish. umi shehu osek battora tamid vetorato umnuto muttar lo laasok betalmud tora beshaa shehakkore kore battora:

Mimot ezra nahagu sheyyehe sham turgeman metargem laam ma shehakkore kore battora kede sheyyavinu inyan haddevarim. vehakkore kore pasuk echad bilvad veshotek ad sheyyetargem oto hatturgeman vechozer vekore pasuk sheni. veen hakkore rashshay likrot lamturgeman yoter mippasuk echad:

En hakkore rashshay lehagebiah kolo yoter min hametargem. vehametargem lo yagbiah kolo yoter min hakkore. veen hametargem rashshay letargem ad sheyyichle happasuk mippi hakkore. veen hakkore rashshay likrot pasuk acher ad sheyyichle hattargum mippi hatturgeman. veen hatturgeman nishan lo leammud velo lekora ella omed beema uveyira. velo yetargem mittoch hakketav ella al pe. veen hakkore rashshay lesayyea latturgeman shello yomru targum katuv battora. vehakkatan metargem al yede gadol veen kavod laggadol sheyyetargem al yede katan. velo yihyu hametargemin shenayim keechad ella echad kore veechad metargem:

Velo kol hammikraot metargeminan betzibbur. <small>(Bereshit la 22)</small> "maase reuven" u<small>(Bamidbar 6 22 27)</small> "virkat kohanim" umaase haegel min <small>(Shemot 32 21)</small> "vayyomer moshe el aharon" ad <small>(Shemot 32 25)</small> "vayyar moshe et haam" vegomer veod pasuk echad <small>(Shemot 32 la)</small> "vayyiggof Adonai et haam" kullam nikrain velo mittargemin. uvemaase amnon bammakom shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 13 1)</small> "amnon ben david" nikra velo mittargem:

Hammaftir bannavi tzarich likrot battora techilla afillu shelosha pesukim. chozer vekore ma shekkara lefanav. velo yaftir bannavi ad sheyyiglol sefer tora. velo yifchot meesrim veechad pesukim. veim shalem hainyan befachot meellu eno tzarich lehosif. veim kara asara pesukim vetirgeman hametargem dayyo vaafillu lo shalem hainyan. uvannavi echad kore vaafillu shenayim metargemin. umedalleg meinyan leinyan acher. veeno medalleg minnavi lenavi ella binviim shel shenem asar bilvad. uvilvad shello yedalleg missof hassefer litchillato. vechol hamedalleg lo yishhe bedillug ella kede sheyyashlim hametargem targumo:

Hakkore bannavi yesh lo likrot latturgeman shelosha pesukim vehametargem metargem shelashtan ze achar ze. veim hayu shelosha happesukim shalosh parashiyyot lo yikra latturgeman ella echad echad bilvad:

Hammaftir bannavi mevarech lefanav beracha achat. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar binviim vechulei. umevarech leacharav arba berachot. beracha rishona chotem bah hael hanneeman bechol devarav. sheniyya chotem bah bone yerushalayim. shelishit chotem bah magen david. reviit chotem bah inyan kedushshat hayyom kemo shechotem battefilla. vechen im chal rosh chodesh lihyot beshabbat hammaftir bannavi mazkir rosh chodesh bivracha zo kemo shemmazkir battefilla:

Kamma hen hakkorin. beshabbat beshacharit korin shiva. uveyom hakkippurim shishsha. uveyamim tovim chamishsha. en pochatin mehen aval mosifin alehem. berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed korin arbaa. beshabbat uveyom hakkippurim bemincha uvesheni uvachamishi shel kol hashshana uvachanukka uvefurim beshacharit uvime hattaanit beshacharit uvemincha korin shelosha. en pochatin mimminyan ze veen mosifin alehen:

Ishsha lo tikra betzibbur mippene kevod hatztzibbur. katan hayyodea likrot veyodea lemi mevarchin ole mimminyan hakkorim. vechen maftir ole mehamminyan shehare hu kore battora. veim hifsik sheliach tzibbur bekaddish ben mashlim uven hammaftir eno ole min hamminyan. tzibbur shello haya bahem yodea likrot ella echad ole vekore veyored vechozer vekore sheniyya ushelishit ad sheyyigmor minyan hakkorim shel oto hayyom:

Bechol keria ukeria meellu kohen kore rishon veacharav levi veacharav miyyisrael. uminhag pashut hu hayyom sheafillu kohen am haaretz kodem likrot lifne chacham gadol yisrael. vechol mi shehu gadol mechavero bechachma kodem likrot. vehaacharon sheggolel sefer tora notel sachar keneged hakkol. lefichach ole umashlim afillu gadol shebbatztzibbur:

En sham kohen ole yisrael. velo yaale acharav levi kelal. en sham levi kohen shekkara rishon chozer vekore hu atzmo paam sheniyya bimkom levi. aval lo yikra acharav kohen acher shemma yomru harishon pasul ulefichach ole kohen acher. vechen lo yikra levi achar levi shemma yomru echad mishshenehem pasul:

Ketzad seder hakkeria battora. achar hattefilla kol yom sheyyesh bo tefillat musaf achar sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur tefillat shacharit omer kaddish umotzi sefer tora vekore leechad echad min hatztzibbur veolin vekorin battora. uchesheggomrin machazir sefer tora limkomah veomer kaddish umitpallelin tefillat musaf. veyamim sheyyesh bahen maftir umusaf nahagu lomar kaddish kodem sheyyaale hammaftir. veyesh mekomot shennahagu lomar kaddish achar hammaftir:

Uvemincha shel shabbat veshel yom hakkippurim achar sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" veseder hayyom omer kaddish umotzi sefer tora veolin vekorin bo umachaziro veomer kaddish umitpallelin mincha. vechen betaanit korin bemincha veachar kach omer kaddish umitpallelin tefillat mincha. aval beyom tov lo nahagu likrot bemincha:

Veyom sheen bo musaf kesheggomer tefillat shacharit omer kaddish umotzi sefer tora vekorin bo umachaziro veomer kaddish veachar kach omer <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" veseder hayyom kederech sheomrim bechol yom veomer kaddish vechol haam niftarin:

En korin bechummashin bevatte kenesiyyot mishshum kevod tzibbur. veen gollin sefer tora betzibbur mippene torach hatztzibbur shello yatriach alehem lihyotan omdin ad sheyyiglol sefer tora. lefichach im yitztarchu likrot shene inyanim motziin shene sifre tora. velo yikra ish echad inyan echad bishte torot shemma yomru sefer rishon pagum haya ulefichach kore bashsheni:

Kol haggolel sefer tora gollu mibbachutz ucheshehu mehaddeko mehaddeko mibbifnim. vetzarich lehaamido al hattefer kede shello yikkara. makom shemmotziin sefer tora achar shekkorin bo umolichin oto levet acher lehatzenio en hatztzibbur rashshain latzet ad sheyyetze sefer tora vilauu oto vehem acharav ad hammakom shemmatzniin oto bo:

Hamminhag happashut bechol yisral shemmashlimin et hattora beshana achat. matchilin beshabbat sheachar chag hassukkot vekorin beseder <small>(Bereshit 1 1)</small> "bereshit". bashsheniyya <small>(Bereshit 6 9)</small> "elle toldot". bashshelishit <small>(Bereshit 12 1)</small> "vayyomer Adonai el avram". vekorin veholchin al hasseder hazze ad sheggomrin et hattora bechag hassukkot. veyesh mi shemmashlim et hattora beshalosh shanim veeno minhag pashut:

Ezra tikken lahem leyisrael sheyyehu korin kelalot shebbesefer vayyikra kodem atzeret veshebbemishne tora kodem rosh hashshana. vehamminhag happashut sheyyehu korin <small>(Bamidbar 1 1)</small> "bemidbar sinay" kodem atzeret. <small>(Devarim 3 23)</small> "vaetchannan" achar tisha beav. <small>(Devarim 29 9)</small> "attem nitztzavim" kodem rosh hashshana. <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "tzav et aharon" kodem happesach beshana peshuta. lefichach yesh shabbatot shekkorin shacharit shene sedarin kegon <small>(Vayikra 12 2)</small> "ishsha ki tazria" v<small>(Vayikra 14 2)</small> "zot tihye torat hammetzora". <small>(Vayikra 26 3)</small> "im bechukkotay" im <small>(Vayikra 25 1)</small> "behar sinay" vechayyotze bahen kede sheyyashlimu beshana veyikreu otan hassedarim beonatan:

Makom shemmafsikin beshabbat beshacharit sham korin bemincha uvesheni uvachamishi uleshabbat habbaa. ketzad. shabbat rishona korin beshacharit beseder <small>(Bereshit 1 1)</small> "bereshit". bemincha korin <small>(Bereshit 6 9)</small> "elle toldot noach" asara pesukim o yoter. vechen besheni uvachamishi. vechen leshabbat habbaa beshacharit matchilin meelle toldot noach vekore ad sof hasseder. veal derech zo korin kol hashshana. umaftirin bechol shabbat veshabbat bannavi meen shekkara battora:

Uverashe chodashim. harishon kore shelosha pesukim mipparashat <small>(Bamidbar 28 2)</small> "tzav". vehashsheni chozer vekore pasuk 3 shekkara harishon ushene pesukim sheacharav kede sheyyeshayyer bapparasha shelosha pesukim. vehashshelishi kore shelosha pesukim sheshshiyyer hashsheni im <small>(Bamidbar 28 9)</small> "uveyom hashshabbat". veharvii kore <small>(Bamidbar 28 11)</small> "uverashe chadshechem". veim chal rosh chodesh lihyot beshabbat motziin shene sefarim beshacharit. beechad korin bo seder otah shabbat uvashsheni kore bo hammashlim uverashe chadshechem. vehammaftir kore inyan rosh chodesh. umaftirin <small>(yeshaya 66 23)</small> "vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho". verosh chodesh av shechal lihyot beshabbat maftirin <small>(yeshaya 1 14)</small> "chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi". verosh chodesh shechal lihyot beechad beshabbat maftirin bashshabbat shellefanav <small>(Shmuel 1 20 18)</small> "vayyomer lo yehonatan machar chodesh":

Kol haole likrot battora poteach bedavar tov umesayyem bedavar tov. aval parashat <small>(Devarim 32 1)</small> "haazinu" kore harishon ad <small>(Devarim 32 7)</small> "zechor yemot olam". vehashsheni matchil mizzechor yemot olam ad <small>(Devarim 32 13)</small> "yarkivehu". vehashshelishi miyyarkivehu ad vayyar Adonai vayyinatz. veharvii min vayyar Adonai vayyinatz ad <small>(Devarim 32 29)</small> "lu chachmu". vehachamishi min lu chachmu ad <small>(Devarim 32 40)</small> "ki essa el shamayim yadi". vehashshishshi mikki essa el shamayim yadi ad sof hashshira. velamma poskin bah beinyanot ellu mippene shehen tochacha kede sheyyachzeru haam bitshuva:

Shemona pesukim shebbesof hattora muttar likrot otam bevet hakkeneset befachot measara. af al pi shehakkol tora hi umoshe mippi haggevura amaram hoil umashmaan shehem achar mitat moshe hare nishtannu ulefichach muttar leyachid likrot otan:

Kelalot shebbetorat kohanim en mafsikin bahen ella echad kore otan matchil bappasuk shellifnehem umesayyem bappasuk shel acharehem. ukelalot shebbemishne tora im ratza lifsok bahen posek uchevar nahagu haam shello lifsok bahen ella echad kore otan:

Mafsikin lemoadot uleyom hakkippurim vekorin beinyan hammoed, lo beseder shabbat. umoshe tikken lahem leyisrael sheyyehu korin bechol moed inyano. veshoalin vedorshin beinyano shel yom bechol moed umoed. uma hen korin. befesach befarashat moadot shebbetorat kohanim. uchevar nahagu haam likrot beyom rishon <small>(Shemot 12 21)</small> "mishchu ukechu lachem" umaftirin b<small>(gemara Megila lo 1)</small> "fesach gilgal". uveyom tov sheni <small>(Vayikra 22 27)</small> "shor o chesev" umaftirin befesach yoshiyyahu. bashshelishi <small>(Shemot 13 2)</small> "kaddesh li chol bechor". barvii <small>(Shemot 22 24)</small> "im kesef talve". bachamishi <small>(Shemot 34 1)</small> "pesal lecha". beshishshi <small>(Bamidbar 9 2)</small> "veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach bemoado". beyom tov acharon <small>(Shemot 13 17)</small> "vayhi beshallach" ad sof hashshira ad <small>(Shemot 15 26)</small> "ki ani Adonai rofecha" umaftirin <small>(Shmuel 2 22 1)</small> "vaydabber david". uvashshemini <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "kol habbechor" umaftirin <small>(yeshaya 10 32)</small> "od hayyom":

Baatzeret korin b<small>(Devarim 16 9)</small> "shiva shavuot". uminhag pashut shekkorim beyom tov harishon <small>(Shemot 19 1)</small> "bachodesh hashshelishi" umaftirin bemerkava. uvesheni korin befarashat moadot <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "kol habbechor" umaftirin bachavakkuk:

Berosh hashshana korin <small>(Bamidbar 29 1)</small> "bachodesh hashshevii beechad lachodesh". uminhag pashut shekkorin beyom rishon <small>(Bereshit 21 1)</small> "vaAdonai pakad et sara" umaftirin <small>(Shmuel 1 1 1)</small> "vayhi ish echad min haramatayim". uvesheni korin <small>(Bereshit 22 1)</small> "vehaelohim nissa et avraham" umaftirin <small>(yirmeya lo 19)</small> "haven yakkir li efrayim":

Beyom hakkippurim beshacharit korin <small>(Vayikra 16 1)</small> "achare mot" umaftirin <small>(yeshaya 57 15)</small> "ko amar ram venissa". bemincha korin baarayot shebbeachare mot kede sheyyizkor veyikkalem kol mi shennichshal beachat mehen veyachazor bitshuva. vehashshelishi kore battora umaftir beyona:

Besukkot bishne yamim tovim harishonim korin befarashat hammoadot shehi <small>(Vayikra 22 27)</small> "shor o chesev o ez" vegomer umaftirin beyom rishon <small>(Zecharya 14 1)</small> "hinne yom ba laAdonai". uveyom sheni <small>(Melachim 1 8 2)</small> "vayyikkahalu el hammelech shelomo". uveyom tov acharon korin <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "kol habbechor" umaftirin <small>(Melachim 1 8 54)</small> "vayhi kechallot shelomo". ulemachar korin <small>(Devarim 33 1)</small> "vezot habberacha" umaftirin <small>(Melachim 1 8 22)</small> "vayyaamod shelomo". veyesh mi shemmaftirin <small>(Yehoshua 1 1)</small> "vayhi achare mot mshe". uvishar yemot hechag korin bekarbenot hechag:

Ketzad. bechol yom vayom mechullo shel moed kore shete parashiyyot. <small>(Bamidbar 29 20)</small> "bayyom hashshelishi" shehu chullo shel moed kore hakkohen <small>(Bamidbar 29 17)</small> "uvayyom hashsheni". velevi kore uvayyom hashshelishi. veyisrael kore bayyom hashshelishi. veharvii chozer vekore bayyom hashsheni uvayyom hashshelishi. vechen bayyom harvii shehu sheni shel chullo shel moed korin uvayyom hashshelishi <small>(Bamidbar 29 23)</small> "uvayyom harvii". veal derech zo bechol yom vayom:

Bechol yom veyom miyyamim tovim vechen beyom hakkippurim uveshivat yeme happesach motziin shene sefarim beshacharit. harishon kore bo ellu hainyanot sheamarnu. vehashsheni kore bo karban oto hayyom haamur bechummash happekuddim battora. vehakkore inyan hakkarban hu maftir bannavi:

Uvechol yom shemmotziin shene sefarim o shelosha im hotziu ze achar ze keshemmachazir et harishon omer kaddish umotzi hashsheni. ucheshemmachazir et haacharon omer kaddish. uchevar amarnu shehamminhag happashut lomar kaddish achar shekkore hammashlim leolam veachar kach maftirin bannavi:

Shabbat shechala lihyot bechullo shel moed ben befesach ben besukkot korin beotah shabbat <small>(Shemot 33 12)</small> "ree atta omer elay" umaftirin befesach <small>(Yechezkel 37 4)</small> "haatzamot hayeveshot". veim chala betoch hechag <small>(Yechezkel 38 18)</small> "beyom bo gog":

Bachanukka beyom rishon korin mi<small>(Bamidbar 6 22)</small> "birkat kohanim" ad sof karban <small>(Bamidbar 7 12)</small> "hammakriv bayyom harishon". uveyom sheni korin karban nasi shehikriv besheni. vechen ad yom hashshemini. beyom shemini korin ad sof hakkarbanot ad sof hasseder. umaftirin beshabbat shel chanukka benerot zecharya. veim hayu shete shabbatot bachanukka maftirin beshabbat rishona benerot zecharya. uvashsheniyya benerot shelomo. vehakkore beinyan chanukka hu shemmaftir bannavi. befurim korin beshacharit <small>(Shemot 17 8)</small> "vayyavo amalek":

Betisha beav korin beshacharit <small>(Devarim 4 25)</small> "ki tolid banim" umaftirin <small>(yirmeya 8 13)</small> "asof asifem neum Adonai". uvemincha korin <small>(Shemot 32 11)</small> "vaychal mshe" kishar yeme hattaaniyyot. uvishar hattaaniyyot sheanu mitanin al ma sheera laavotenu korin beshacharit umincha. harishon kore vaychal moshe arba pesukim. vekore hashsheni vehashshelishi mi<small>(Shemot 34 1)</small> "pesal lecha" ad <small>(Shemot 34 10)</small> "asher ani osho immach". uvetaaniyyot sheggozrin otan hatztzibbur mippene hatztzarot kegon batztzoret vedever vechayyotze bahen korin berachot ukelalot kede sheyyashuvu haam veyikkana levavam kesheyyishmeu otam:

Nahagu haam lihyot maftirin kodem tisha beav beshalosh shabbatot bedivre tochachot. shabbat rishona maftirin b<small>(yirmeya 1 1)</small> "divre yirmeyahu". sheniyya <small>(yeshaya 1 1)</small> "chazon yeshayahu". shelishit <small>(yeshaya 1 21)</small> "echa hayta lezona". vechen shabbat sheachar tisha beav maftirin <small>(yeshaya 40 1)</small> "nachamu nachamu ammi". uminhag pashut beirenu lihyot maftirin benechamot yeshayahu meachar tisha beav ad rosh hashshana. veshabbat shebben rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim maftirin <small>(Hoshea 14 2)</small> "shuva yisrael":

Rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot beshabbat korin befarashat <small>(Shemot 30 11 16)</small> "shekalim" umaftirin bi<small>(Melachim 2 12 3)</small> "yhoyada hakkohen". vechen im chal rosh chodesh adar lihyot betoch hashshabbat vaafillu beerev shabbat makdimin vekorin bashshabbat shellefanav befarashat shekalim. bashsheniyya korin <small>(Devarim 25 17)</small> "zachor" umaftirin <small>(Shmuel 1 15 2)</small> "pakadti et asher asa amalek". e zo hi shabbat sheniyya kol shechal purim lihyot betochah vaafillu beerev shabbat. bashshelishit korin <small>(Bamidbar 19 1)</small> "para adumma" umaftirin <small>(Yechezkel 36 25)</small> "vezarakti alechem". vee zo hi shabbat shelishit hassemucha larviit. barviit korin <small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "hachodesh hazze" umaftirin <small>(Yechezkel 45 18)</small> "berishon beechad lachodesh". vee zo hi reviit kol shechal rosh chodesh nisan lihyot betochah vaafillu beerev shabbat:

Nimtzeta omer sheppeamim tihye hafesaka ben shabbat rishona usheniyya o ben sheniyya ushelishit. ufeamim yihyu shete hafesakot ben rishona lishniyya uven sheniyya ushelishit. aval ben shelishit lirviit en mafsikin:

Kol parasha mearba parashiyyot haellu echad kore otah besefer sheni achar shekkorin seder otah shabbat bassefer shehotziu rishon. chal rosh chodesh adar lihyot beshabbat vehaya seder otah shabbat bi <small>(Shemot 27 20)</small> "veatta tetzavve" korin shishsha mivveatta tetzavve ad <small>(Shemot 30 18)</small> "veasita kiyyor nechshet" vehashshevii chozer vekore mikki tissa ad veasita kiyyor. veim haya seder otah shabbat ki tissa atzmo korin shishsha mikki tissa ad <small>(Shemot la 1)</small> "vayyakhel" vehashshevii chozer vekore besefer sheni mikki tissa ad veasita kiyyor nechoshet:

Rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot beshabbat motziin shelosha sefarim. harishon kore bo seder hayyom. vehashsheni kore bo inyan rosh chodesh. vehashshelishi korin bo <small>(Shemot 30 12)</small> "ki tissa". vechen rosh chodesh nisan shechal lihyot beshabbat motziin shelosha sefarim. korin seder hayyom barishon. veinyan rosh chodesh bashsheni. v<small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "hachodesh hazze" bashshelishi:

Rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihyot beshabbat motziin shelosha sefarim. harishon kore bo seder hayyom. vehashsheni kore bo inyan rosh chodesh. vehashshelishi kore bo inyan chanukka. chal lihyot beemtza hashshabbat shelosha korin beinyan rosh chodesh veharvii kore beinyan chanukka:

Af al pi sheadam shomea kol hattora kullah bechol shabbat batztzibbur chayyav likrot leatzmo bechol shavua veshavua seder shel otah shabbat shenayim mikra veechad targum. ufasuk sheen bo targum korehu shalosh peamim ad sheyyashlim parashiyyotav im hatztzibbur:

Beshacharit bemusaf uvinilo hakkohanim nosim et kappehem. aval bemincha en nesiat kappayim. mippene shebbemincha kevar saadu kol haam veshemma shatu hakkohanim yayin veshikkor asur binsiat kappayim. vaafillu beyom taanit en nosin kappehen bemincha gezera minchat taanit mippene minchat kol yom:

Bamme devarim amurim betaaniyyot shemmitpallelin bo mincha uneila kegon tzom kippur vetaanit tzibbur. aval taanit sheen bo neila kegon tisha beav veshiva asar betammuz hoil utefillat mincha shellahem samuch lishkiat hachamma hare niret kinila veenah mitchallefet bemincha shel kol yom. ulefichach yesh bah nesiat kappayim. vechohen sheavar veala ladduchan bemincha shel yom hakkippurim hoil vehaddavar yadua sheen sham shichrut hare ze nose kappav veen moridin oto mippene hachashad shello yomru pasul haya lefichach horiduhu:

Ketzad hi nesiat kappayim baggevulin. beet sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur laavoda kesheyyomar retze kol hakkohanim haomdim bevet hakkeneset neekarin mimmekoman veholchin veolin ladduchan veomdim sham penehem lahechol vaachorehem kelappe haam veetzbeotehem kefufot letoch kappehem ad sheyyashlim sheliach tzibbur hahodaa umachzirin penehem kelappe haam ufoshtin etzbeotehen umagbihin yedehem keneged kitfehem umatchilin <small>(Bamidbar 6 24)</small> "yevarechcha". usheliach tzibbur makre otam milla milla vehem onin shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 23)</small> "amor lahem" ad sheyyomar. keshemmashlimin pasuk rishon kol haam onin amen. vechozer sheliach tzibbur umakre otan pasuk sheni milla milla vehem onim ad shemmashlimin pasuk sheni vechol haam onin amen. vechen befasuk shelishi:

Kesheyyashlimu hakkohanim shelosha pesukim matchil sheliach tzibbur beracha acharona shel tefilla shehi sim shalom vehakkohanim machzirin penehem kelappe hakkodesh vekoftzin etzbeotehen veomdin sham badduchan ad sheyyigmor habberacha vechozrin limkoman:

En hammakre rashshay (lehakerot lakkohanim) ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur. veen hakkohanim rashshain lehatechil babberacha ad sheyyichle haddibbur mippi hammakre. veen hatztzibbur onin amen ad shettichle habberacha mippi hakkohanim. veen hakkohanim matchilin bivracha acheret ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur. veen sheliach tzibbur rashshay laanot amen achar hakkohanim kishar haam shemma tittaref dato velo yeda ezo beracha makre otan, im pasuk sheni o pasuk shelishi:

En hakkohanim rashshain lehachazir penehem min hatztzibbur ad sheyyatchil sheliach tzibbur sim shalom. veen hakkohanim rashshain leaker mimmekoman ad sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur sim shalom. veen rashshain lachof kishre etzbeotehem ad sheyyachaziru penehem min hatztzibbur. umittakkanot [ ezra] shello yaalu hakkohanim ladduchan besandelehen ella omdin yechefin:

Kesheyyihyu hakkohanim mevarchin et haam lo yabbitu baam velo yassichu datan ella yihyu enehem keneged haaretz keomed bitfilla. veen adam rashshay lehistakkel bifne hakkohanim beshaa shehen mevarchin et haam kede shello yassichu datam. ella kol haam mitkavvenin lishmoa habberacha umechavvenim penehem keneged pene hakkohanim veenam mabbitim bifnehem:

Im haya hakkohen hamevarech echad matchil levarech meatzmo. usheliach tzibbur makre oto milla milla kemo sheamarnu. hayu shenayim o yoter enan matchilin levarech ad sheyyikra lahem sheliach tzibbur veomer lahem kohanim vehem onin veomrim <small>(Bamidbar 6 24)</small> "yevarechcha". vehu makre otan milla milla al hasseder sheamarnu:

Ketzad birkat kohanim bammikdash. hakkohanim olin ladduchan achar sheyyashlimu hakkohanim avodat tamid shel shachar. umagbihin yedehem lemala al gabbe rashehen veetzbeotehen peshutot. chutz mikkohen gadol sheen magbiah yadav lemala min hatztzitz. veechad makre otan milla milla kederech sheosin baggevulin ad sheyyashlimu shelosha happesukim. veen haam onin achar kol pasuk ella osin otah bammikdash beracha achat. uchesheyyashlimu kol haam onim baruch Adonai elohim elohe yisrael min haolam vead haolam:

Veomer et hashshem kichtavo vehu hashshem hannehge miyyud hei vav hei. veze hu hashshem hameforash haamur bechol makom. uvammedina omrim oto bechinnuyo vehu beAlef dalet. sheen mazkirin et hashshem kichtavo ella bammikdash bilvad. umishshemmet shimon hatztzaddik pasku hakkohanim millevarech bashshem hameforash afillu bammikdash kede shello yilmod oto adam sheeno chashuv vesheeno hagun. velo hayu chachamim harishonim melammedin shem ze letalmidehem uvenehem hahagunim ella paam achat lesheva shanim. kol ze gedulla lishmo hannichbad vehannora:

En birkat kohanim neemeret bechol makom ella bilshon hakkodesh shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 23)</small> "ko tevarachu et bene yisrael". kach lamdu mippi hashshemua mimmoshe rabbenu alav hashshalom ko tevarchu baamida. ko tevarchu binsiat kappayim. ko tevarchu bilshon hakkodesh. ko tevarchu panim keneged panim. ko tevarchu bekol ram. ko tevarchu beshem hameforash. vehu sheyyihye bammikdash kemo sheamarnu:

En hakkohanim rashshain bechol makom lehosif beracha al sheloshet happesukim kegon <small>(Devarim 1 11)</small> "Adonai elohe avotechem yosef alechem kachem elef peamim" vechayyotze bah lo bekol ram velo belachash shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 2)</small> "lo tosifu al haddavar". beshaa shekkol kohen ole ladduchan keshehu oker raglav laalot omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettihye beracha zo shetztzivvitanu levarech et ammecha yisrael beracha shelema veal yehi bah michshol veavon meatta vead olam. vekodem sheyyachazir panav levarech et haam mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bikdushshato shel aharon vetzivvanu levarech et ammo yisrael beahava. veachar kach machazir panav latztzibbur umatchil levarcham. ucheshemmachazir panav min hatztzibbur achar shemmashlim omer asinu ma sheggazarta alenu ase immanu ma shehivtachtanu <small>(Devarim 26 15)</small> "hashekifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim uvarech et ammecha et yisrael":

Keshemmachzirin hakkohanim et penehem latztzibbur levarcham ucheshemmachzirin penehem min hatztzibbur achar shemmevarchin lo yachaziru ella al derech yamin bechol makom. vechen kol pinnot sheyyihye adam pone lo yihyu ella al derech yamin:

Bammikdash mevarchin birkat kohanim paam achat beyom achar tamid shel shachar. bain veomdin al maalot haulam umevarchin kederech sheamarnu. aval bammedina mevarchin otah achar kol tefilla chutz mimmincha kemo sheamarnu. bechol makom mishtaddelin sheyyihye hammakre otan yisrael shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 23)</small> "amor lahem" mikkelal sheen hammakre mehem:

Shishsha devarim monin nesiat kappayim. hallashon. vehammumin. vihaavera. vehashshanim. vehayyayin. vetumat hayyadayim. hallashon ketzad. haillegim sheen motziin et haotiyyot ketikkunan kegon shekkorin laalefin aynin uleaynin alefin o leshibbolet sibbolet vechayyotze bahen en nosin et kappehen. vechen kevede pe uchevede lashon sheen divrehem nikkarim lakkol en nosin et kappehen:

Hammumin ketzad. kohen sheyyesh mumin befanav o beyadav o beraglav kegon shehayu etzbeotav akummot o akkushshot o shehayu yadav bohakaniyyot lo yissa et kappav lefi shehaam mistakkelin bo. mi shehaya riro yored al zekano beshaa shehu medabber vechen hassuma beachat meenav lo yissa et kappav. veim haya dash beiro vehakkol hayu regilim beze hassuma beachat meenav o beze sheriro zav muttar lefi sheen mistakkelin bo. vechen mi shehayu yadav tzevuot istis ufua lo yissa et kappav. veim rov anshe hair melachtan bechach muttar lefi sheen mistakkelin bo:

Haavera ketzad. kohen sheharag et hannefesh af al pi sheasa teshuva lo yissa et kappav shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 1 15)</small> "yedechem damim maleu" uchetiv <small>(yeshaya 1 15)</small> "uvefarischem kappechem" vegomer. vechohen sheavad kochavim ben beones ben bishgaga af al pi sheasa teshuva eno nose et kappav leolam shenneemar <small>(Melachim 2 23 9)</small> "ach lo yaalu kohane habbamot" vegomer. uveracha kaavoda hi shenneemar <small>(Devarim 10 8)</small> "lesharto ulevarech bishmo". vechen kohen shehemir leakkum af al pi shechazar bo eno nose et kappav leolam. ushear haaverot en monin:

Hashshanim ketzad. kohen naar lo yissa et kappav ad sheyyitmalle zekano. vehayyayin ketzad. mi sheshshata reviit yayin bevat achat eno nose et kappav ad sheyyasir et yeno mealav lefi shehukkesha beracha laavoda. shata reviit yayin bishte peamim o shennatan letocho meat mayim muttar. veim shata yoter merviit af al pi shehaya mazug af al pi sheshshetao bechamma peamim lo yissa et kappav ad sheyyasir et yeno mealav. vechamma hi reviit etzbaim al etzbaim berum etzbaim vachatzi etzba vechomesh etzba begudal. veze haetzba shemmoshchin bo bechol hattora kullah hu haggudal vehu hannikra bohen yad:

Tumat hayyadayim ketzad. kohen shello natal et yadav lo yissa et kappav ella notel et yadav ad happerek kederech shemmekaddeshin laavoda veachar kach mevarech shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 134 2)</small> "seu yedechem kodesh uvarachu et Adonai". vehechalal eno nose et kappav lefi sheeno bechihuno:

Kohen shello haya lo davar mikkol ellu haddevarim hammonin nesiat kappayim af al pi sheeno chacham veeno medakdek bemitzvot o shehayu habberiyyot merannenim acharav o shello haya massao umattano betzedek hare ze nose et kappav veen monin oto lefi shezzo mitzvat ase al kol kohen vechohen sherauy linsiat kappayim veen omrim leadam rasha hosef resha vehimmana min hammitzvot:

Veal titma vetomar uma toil birkat hedyot ze. sheen kibbul habberacha taluy bakkohanim ella behakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 27)</small> "vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarachem". hakkohanim osim mitzvatan shennitztauu bah vehakkadosh baruch hu verachamav mevarech et yisrael kecheftzo:

Am shehem achore hakkohanim enam bichlal habberacha. vehaomdim mitztziddehen hare hem bichlal habberacha. veim hayta mechitztza ben hakkohanim uven hammitbarchim afillu hi choma shel barzel hoil ufenehem mul pene hakkohanim hare hem bichlal habberacha:

Nesiat kappayim baasara vechohanim min hamminyan. bet hakkeneset shekkullan kohanim kullam nosim et kappehem. ulemi hem mevarchim leachehem shebbatztzafon velaachehem shebbaddarom. umi one acharehem amen hannashim vehattaf. veim nisharu sham asara kohanim yoter al ellu shealu ladduchan haasara onin amen vehashshear mevarchin:

Tzibbur shello haya bahen kohen ella sheliach tzibbur levaddo lo yissa et kappav. veim hayta havetachato shehu nose et kappav vechozer litfillato rashshay. veim en lahem kohen kelal kesheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur lesim shalom omer elohenu velohe avotenu barchenu babberacha hameshulleshet battora hakketuva al yede moshe avdecha haamura mippi aharon uvanav kohanim am kedoshecha kaamur <small>(Bamidbar 6 24)</small> "yevarechcha Adonai veyishmerecha" <small>(Bamidbar 6 25)</small> "yaer Adonai panav elecha vichunnekka" <small>(Bamidbar 6 26)</small> "yissa Adonai panav elecha veyasem lecha shalom" <small>(Bamidbar 6 27)</small> "vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarachem". veen haam onin amen. umatchil veomer sim shalom:

Kohen shennasa et kappav bevet hakkeneset vehalach levet hakkeneset acher umatza tzibbur shemmitpallelin velo higgiu levirkat kohanim nose yadav lahen umevarchan. vaafillu kamma peamim beyom. kohen shello akar raglav mimmekomo laalot ladduchan beshaa sheamar sheliach tzibbur retze shuv eno ole beotah tefilla. aval im akar raglav laalot af al pi shello higgia ladduchan ella achar avoda hare ze ole umevarech:

Kol kohen sheeno ole ladduchan af al pi shebbittel mitzvat ase achat hare ze keover al shalosh ase shenneemar (Bamidbar 6 23) "ko tevarachu et bene yisrael" (Bamidbar 6 23) "amor lahem" (Bamidbar 6 27) "vesamu et shemi". vechol kohen sheeno mevarech eno mitbarech vechol kohen hamevarech mitbarech shenneemar (Bereshit 12 3) "vaavaracha mevarchecha":
seliku hilchot tefila besiyyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Tefillin, Mezuzah and the: Arba parashiyyot ellu. shehen <small>(Shemot 13 1)</small> "kaddesh li". <small>(Shemot 13 11)</small> "vehaya chi yeviacha Adonai" shebbesefer veelle shemot. u<small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema". <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa". hen shennichtavot bifne atzman umechappin otan beor venikrain tefillin umannichin otan al harosh vekoshrin otan al hayyad. vaafillu kotzo shel ot achat mearba parashiyyot ellu meakkev et kullan min hattora ad sheyyihyu nichtavot shelemot ketikkunan:

Vechen shete parashiyyot shebbammezuza shehen <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" afillu ot achat mishshete happarashiyyot im chaser kotzo meakkev min hattora ad sheyyihyu shetehen nichtavot shelemot. vechen sefer tora shechisser afillu ot achat pasul:

Asara devarim yesh battefillin kullan halacha lemoshe missinay vechullan meakkevin. lefichach im shinna beachat mehen hare hattefillin pesulot. shenayim hen bichtivatan ushemona bechippuyan ukeshirat retzuotehen. veellu hen hashshenayim shebbichtivatan. shekkotvin otan bidyo vesheyyihyu nichtavin al hakkelaf:

Ketzad maase haddeyo. mekabbetzin heashan shel shemanim o shel zefet veshel shaava vechayyotze bahen vegovlin otan bisraf hailan uvimat devash velottin oto harebe vedachin oto ad sheyyease rekikin umeyabbeshin oto umatzniin oto. uvishat ketiva shorehu beme afatzim vechayyotze bo vechotev bo. sheim timchakennu yihye nimchak. vezehu haddeyo shemmitzva min hammuvchar lichtov bo sefarim tefillin umezuzot. veim katav shelashtan beme aftza vekankantom shehu omed veeno nimchak kesheriyim:

Im ken ma miata hahalacha shenneemar lemoshe missinay sheyyihyu ketuvim bidyo. lemaet shear mine tzivonin kegon haadom vehayyarok vechayyotze bahen. sheim katav bassefarim o battefillin o bammezuzot afillu ot achat bishar mine tzivonin o bezahav hare ellu pesulin:

Shalosh orot hen. gevil ukelaf veduchesusetus. ketzad. lokchin or behema o chayya umaavirin hassear mimmennu techilla. veachar kach molchin oto bemelach. veachar kach meabbedin oto bekemach. veachar kach baaftza vechayyotze bo middevarim shemmechavvetzin et haor umechazzekin oto. veze hu hannikra gevil:

Veim lakchu haor achar sheheeviru searo vechilleku oto beavyo lishnayim kemo shehaabbedanin osin ad sheyyihyu shene orot. echad dak hu shemmimmul hassear veechad ave vehu shemmimmul habbasar veibbedu oto bemelach veachar kach bekemach veachar kach baaftza vechayyotze bo. ze hachelek shemmimmul hassear nikra duchesusetus veze shemmimmul habbasar nikra kelaf:

Halacha lemoshe missinay sheyyihyu kotvin sefer tora al haggevil vechotvin bimkom hassear. vesheyyihyu kotvin hattefillin al hakkelaf vechotvin bimkom habbasar. vesheyyihyu kotvin hammezuza al duchesusetus vechotvin bimkom hassear. vechol hakkotev al hakkelaf bimkom sear o shekkatav bigvil uveduchesusetus bimkom basar pasul:

Af al pi shekkach hi halacha lemoshe missinay im katav sefer tora al hakkelaf kasher. velo neemar gevil ella lemaet duchesusetus sheim katav alav hassefer pasul. vechen im katav et hammezuza al hakkelaf o al haggevil kasher. lo amru al duchesusetus ella lemitzva:

En kotvin sefarim tefillin umezuzot al gabbe or behema temea veof vechayya hattemeim. aval kotvin al gabbe or behema vechayya vaof tehorim vaafillu nevelot uterefot shellahen. veen kotvin al gabbe or haddag hattahor mippene hazzuhama. sheen hazzuhama poseket beibbudah:

Gevil shel sefer tora ukelaf shel tefillin o shel sefer tora tzarich leabbed otan lishman. veim ibbedan shello lishman pesulin. lefichach im ibbedan hakkuti pesulin af al pi sheamarnu lo lakkuti leabbed or ze leshem hassefer o leshem hattefillin pesulin. shehakkuti al daat atzmo hu ose lo al daat hassocher oto. lefichach kol davar shetztzarich maase lishmo im asahu hakkuti pasul. umezuza enah tzericha haavada lishmah:

Halacha lemoshe missinay sheen kotvin sefer tora velo mezuza ella besirtut. aval tefillin enan tzerichin sirtut lefi shehen mechuppin. umuttar lichtov tefillin umezuza shello min hakketav shehakkol gorsin parashiyyot ellu. aval sefer tora asur lichtov afillu ot achat shello min hakketav:

Sefer tora tefillin umezuzot shekketavan eppikoros yissarfu. ketavan kuti o yisrael mumar o moser beyad annas o eved o ishsha o katan hare ellu pesulin veyigganzu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 8)</small> "ukeshartam" <small>(Devarim 6 9)</small> "uchetavtam" kol shemmuzhar al hakkeshira umaamin bah hu shekkotev. nimtzeu beyad eppikoros veeno yodea mi ketavan yigganzu. nimtzeu beyad kuti kesherim. veen lokchin sefarim tefillin umezuzot min hakkutim beyoter al demehem shello leharegil otan leganvan ulegazlan:
Sefer tora tefillin umezuzot shekketavan al gabbe or behema chayya veof hattemein o al gabbe orot sheenam meubbadin o shekkatav sefer tora utefillin al or shello ibbedan lishman hare ellu pesulin:

Hakkotev sefer tora o tefillin o mezuza uvishat ketiva lo hayta lo kavvana vechatav azkara min haazkarot shebbahen shello lishman pesulin. lefichach hakkotev et hashshem afillu melech yisrael shoel bishlomo lo yeshivennu. haya kotev shenayim o shelosha shemot hare ze mafsik benehem umeshiv:

Hattovel et hakkulmos lichtov et hashshem lo yatchil meot hashshem aval matchil hu meot shellefanav. shachach lichtov et hashshem kullo tole oto ben hashshittot. aval miktzat hashshem bashshitta umiktzato taluy pasul. uvishar hattevot im shachach kotev miktzat hatteva bashshitta umiktzatah lemala. bamme devarim amurim besefer tora aval bimzuza utefillin en tolin bahen afillu ot achat. ella im shachach afillu ot achat gonez ma shekkatav vechotev acheret. umuttar lichtov et hashshem al mekom haggered veal mekom hammachak bechullan:
Kotve sefarim tefillin umezuzot asur lahem lahafoch hayeria al paneha ella pores aleha beged o koflah:

Sefer tora tefillin umezuza sheamar hassofer achar sheyyatzu mittachat yado lo katavti haazkarot shebbahen lishman eno neeman lefaslan aval neeman hu lehafesid kol secharo. velamma eno neeman lefaslan shemma lo nitkavven ella lehafesid al hallokeach o al ze shessecharo vedome sheeno mafsid baamira zo ella sechar haazkarot. lefichach im amar sefer tora ze o tefillin ellu orot shellahen enam meubbadot lishman mittoch shenneeman lehafesid secharo neeman lefaslan. shehare hakkol yodim sheim en haorot meubbadim lishman en sachar lo kelal:

En kotvin tefillin umezuza ella bichtav ashshurit. vehittiru bassefarim lichtov af bivani bilvad. uchevar nishka yevani min haolam venishtabbesh veavad lefichach en kotvin hayyom shelashtan ella ashshurit. vetzarich lehizzaher bichtivatan kede shello tidbak ot beot shekkol ot sheen haor makkif lah mearba ruchoteha pasul. vechol ot sheen hattinok sheeno lo chacham velo sachol yachol likrotah pasul. lefichach tzarich lehizzaher betzurat haotiyyot shello tidme hayyud levav velo vav leyud velo kaf levet velo bet lechaf velo dalet leresh velo resh ledalet vechen kol kayyotze baze ad sheyyarutz kol hakkore bahen:

Or shehaya nakuv lo yichtov al gabbe hannekev. vechol nekev shehaddeyo overet alav eno nekev umuttar lichtov alav. lefichach muttar lichtov al gabbe or haof shennitabbed. nikkav haor achar shennichtav im nikkav betoch haot kegon toch hei o toch mem vechen bishar otiyyot kasher. nikkav bayyarech shel ot ad shennifseka. im nishtayyer mimmenna melo ot ketanna kasher vehu shello tidme leot acheret. veim lo nishtayyer mimmenna melo ot ketanna pesula:

Ketzad kotvin et hattefillin shel rosh. kotvin arba parashiyyot al arba kelafin vegollin kol echad veechad levaddo umannichin otan bearba battim shehen mechubbarin beor echad. veshel yad kotvin otan haarba parashiyyot bearba dappin al kelaf echad vegollelo kemin sefer tora missofo litchillato umannicho bevayit echad:

Vetzarich lehizzaher bapparashiyyot sheim asa hassetuma petucha o happetucha setuma pesalan. usheloshet happarashiyyot harishonot kullan petuchot ufarasha acharona shehi <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" setuma:

Vetzarich lehizzaher bemale vechaser ad sheyyihyu arbatan ketuvot kemo shehen ketuvot besefer tora habbaduk. sheim katav hechaser male pasul ad sheyyimchok hayyater. veim katav hammale chaser pasul veen lo takkana. veellu hen hachaserot vehammeleot sheyyesh bearba parashiyyot ellu:

Parasha rishona <small>(Shemot 13 2)</small> "kaddesh li chol bechor" male. zachor male. bechozek chaser. [hotzi male. yotzim chaser vav.] yeviacha male. vehaemori chaser. vehayevusi male. laavotecha chaser vav. haavoda chaser. matztzot chaser. hashshevii male. matztzot male. seor chaser. gevulecha chaser. baavur male. leot male. ulezikkaron male. enecha male. torat male. hotziacha chaser yod. hachukka chaser. lemoadah male:

Parasha sheniyya <small>(Shemot 13 5)</small> "vehaya ki yeviacha" chaser yod. velaavotecha chaser vav. chamor chaser. bechor male. bechozek chaser. hotzianu male. vayyaharog chaser. bechor male. mibbechor chaser. vead bechor male. zoveach chaser vav. vechol bechor male. leot male. yadcha katuv beHei. uletotafot chaser vav tinyana. enecha male. bechozek chaser. hotzianu male:

Parasha shelishit <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" ayin shel shema gedola. dalet shel echad gedola. meodecha chaser. levanecha male. bevetecha belo yod sheniyya. uvekumecha male. leot male. yadecha chaser. letotafot chaser shene vavin. enecha male. mezuzot chaser vav rishona. betecha belo yod sheniyya. uvisharecha male:

Parasha reviit <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" chaser. mitzvotay beVav achat. yore male. umalkosh male. vetiroshcha chaser vav. vehishtachavitem male. yevulah male. hattova chaser. noten chaser. otam chaser. leot male. letotafot chaser vav sheniyya. enechem male. otam chaser. bevetecha belo yod sheniyya. uvekumecha male. mezuzot male. betecha belo yod sheniyya. uvisharecha male. laavotechem chaser vav:
Vetzarich lehizzaher betagin shel otiyyot vehen kemo zayinnin zekufot sheyyesh lahen tag kemo shehen ketuvin besefer tora. veellu hen haotiyyot hametuyyagot shebbearba parashiyyot ellu:

Parasha rishona yesh bah ot achat bilvad vehi mem setuma shel <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "miyyamim" aleha shalosh zayinnin. parasha sheniyya yesh lah chamesh otiyyot vechol achat mehen hei veal kol hei mechamishtan arba zayinnin. vehen hei shel <small>(Shemot 13 11)</small> "unetanah". vehe rishona vehe acharona shel <small>(Shemot 13 15)</small> "hiksha". vehe shel <small>(Shemot 13 15)</small> "vayyaharog". vehe shel <small>(Shemot 13 16)</small> "yadcha". parasha shelishit yesh bah chamesh otiyyot veellu hen kuf shel <small>(Devarim 6 7)</small> "uvekumecha" yesh aleha shalosh zayinnin. vekuf shel <small>(Devarim 6 8)</small> "ukeshartam" yesh aleha shalosh zayinnin. vetet tet fe shel <small>(Devarim 6 8)</small> "letotafot" al kol ot mishshelashtan arba zayinnin. parasha reviit yesh bah chamesh otiyyot. fe shel <small>(Devarim 11 14)</small> "veasafta" yesh aleha shalosh zayinnin. vetav shel veasafta yesh aleha zayin achat. vetet tet fe shel <small>(Devarim 11 18)</small> "letotafot" al kol achat mishshelashtan arba zayinnin. kol haotiyyot hametuyyagot shesh esre. veim lo asa hattagin o hosif vegara bahen lo pasal:

Hallokeach tefillin mimmi sheeno mumche tzarich levadkan. lakach mimmennu mea ketzitzot bodek mehen shalosh ketzitzot. o shetayim shel rosh veachat shel yad o shetayim shel yad veachat shel rosh. im metzaam kesherim huchzak ze haish vahare kullan kesherim veen hashshear tzarich bedika. veim lekacham tzevatim tzevatim kullan tzerichot bedika shechezkat hatztzevatim meanashim harebe lekuchim:

Hakkotev tefillin bichtav yado o shellekachan min hammumche o mishshear adam uvedakan vehecheziran leoran leolam eno tzarich levadkam paam acheret vaafillu leachar kamma shanim. kol zeman shechippuyan shalem hare hen bechezkatan. veen choshshin lahen shemma nimchaka ot mittochan o shennikkeva. hillel hazzaken haya omer ellu mishshel avi ima:

Shemone halachot yesh bemaase hattefillin kullan halacha lemoshe missinay. ulefichach kullan meakkevot veim shinna beachat mehen pasal. veellu hem. sheyyihyu merubbaot. vechen tefiratan beribbua. vaalachsonan beribbua ad sheyyihye lahen arba zaviyyot shavot. vesheyyihye baor shel rosh tzurat shin miyyamin umissemol. vesheyyichroch happarashiyyot bematlit. vesheyyichroch otan besear meal hammatlit. veachar kach machnisan bevattehen. vesheyyihyu tofrin otan begidin. vesheosin lahen maboret meor hachippuy shettikkanes bah hartzua ad shettehe overet veholechet betoch tovar shellah. vesheyyihyu hartzuot shechorot. vesheyyihye hakkesher shellahen kesher yadua ketzurat dalet:

Ketzad osim tefillin shel rosh. lokchin etz merubba arko kerachbo uchegavho. veim haya gavho yoter al rachbo o pachot mimmennu en bechach kelum. veen makpidin ella al arko sheyyehe kerachbo. vechofrin bo shelosha charitzin kede sheyyease lo arba rashim kegon ze:
