velokchin or umartivin oto bemayim umesimin bo et haetz umachnisin et haor ben kol charitz vecharitz umechammeshim oto vehu ratov mikkan umikkan ad sheosin bo demut shin sheyyesh lah shelosha rashin miyyamin hammeniach tefillin udemut shin sheyyesh lah arbaa rashim missemol hammeniach:

Umannichin et haor al haetz ad sheyyivash. veachar kach choletz haor meal gabbe haimmum shel etz venimtza haor sheyyesh bo arbaa battim penuyin. umachnisin parasha bechol bayit uvayit. umachzirin miktzat haor millematta vetofrin oto mearba pinnotav. umannichin min haor shellematta makom shettikkanes bo hartzua kemo tovar vehu hannikra maboret:

Vechetzad osin tefillin shel yad. lokchin etz merubba arko kerachbo veyihye gavho keetzba o yater al ze meat o pachot meat umechappin oto beor ratov umannichin et haor al haimmum ad sheyyivash vecholetz et haor umanniach et arba happarashiyyot bimkom haetz umachazir miktzat haor millematta vetofro mearba pinnotav. umannichin min haor tovar mekom hartzuot:

Ketzad siddur happarashiyyot bitfilla shel rosh. machnis parasha acharona shehi (Devarim 11 13) "vehaya im shamoa" bevayit rishon shehu al yemin hammeniach. u (Devarim 6 4) "shema" semucha lah. (Shemot 13 11) "vehaya chi yeviacha" bevayit shelishi semucha lishma. v(Shemot 13 2) "kaddesh li" bevayit revii shehu lismol hammeniach tefillin kede sheyyehe hakkore shellefanav keneged pene hammeniach kore al hasseder hazze kegon ze: veim hechelif siddur ze pesulot:

Tefilla shel yad kotvam bearbaa dappin beor echad aroch kesefer tora al sidduran battora kegon ze

im ketavan al arba orot vehichnisan bevayit echad yatza veeno tzarich ledabbekam:
Keshehu golel happarashiyyot ben shel rosh ben shel yad golel otan missofan litchillatan ad shettimtza keshettiftach happarasha tikra kol parasha ufarasha mittechillatah ad sofah:

Ucheshemmachnisin et happarashiyyot babbattim shellahem korchin otan bematlit veal hammatlit sear veachar kach machnisin otan bevattehen. vesear ze tzarich lihyot sear behema o shel chayya tehora vaafillu minnevelot uterefot shellahen. uchevar nahagu kol haam (levarchan) [lecharchan] bisar zenav haagalim:

Keshettofrin et hattefillin en tofrin ella begidin shel behema o shel chayya tehora vaafillu minnevelot uterefot shellahen. lokchin haggidin sheyyesh baakev habbehema o hachayya tehorim vehem levanim. veim hem kashim merakkechin otan baavanim vechayyotze bahen ad sheyyeasu kefishtan vetovin otan veshozrin otan uvahen tofrin hattefillin viriot sefer tora:

Keshettofrin hattefillin tofrin otan beribbua. vahalacha rovachat sheyyihyu bechol tzad shalosh tefirot ad sheyyihyu hakkol shetem esre tefirot ben shel yad ben shel rosh. veim asa hattefirot eser o arba esre ose. vechol hattefirot yihye hachut shellahen sovev mishshete ruchot:

Vetzarich sheyyaggia hecharitz shel tefillin shel rosh ad mekom hattefer. veim haya hecharitz nikkar kede sheyyihyu arbaa rashin nirin lakkol veaf al pi sheen hecharitz maggia limkom hattefer kesherot. veim en charitz nikkar pesulot. vetzarich lehaavir betoch kol charitz vecharitz al gabbe haor chut o meshicha lehavedil ben bayit levayit. uminhag pashut lehaavir gid miggide hattefira bechol charitz vecharitz mishshelashtan:

Vechetzad osin hartzuot. lokchin retzua shel or rechava keorech hasseora. veim hayta rechava mizzo hashshiur keshera. veorech retzua shel rosh kede shettakkif et harosh veyikshor mimmenna hakkesher vetimtach shete hartzuot mikkan umikkan ad sheyyaggiu lattabbur o lemala mimmennu meat. veorech retzua shel yad kede shettakkif et hazzeroa veyikshor mimmenna hakkesher vetimmatach retzua achat al etzba emtzait veyichroch mimmenna al etzbao shalosh kerichot veyikshor. veim hayu hartzuot arukkot yater al shiurim haellu kesherot:

Umachnis retzua shel rosh battovar shellah. umakkif bemiddat rosho vekosher kesher merubba kemin dalet. vekesher ze tzarich kol talmid chacham lelamdo vei efshar lehodia tzurato bichtav ella biriyyat haayin. vechen beshel yad kosher kesher kemin yod. vetihye hartzua shel yad ola veyoredet betoch hakkesher kede sheyyarchiv vikatztzer beet sheyyirtze likshor al yado:

Hartzuot shel tefillin ben shel rosh ben shel yad penehem hachitzonim shechorim vezo halacha lemoshe missinay. aval achore hartzuot hoil umibbifnim hen im hayu yerukkot o levanot kesherot. adummot lo yaase shemma tehafech hartzua ugenay hu lo. velo yihye achore hartzua leolam ella keen hakketzitza im yerukka yerukkin veim levana levanim. venoy hu lattefillin sheyyihyu kullan shechorot hakketzitza vehartzua kullah:

Haor shemmechappin bo hattefillin vesheosin mimmennu hartzuot hu or shel behema o chayya o of hattehorim vaafillu nevelot uterefot shellahen. veim asa meor temeim o shechippa tefillin bezahav pesulot. veor hartzua tzarich ibbud lishmah. aval beor shemmechappin bo eno tzarich ibbud kelal afillu asahu matztza kasher. umekomot harebe nahagu laasot otan beor matztza:

En osin hattefillin ella yisrael sheasiyyatan kichtivatan mippene hashshin sheosin baor kemo sheamarnu. lefichach im chippan hakkuti o tefaran pesulot vehu haddin lechol happasul lechatvan shello yaase otan:

Tefilla shel rosh en osin otah shel yad veshel yad osin otah shel rosh lefi sheen moridin mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla. vechen retzua shel tefilla shel rosh en osin otah litfilla shel yad. bamme devarim amurim keshellevashan. aval tefillin shel rosh shello levashan adam meolam im ratza lehachaziran leyad muttar. vechetzad osin. tole aleha or ad shettease achat vekoshrah al yado:

Tefillin shennifseku hattefirot shellahen im hayu shete hattefirot zo betzad zo o shennifseku shalosh tefirot afillu zo shello keneged zo hare ellu pesulot. bamme devarim amurim bishanot aval bachadashot kol zeman sheppene tavlan kayyamot kesherot. veellu hen hachadashot kol sheochazin miktzat haor shennikra tifro vetolin bo hattefillin vehu chazak veeno nichrat hare ellu chadashot. veim en rauy litlot bo ella hu nifsak hare ellu yeshanot:

Retzua shennifseka en koshrin otah veen tofrin otah ella motziah vegonzah veosin acheret. veshiyyure hartzua pesulin ad sheyyehe arkah verachbah kashshiur o yater alav. uleolam yizzaher lihyot pene hartzua lemala beet shekkosher otan al yado veal rosho:

Hechan menichin tefillin shel rosh. menichin otan al hakkadkod shehu sof hassear shekkeneged happanim vehu hammakom shemmocho shel tinok rofes bo. vetzarich lechavven otam baemtza kede sheyyihyu ben haenayim. veyihye hakkesher begova haoref shehu sof haggulgolet:

Veshel yad kosher otah al semolo al hakkibboret vehu habbasar hattofeach shebbammarpek shebben perek hakkatef uven perek hazzeroa shennimtza keshehu medabbek marpeko litzlaav tihye tefilla keneged libbo venimtza mekayyem <small>(Devarim 6 6)</small> "vehayu haddevarim haelle" <small>(Devarim 6 6)</small> "al levavecha":

Hammeniach tefilla shel yad al pas yado o shel rosh al mitzcho hare ze derech tzedokim. haose tefillato agulla keegoz en bah mitzva kelal. itter meniach tefillin bimino shehu semol shello. veim haya sholet bishte yadav meniach otah bismolo shehu semol kol adam. umekom keshirat hattefillin umekom hanachatan mippi hashshemua lemadum:

Tefilla shel rosh enah meakkevet shel yad veshel yad enah meakkevet shel rosh mippene shehen shete mitzvot zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah. vechetzad mevarchin. al shel rosh mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al mitzvat tefillin. veal shel yad mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehanniach tefillin:

Bamme devarim amurim kesheheniach achat mehen aval im heniach shetehen mevarech beracha achat vehi lehanniach tefillin. vekosher shel yad veachar kach meniach shel rosh. ucheshehu choletz choletz shel rosh veachar kach choletz shel yad:

Mi shebberech lehanniach tefillin vekashar tefillin shel yad asur lo lesapper vaafillu lehashiv shalom lerabbo ad sheyyaniach shel rosh. veim sach hare zo avera vetzarich levarech beracha sheniyya al mitzvat tefillin veachar kach meniach shel rosh:

Tefillin kol zeman shemmenichan mevarech alehen vaafillu choletz velovesh kamma peamim beyom. vechol hammitzvot kullan mevarech alehem kodem laasiyyatan. lefichach tzarich levarech al hattefilla shel yad achar hanacha al hakkibboret kodem keshiratan. shekkeshiratan zo hi asiyyatan:

Keshecholetz adam tefillav lehatzenian bichli lo yanniach shel yad millematta veshel rosh millemala mippene shebbeshaa shehu rotze lelavshan yifga beshel rosh techilla venimtza shemmannichah umotzi shel yad lefi sheen lovshin shel rosh kodem shel yad. veasur laadam lehanniach mitzva velaavor mimmenna lemitzva acheret ella mitzva shettavo leyado shel adam battechilla bah hu mitassek. lefichach tzarich lehanniach shel yad lemala kede sheyyifga bah techilla veyilbash al hasseder:

Keli shehechino lehanniach bo tefillin vehinnicham bo nitkaddesh veasur lehishtammesh bo bedivre chol. hechino velo hinniach bo o shehinniach bo aray velo hechino lo nitkaddesh vahare hu chol kemo shehaya. veasur litlot et hattefillin ben bartzua ben battefilla atzmah aval tole hu et hakkis shehattefillin munnachin bo:

Zeman hanachat hattefillin bayyom velo ballayla shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "miyyamim yamima". <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "chukka" zo hi mitzvat tefillin. vechen shabbatot veyamim tovim enan zeman tefillin shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 16)</small> "vehaya leot" veshabbatot veyamim tovim hen atzman ot. umeematay zeman hanachatan mishsheyyire et chavero berichuk arba ammot veyakkirehu, ad shettishka hachamma:

Mi sheheniach tefillin kodem shettishka hachamma vechashcha alav afillu hen alav kol hallayla muttar. veen morin davar ze larabbim ella melammedin et hakkol shello yanichu tefillin alehen ballayla ella yachletzu otan mishshettishka hachamma. vechol hammeniach tefillin lechattechilla achar shettishka hachamma over belav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "veshamarta et hachukka hazzot" vegomer <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "miyyamim yamima":

Haya ba badderech utefillin berosho veshaka alav hachamma vekadash hayyom manniach yado alehen ad shehu maggia leveto vecholetz. haya yoshev bevet hammidrash utefillin berosho vekadash alav hayyom manniach yado alehen ad shemmaggia leveto vecholetz. veim yesh bayit samuch lachoma shemmishtammerin bo mannichan sham. veim lo chalatz tefillav mishsheshshaka hachamma mippene shello haya lo makom leshamran venimtzau alav kede leshamran muttar:

Kol happatur mikkeriat shema patur mittefillin. katan sheyyodea lishmor tefillav aviv lokeach lo tefillin kede lechannecho bemitzvot. chole meayim vechol mi shello yachol lishmor et nekavav ella betzaar patur min hattefillin. vechol hattemeim kullan chayyavin bitfillin kithorim. mitztaer umi sheen dato meyushshevet unechona alav patur min hattefillin shehammeniach tefillin asur lo lehassiach dato mehen. kohanim bishat haavoda vehaleviyyim beshaa sheomrim hashshir al hadduchan veyisrael beshaa sheomdim bammikdash peturin min hattefilla umin hattefillin:

Chayyav adam lemashmesh bitfillav kol zeman shehem alav shello yassiach dato mehem afillu rega echad. shekkedushshatan gedola mikkedushshat hatztzitz. shehatztzitz en bo ella shem echad veellu yesh bahem echad veesrim shem shel yod hei beshel rosh uchemotan beshel yad:

Tefillin tzerichin guf naki sheyyizzaher shello tetze mimmennu ruach millematta kol zeman shehem alav. lefichach asur lishan bahem lo shenat keva velo shenat aray ella im hinniach alehen sudar velo hayta immo ishsha yashen bahem shenat aray. vketzad hu ose. manniach rosho ben birkav vehu yoshev veyashen:

Hayu tefillav keruchin beyado muttar lishon bahem afillu shenat keva. veeno ochel bahem ella achilat aray. aval im nichnas lisuddat keva choltzan umannichan al shulchano ad sheyyittol yadav veachar kach yenichem vivarech al mezono vehu lavush bahen:

Haya lavush tefillin vehutzrach levet hakkisse lo yanniach hattefillin bachorin hassemuchin lirshut harabbim veyikkanes shemma yittelum ovre derachim. ketzad yaase. afillu hutzrach lehashetin mayim choletz tefillav berichuk arba ammot vegollan bevigdo kemin sefer tora veochazan bimino keneged libbo. veyizzaher kede shello tehe retzua yotzet mittachat yado tefach. venichnas veose tzerachav. uchesheyyetze marchik arba ammot mibbet hakkisse velovshan:

Bamme devarim amurim bevet hakkisse hakkavua sheen nitzotzot nittazot alav. aval bet hakkisse aray lo yikkanes bahen keshehem gelulim ella choletz otan venotnan lachavero leshamran. veen me raglayim kalin afillu bevet hakkisse kavua ella bishiva. veim haya afar tachuach afillu baamida. haya bemakom kashe yaamod bimkom midron kede shello yinnatzu nitzotzot alav:

Haya lavush bitfillin vehutzrach levet hakkisse leet erev velo nishar min hayyom kede lelavshan achar sheyyetze lo yikkanes bahem gelulim bevigdo vaafillu lehashetin mayim bevet hakkisse kavua. ella ketzad yaase. choltzan umannichan bechelyan im haya bo tefach o bichli sheeno kelyan af al pi sheen bo tefach veochez hakkeli beyado venichnas. vechen im hutzrach ballayla mannichan bichli veochez hakkeli beyado venichnas:

Shachach venichnas levet hakkisse vehu lavush tefillin meniach yado alehen ad sheyyigmor ammud rishon veyotze vecholetz. achar kach nichnas veose tzerachav. sheim yafsik beammud rishon ben bigdolim ben biktannim yavo lide cholaim sheyyesh bahen sakkana gedola:
Shachach veshimmesh mittato bitfillin hare ze lo yochaz lo bartzua velo bakketzitza ad sheyyittol yadav veyittelem mippene shehayyadayim askaniyyot:

Hannichnas levet hammerchatz makom shebbene adam omdin levushin muttar lehanniach tefillin. umakom shebbene adam omdin sham miktzatan arumim umiktzatan levushin eno choletz tefillav veeno meniach sham tefillin lechattechilla. umakom shebbene adam omdim arumim choletz tefillav veen tzarich lomar sheeno meniach:

Lo yehallech adam bevet hakkevarot utefillin berosho. vaafillu betoch arba ammot shel met o betoch arba ammot shel kever tzarich lachalotz tefillav ad sheyyarchik arba ammot. velo yilbash adam tefillin ad sheyyechasse ervato veyilbash begadav. hannose massooy al rosho choletz tefillav shel rosh ad sheyyasir hammassooy mealav vaafillu mitpachat asur lehanniach al harosh sheyyesh bo tefillin. aval tzonef hu mitznafto al tefillav:

Bayit sheyyesh bo tefillin o sefer tora asur leshammesh bo mittato ad sheyyotziem o yannichem bichli veyanniach hakkeli bichli acher sheeno kelyan. aval im haya hakkeli hashsheni mezumman lahem afillu asara kelim kichli echad hen chashuvin. veim hinnichan keli betoch keli muttar lehannichan tachat meraashotav ben kar lecheset shello keneged rosho kede leshamran vaafillu ishto immo bammitta:

Kedushshat tefillin kedushshatan gedola hi. shekkol zeman shehattefillin berosho shel adam veal zeroo hu anav vire shamayim veeno nimshach bischok uvesicha betela veeno mehareher machashavot raot ella mefanne libbo bedivre haemet vehatztzedek. lefichach tzarich adam lehishtaddel lihyotan alav kol hayyom shemmitzvatan kach hi. amru alav al rav talmido shel rabbenu hakkadosh shekkol yamav lo rauhu shehalach arba ammot belo tora o belo tzitzit o belo tefillin:

Af al pi shemmitzvatan lelavshan kol hayyom, bishat tefilla yoter min hakkol. amru chachamim kol hakkore keriat shema belo tefillin keillu meid edut sheker beatzmo. vechol sheeno meniach tefillin over bishmona ase shehare bearba parashiyyot tzivva al tefillin shel rosh veal tefillin shel yad. vechol haragil bitfillin maarich yamim shenneemar <small>(Yeshayahu 38 16)</small> "Adonai alehem yichyu":

Ketzad kotvin et hammezuza. kotvin shete parashiyyot <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" al daf echad biria achat veose lah revach millematta verevach millemala kemo chatzi tzipporen. veim ketavah bishnayim o bishlosha dappin keshera. uvilvad shello yaasenna kezanav o kemo iggul o kekubba veim asa keachat meelle pesula. ketavah shello al hasseder kegon shehikdim parasha lefarasha pesula. ketavah bishne orot af al pi shettefaran pesula. sefer tora shebbala utefillin shebbalu en osin mehen mezuza. velo min haggilyonim shel sefer tora en kotvin alav mezuza lefi sheen moridin mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla:

Umitzva laasot revach shebben parashat <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" li <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" parasha setuma. veim asa otah petucha keshera lefi sheenah semucha lah min hattora. vetzarich lehizzaher betagin shebbah. veellu hen hattagin sheosin bammezuza:

Parasha rishona yesh bah sheva otiyyot al kol ot mehen shelosha zayinnin. veellu hen. shin ayin shel <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" venun d<small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "nafshecha" utere zayinnin shel mezuzot utere tetin shel <small>(Devarim 6 8)</small> "totafot". ufarasha sheniyya yesh bah shesh otiyyot al kol ot mehen shelosha zayinnin. veellu hen. gimel shel <small>(Devarim 11 14)</small> "deganecha" utere zayinnin shel <small>(Devarim 6 9)</small> "mezuzot" utere tetin shel totafot vetzaddik shel <small>(Devarim 11 21)</small> "haaretz". veim lo asa tagin o shehosif bahen o gara mehen lo pasal. veim ketavah shello besirtut o shello dikdek bemale vechaser o shehosif mibbifnim afillu ot achat hare zo pesula:

Minhag pashut shekkotvim al hammezuza mibbachutz keneged harevach shebben parasha lefarasha shadday veen baze hefsed lefi shehu mibbachutz. aval ellu shekkotvin mibbifnim shemot hammalachim o shemot kedoshim o pasuk o chotamot hare hen bichlal mi sheen lahem chelek laolam habba. sheellu hattippeshim lo day lahem shebbittelu hammitzva ella sheasu mitzva gedola shehi yichud hashshem shel hakkadosh baruch hu veahavato vaavodato keillu hu kamea shel hanayat atzman kemo sheala al libbam hassachol shezzehu davar hamehanne behavele haolam:

Umitzva lichtov <small>(Devarim 11 21)</small> "al haaretz" beshita acharona ben berosh ben (beemtza) hashshita. venahagu kol hassofrim lichtov otah bishtayim veesrim shitot veal haaretz berosh shita acharona. veellu hen haotiyyot shebberosh kol shita veshita al hasseder. shema. Adonai. haddevarim. levanecha. uveshachbecha. ben. vehaya. metzavve. bechol. yore. esev. pen. vehishtachavitem. hashshamayim. vaavadtem. vesamtem. otam. otam. badderech. uvisharecha. asher. al haaretz:

Keshekkoflin otah gollin otah missof hashshita litchillatah ad shettimtza kesheyyiftach hakkore likrot yikra merosh hashshita lesofah. veachar sheggollah mannichah bishfoferet shel kane o shel etz o shel kol davar umechabber otah el mezuzat happetach bemasmer o chofer bimzuzat happetach umachnis bah hammezuza:

Vekodem sheyyikbaenna bimzuzat happetach mevarech techilla. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu likboa mezuza. veeno mevarech bishat ketivatah shekkeviatah zo hi hammitzva:

Telaah bemakkel pesula sheen zo kevua. hinnichah achare haddelet lo asa kelum. chafar bimzuzat happetach vehichnis hammezuza kemo neger vehi kivriach hakkerashim battabbaot pesula. heemik lah tefach pesula. chatach kane vehichnis bo mezuza veachar kach chibber hakkane el kanim acherim veheemid min hakkol mezuzat happetach pesula mippene shekkadma keviat hammezuza laasiyyat mezuzat happetach:
Mezuzat hayyachid nivdeket paamayim beshavua. umezuzat rabbim paamayim beyovel. shemma nikrea mimmenna ot achat o nimchaka mippene shehi kevua bakketalim markevet:

Hakkol chayyavin bimzuza afillu nashim vaavadim. umechannechim et hakketannim laasot mezuza levattehem. hassocher bayit bechutza laaretz vehaddar befundak beeretz yisrael patur min hammezuza sheloshim yom. aval hassocher bayit beeretz yisrael chayyav bimzuza miyyad:

Hammaskir bayit lachavero al hassocher lehavi mezuza velikboa otah afillu haya noten sachar al keviatah. mippene shehammezuza chovat haddar hi veenah chovat habbayit. ucheshehu yotze lo yittelenna beyado veyetze. veim haya habbayit shel kuti hare ze notlah kesheyyetze:

Asara tenain yesh babbayit veachar kach yitchayyev haddar bo laasot lo mezuza. veim chaser tenay echad mehen patur min hammezuza. veellu hen. sheyyihye bo arba ammot al arba ammot o yater. veshettihyena lo shete mezuzot. veyihye lo mashkof. vetihye lo tikra. veyihyu lo delatot. veyihye hashshaar gavoah asara tefachim o yoter. veyihye habbayit chol. veyihye asuy ledirat adam. veasuy ledirat kavod. veasuy ledirat keva:

Bayit sheen lo arba ammot al arba ammot patur min hammezuza. veim yesh bo kede lerabbea arba ammot al arba ammot beshave af al pi shehu agol o baal chamesh zaviyyot veen tzarich lomar sheim haya arko yater al rachbo hoil veyesh bo lerabbea arba ammot al arba ammot chayyav bimzuza:

Achsadra vehu hammakom sheyyesh lo shelosha ketalim vetikra af al pi sheyyesh lah shene patztzimin beruach reviit petura min hammezuza. mippene shehappatztzimin lehaamid hattikra hem asuyim velo mishshum mezuzot naasu. vechen hattikra sheen lah ketalim ella omedet al ammudim mikkan umikkan af al pi shehi ketavnit bayit petura lefi sheen lah mezuzot. sheellu haammudim lehaamid hattikra hen asuyin:

Bayit sheyyesh lo mezuza mikkan umikkan vechippa kemin keshet al shete hammezuzot bimkom hammashkof. im yesh begova hammezuzot asara tefachim o yater chayyav bimzuza. veim en bahen asara tefachim peturin mippene sheen lo mashkof:

Bayit sheen lo tikra patur min hammezuza. haya miktzato mekore umiktzato eno mekore yerae li sheim haya hakkeruy keneged happetach shehu chayyav bimzuza umaamidin haddelatot veachar kach kovin et hammezuza:

Har habbayit halleshachot vehaazarot uvatte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot sheen bahen bet dira peturin lefi shehen kodesh. bet hakkeneset shel kefarim shehaorchin darin bo chayyav bimzuza. vechen bet hakkeneset shel kerakkin im haya bo bet dira chayyav. kol hashshearim shehayu bammikdash lo haya lahem mezuzot chutz mishshaar nikkanor veshellefanim mimmennu. veshel lishkat parhedrin mippene shehallishka hazzot hayta bet dira lechohen gadol beshivat yeme hahafrasha:

Bet hatteven bet habbakar bet haetzim bet otzarot peturin min hammezuza, shenneemar betecha, betcha hameyuchad lecha, perat leellu vechayyotze bahen. lefichach refet habbakar shehannashim yoshvot bah umitikashshitot bah chayyavot bimizuza shehare yesh bah yichud ledirat adam. bet shaar achsadra umirpeset vehagginna vehaddir peturin min hammezuza mippene sheenam asuyin ledira. im hayu battim hachayyavin bimzuza petuchin limkomot ellu chayyavin bimzuza:

Lefichach echad shaare chatzerot veechad shaare mevoot veechad shaare medinot vaayarot hakkol chayyavim bimzuza shehare habbattim hachayyavin bimzuza petuchin letochan. afillu asara battim ze patuach leze veze patuach leze hoil vehappenimi chayyav bimzuza kullan chayyavin. umippene ze amru shaar happatuach min hagginna lechatzer chayyav bimzuza:

Bet hakkisse uvet hammerchatz uvet hattevila uvet habburseki vechayyotze bahem peturin min hammezuza lefi sheenan asuyin ledirat kavod. sukkat chag bechag uvayit shebbassefina peturin min hammezuza lefi sheenan asuyin ledirat keva. shete sukkot shel yotzrim zo lefanim mizzo hachitzona petura min hammezuza lefi sheenah kevua. hachanuyyot shebbashshevakim peturin mippene sheenan kevuim ledira:

Bayit sheyyesh lo petachim harebe af al pi sheeno ragil latzet velavo ella beachat mehen chayyav laasot mezuza bechol petach ufetach. petach katan shebben bayit laaliyya chayyav bimzuza. cheder shebbabbayit afillu cheder becheder chayyav laasot mezuza al shaar hacheder happenimi veal shaar hacheder hachitzon veal shaar habbayit shekkullan asuyin ledira ukevuin:

Petach shebben bet hammidrash o ben bet hakkeneset uveto im ragil latzet velavo beoto happetach chayyav bimzuza. petach shebben shene battim holchin achar hatztzir shel delet, makom shehatztzir nire immo sham kovim et hammezuza:

Vehechan kovim et hammezuza. betoch chalal shel patach battefach hassamuch lachutz bitchillat shelish haelyon shel gova hashshaar. veim kevaah lemala mizze keshera. vehu sheyyarchikenna min hammashkof tefach. vetzarich lekavah al yemin hannichnas labbayit veim kevaah missemol pesula. uvayit shel shuttafin chayyav bimzuza:

Chayyav adam lehizzaher bimzuza mippene shehi chovat hakkol tamid. vechol zeman sheyyikkanes veyetze yifga beyichud hashshem shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu veyizkor ahavato veyeor mishshenato veshigyotav behavele hazzeman. veyeda sheen davar haomed leolam uleolme olamim ella yediat tzur haolam. umiyyad hu chozer ledato veholech bedarche mesharim. amru chachamim harishonim kol mi sheyyesh lo tefillin berosho uvizroo vetzitzit bevigdo umezuza befitcho muchzak hu shello yecheta shehare yesh lo mazkirin rabbim vehen hem hammalachim shemmatztzilin oto millachato shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 34 8)</small> "chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem":

Mitzvat ase al kol ish veish miyyisrael lichtov sefer tora leatzmo shenneemar <small>(Devarim lo 19)</small> "veatta kitvu lachem et hashshira". kelomar kitvu lachem tora sheyyesh bah shira zo, lefi sheen kotvin et hattora parashiyyot parashiyyot. veaf al pi shehinnichu lo avotav sefer tora mitzva lichtov mishshello. vim ketavo beyado hare hu keillu kibbelah mehar sinay. veim eno yodea lichtov acherim kotvin lo. vechol hammaggiah sefer tora vaafillu ot achat hare hu keillu ketavo kullo:

Vehammelech mitzva alav lichtov sefer tora echad leatzmo leshem hammelech yater al sefer sheyyihye lo keshehu hedyot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 18)</small> "vehaya cheshivto al kisse mamlachto vechatav lo" vegomer. umaggihin oto missefer haazara al pi bet din haggadol. ze shehaya lo keshehu hedyot mannicho bevet genazav. veze shekkatav o shennichtav lo achar shemmalach yihye immo tamid. veim yatza lammilchama sefer tora immo. nichnas vehu immo. yoshev baddin vehu immo. mesev vehu kenegdo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 19)</small> "vehayta immo vekara vo kol yeme chayyav":

Lo haya lo sefer tora kodem sheyyimloch tzarich lichtov lo achar shemmalach shene sifre tora. echad mannicho bevet genazav. vehashsheni yihye immo tamid lo yasur meimmo ella ballayla bilvad uchesheyyikkanes levet hammerchatz o levet hakkisse o lishon al mittato:

Sefer tora shekketavo belo sirtut o shekketavo miktzato al haggevil umiktzato al hakkelaf pasul ella o kullo al haggevil o kullo al hakkelaf. vechetzad kotvin sefer tora. kotev ketiva metukkenet naa beyoter. yanniach ben kol teva veteva kimlo ot ketanna uven ot leot kimlo chut hassaara uven kol shita veshita kimlo shita. veorech kol shita veshita sheloshim otiyyot kede lichtov lemishpechotechem lemishpechotechem lemishpechotechem telata zimne. veze hu rochav kol daf vedaf. velo tehe shita ketzara mizze kede shello yehe haddaf keiggeret. velo arkah yoter al ze kede shello yehu enav meshottot bakketav:

Lo yemaet hakketav mippene harevach shebben parasha lefarasha. nizdammena lo teva bat chamesh otiyyot lo yichtov shetayim betoch haddaf veshalosh chutz laddaf ella kotev shalosh betoch haddaf ushetayim chutz laddaf. lo nishar min hashshita kede lichtov shalosh otiyyot meniach hammakom panuy umatchil mittechillat hashshita:

Nizdammena lo teva bat shete otiyyot lo yizrekenna ben haddappin ella yachazir litchillat hashshita. nizdammena lo betoch hashshita teva bat eser otiyyot o pachot o yater velo nishar min hashshita kede lichtov et kullah betoch haddaf im yachol lichtov chetzyah betoch haddaf vechetzyah chutz laddaf kotev veim lav meniach hammakom panuy umatchil mittechillat hashshita:

Umeniach ben kol chummash vechummash arba shitin penuyot belo ketiva lo pachot velo yater. veyatchil hachummash mittechillat shita chamishit. uchesheyyigmor et hattora tzarich sheyyigmor beemtza shita shebbesof haddaf. veim nishar min haddaf shitin harebe mekatztzer veole umatchil mittechillat hashshita shebbesof haddaf velo yigmor et hashshita. umitkavven ad sheyyihye <small>(Devarim 34 12)</small> "leene kol yisrael" beemtza shita shebbesof haddaf:

Veyizzaher baotiyyot haggedolot uvaotiyyot hakketannot uvaotiyyot hannekuddot veotiyyot hameshunnot kegon happein hallefufot vehaotiyyot haakummot kemo shehetiku hassofrim ish mippi ish. veyizzaher battagin uveminyanan. yesh ot sheyyesh aleha tag echad veyesh ot sheyyesh aleha shiva. vechol hattagin ketzurat zayinnin hen dakkin kechut hassaara:

Kol haddevarim haellu lo neemru ella lemitzva min hammuvchar. veim shinna betikkun ze o shello dikdek battagin vechatav kol haotiyyot ketikkunan o shekkerev et hashshitin o hirchikan o heerichan o kitztzeran hoil velo hidbikan ot beot velo chisser velo hotir velo hifsid tzurat ot achat velo shinna biftuchot usetumot hare ze sefer kasher:

Yesh devarim acherim shello neemru baggemara venahagu bahem hassofrim vekabbala hu beyadam ish mippi ish. vehen sheyyihyu minyan hashshitin shebbechol daf vedaf lo pachot mishshemona vearbaim velo yater al shishshim. vesheyyihye harevach shebben parasha lefarasha kemo tesha otiyyot asher asher asher. vesheyyihye berosh hashshitin lemala mishshirat hayyam <small>(Shemot 14 28 lo)</small> "habbaim. vayyabbasha. hashshem. met. bemitzrayim". chamesh shitin. ulematta min hashshira chamesh shitin techillat kol shita mehen kach. <small>(Shemot 15 20 23)</small> "vattikkach. achareha. sus. vayyetzu. vayyavou". veyihye berashe hashshitin lemala mishshirat haazinu. <small>(Devarim lo 29 30)</small> "veaida. achare. hadderech. beacharit. lehacheiso. kehal". shesh shitin. ulematta mimmenna chamesh shitin <small>(Devarim 32 44 47)</small> "vayyavo. ledabber. asher. hazzot. asher":

Vechol haddevarim haellu lemitzva min hammuvchar veim shinna lo pasal. aval im katav hammale chaser o hechaser male. o shekkatav milla shehi keri vechatav kikriatah kegon shekkatav yishkavenna bimkom yishgalenna uvattechorim bemakom uvaafolim vechayyotze bahen. o shekkatav parasha petucha setuma o setuma petucha. o shekkatav hashshira kishar hakketav. o shekkatav parasha achat keshira hare ze pasul veen bo kedushshat sefer tora kelal ella kechummash min hachummashin shemmelammedin bah hattinokot:

Sefer tora sheeno muggah asur lishhoto yoter al sheloshim yom ella yetakken o yigganez. sefer tora sheyyesh bo shalosh taeyyot bechol daf vedaf yetakken veim hayu arba yigganez. veim haya rov hassefer muggah vehashshear yesh bo arba tauyyot bechol daf venishar afillu daf echad meoto hashshear hameshubbash belo arba taeyyot hare ze yetakken:

Bamme devarim amurim shekkatav hammale chaser shennimtza tole haotiyyot sheshshachach bene hashshitot. aval im katav hechaser male afillu yesh bechol daf vedaf kamma taeyyot hare ze metakken mippene shehu gored veeno tole:

Muttar lichtov hattora kol chummash vechummash bifne atzmo veen bahen kedushshat sefer tora. aval lo yichtov megilla bifne atzmah sheyyihye bah parashiyyot. veen kotvin megilla letinok lehitlammed bah. veim dato lehashelim aleha chummash muttar. katav megilla shalosh shalosh tevot beshita achat muttar:

Muttar ledabbek tora neviim uchetuvim becherech echad. umanniach bechol chummash vechummash arba shitin. uven kol navi venavi shalosh shitin. uven kol navi venavi mishshenem asar shalosh shitin sheim ba lachtoch chotech. vesidduran shel neviim kach hu. yehoshua. shoftim. shemuel. melachim. yirmeya. yechezkel. yeshaya. tere asar. veseder hakketuvim. rut. utehillim. veiyyov. umishle. vekohelet. veshir hashshirim. vekinot. vedaniyyel. umegilla. veezra. vedivre hayyamim:

Kol kitve hakkodesh en kotvin otan ella besirtut afillu ketavan al hanneyar. umuttar lichtov shalosh tevot belo sirtut. yoter al ze asur. kerech ze sheyyesh bo tora neviim uchetuvim en kedushshato kikdushshat sefer tora ella kechummash min hachummashim. din hayyater kedin hechaser:

Parasha petucha yesh lah shete tzurot. im gamar beemtza hashshita meniach shear hashshita panuy umatchil happarasha shehi petucha mittechillat hashshita hashsheniyya. bamme devarim amurim shennishar min hashshita revach keshiur tesha otiyyot. aval im lo nishar ella meat o im gamar besof hashshita meniach shita sheniyya belo ketav umatchil happarasha happetucha mittechillat shita hashshelishit:

Parasha setuma yesh lah shalosh tzurot. im gamar beemtza hashshita manniach revach kashshiur umatchil lichtov besof hashshita teva achat mittechillat happarasha shehi setuma ad sheyyimmatze harevach baemtza. veim lo nishar min hashshita kede lehanniach harevach kashshiur velichtov besof hashshita teva achat yaniach hakkol panuy veyanniach meat revach merosh shita sheniyya veyatchil lichtov happarasha hassetuma meemtza shita sheniyya. veim gamar besof hashshita manniach mittechillat shita sheniyya keshiur harevach umatchil lichtov hassetuma meemtza hashshita. nimtzeta omer shepparasha petucha techillatah bitchillat hashshita leolam ufarasha setuma techillatah meemtza hashshita leolam:

Sefer sheeno muggah bemale vechaser efshar letakkeno ulehaggiho kemo shebbearnu. aval im taa berevach happarashiyyot vechatav petucha setuma o setuma petucha o shehifsik vehinniach panuy bemakom sheen bo parasha o shekkatav kedarko velo hifsik berevach bimkom happarasha o sheshshinna tzurat hashshirot hare ze pasul veen lo takkana ella lesallek et kol haddaf shettaa bo:

Ulefi sheraiti shibbush gadol bechol hassefarim sheraiti bidvarim ellu. vechen baale hammasoret shekkotvin umechabberin lehodia happetuchot vehassetumot nechlakim bidvarim ellu bemachaloket hassefarim shessomchin alehem. raiti lichtov henna kol parashiyyot hattora hassetumot vehappetuchot vetzurat hashshirot kede letakken alehem kol hassefarim ulehaggiah mehem. vesefer shessamachnu alav bidvarim ellu hu hassefer hayyadua bemitzrayim shehu kolel arbaa veesrim sefarim shehaya birushalayim mikkamma shanim lehaggiah mimmennu hassefarim vealav hayu hakkol somchin lefi shehiggiho ben asher vedikdek bo shanim harebe vehiggiho peamim rabbot kemo shehetiku vealav samachti besefer hattora shekkatavti kehilchato:

En osin sefer tora lo arko yoter al hekkefo velo hekkefo yater al arko. vechamma hu arko. bigvil shishsha tefachim shehem arba veesrim etzbaot berochav haggudal shel yad. uviklaf o pachot o yoter vehu sheyyehe arko kehekkefo. vechen im asa baggevil pachot mishshisha tefachim umiet et hakketav o yitter al shishsha vehirchiv bakketav ad sheyyihye arko kehekkefo hare ze kammitzva:

Shiur haggillayon millematta arba etzbaot ulemala shalosh etzbaot uven daf ledaf shete etzbaot. lefichach tzarich sheyyanniach bitchillat kol yeria uvesofah rochav etzba achat uchede tefira. shennimtza kesheyyitpor hayeria yihye ben kol daf vedaf bechol hassefer kullo shete etzbaot. veyanniach min haor bitchillat hassefer uvesofo kede liglol al haammud. vechol hashshiurin haellu lemitzva veim chisser o hotir lo pasal:

Ketzad yitkavven adam ad sheyyaase hassefer sheyyihye arko kehekkefo. matchil umerabbea haorot beshave veose rochav kol or mehen shishsha tefachim, ketzev echad lechol echad. veachar kach golel haorot beshave veose mehen kerech echad mehuddak yafe yafe umosif beorot umehaddek ad sheyyease hekkef hakkerech shishsha tefachim shehu rochav haor. umoded bechut shel shani sheyyakkifo al hakkerech:

Veachar kach yaase kane shave yihye arkah arbaim o chamishshim etzbaot vichallek etzba mehen bakkane lishnayim velishlosha ulearbaa chalakim kede sheyyeda bo shiur chatzi etzba urevia etzba vechayyotze beze hachelek. veyimdod kol or bekane zo ad sheyyeda kamma etzbaot yesh bechol or ad sheyyeda kamma etzbaot beorech kol hakkerech:

Veachar kach lokeach orot acherot shenayim o shelosha livdok bahen shiur hakketav vechotev bahen daf echad. vedavar yadua sheorech haddaf sheva esre etzbaot. lefi shehu manniach gillayon lemala shalosh ulematta arba. aval rochav haddaf hu lefi hakketav im dakka im ava. vechen minyan hashshitot shebbaddaf yavou lefi hakketav lefi shebben shita veshita kimlo shita:

Veachar shekkatav haddaf shebbodek bo lefi ma sheyyirtze yamod rochav haddaf beetzbeot hakkane veyosif al rochav haddaf shete etzbaot shebben daf vedaf veyachashov kamma dappin yavou bakkerech sheggalal meoto hakketav shebbadak bo veyeda cheshbon haddappin veyire kamma nichtav bedaf ze shebbadak bo min hattora kullah. umeshaer lefi hassefer shehu kotev mimmennu umechashshev im alta lo kol hattora lefi minyan haddappin mizze hakketav shekkotev bo becherech mutav. veim hotzi hacheshbon shehaddappin yoter min hattora yarchiv bakketav ad sheyyitmaet minyan haddappin veyivdok bedaf acher. veim hotzi hacheshbon shehattora yater min haddappin yemaet hakketav ad sheyyarbe beminyan haddappin veyivdok bedaf achar daf ad sheyyavo hacheshbon echad. meachar sheyyada rochav haddaf veshiur hakketav matchil beoto hakkerech:

Umechallek kol or veor dappin dappin besirtut kefi rochav haddaf shebbadak bo veala bacheshbon. uchesheyyishshaer baor shalosh etzbaot o arba yoter al haddaf haacharona shebbayria yanniach mimmennu rochav etzba uchede tefira veyakotz hashshear veal yachush, shebbaacharona yitvassef orot acherot al hakkerech sheggalal keneged kol hattosafot shekkotzetz mikkol or veor veeno tzarich lechashshev davar ze, shehakketav moshcho lefi minyan haddappin:
Vechen harotze laasot rochav hassefer yoter mishshishsha o pachot mishshishsha al hadderech hazze hu mechashshev veyetze arko kehekkefo belo pachot velo yoter. vehu shello yite bacheshbon:

Rochav haggudal haamur bechol hashshiurin haellu uvishar shiure tora kullah hu etzba habbenoni. uchevar dikdaknu beshiuro umetzanuhu rachav sheva seorot benoniyyot zo betzad zo bedochak vehen keorech shete seorot berevach. vechol tefach haamur bechol makom hu arba etzbaot mizzo. vechol amma shishsha tefachim:

Sefer tora shekkatavti ani rochav kol daf vedaf middappav arba etzbaot. veshirat hayyam veshirat haazinu rochav kol daf mishshetehen shesh etzbaot. uminyan hashshitin shebbechol daf vedaf achat vachamishshim. uminyan haddappin shel kol hassefer matayim veshishsha veesrim daf. veorech kol hassefer elef ushelosh meot veshishshim veshesh etzbaot bekeruv:

Ellu hashshesh etzbaot hayeterot becheshbon laggillayon shebbitchillat hassefer vesofo. vehaorot shekkatavnu bahem orot elim. uvizman shettirtze lichtov al pi hammiddot haellu o karov lahem meat hen chaser daf echad o shenayim o shelosha o yater daf o shenayim o shalosh lo tiga velo tehe tzarich lecheshbon ella miyyad yavo lecha arko kehekkefo:

En osin biria pachot mishshelosha dappin velo yater al shemona dappin. nizdammena lo yeria bat tisha dappin cholek otah arbaa lechan vachamishsha lechan. bamme devarim amurim bitchillat hassefer o beemtza aval besof hassefer afillu pasuk echad bedaf echad osim oto daf levaddo vetofrin oto im shear hayeriot:

Ucheshettofrin hayeriot en tofrin otan ella begidim shel behema o chayya tehora vaafillu minnevelot uterefot shellahem kederech shettofrin et hattefillin. vedavar ze halacha lemoshe missinay. lefichach im tefaran shello begidin o begide behema temea pasul ad sheyyattirah veyachazor veyitpor kahalacha:

Sefer tora kasher nohagin bo kedushsha yetera vechavod gadol. veasur laadam limkor sefer tora afillu en lo ma yochal. vaafillu hayu lo sefarim rabbim. vaafillu yashan likkach bo chadash. leolam en mochrin sefer tora ella lishne devarim. sheyyilmod tora bedamav o sheyyissa ishsha bedamav. vehu shello yihye lo davar acher limkor:
Sefer tora shebbala o shennifsal notnin oto bichli cheres vekovrin oto etzel talmide chachamim vezo hi genizato. mitpechot sefarim shebbalu osin otan tachrichin lemet mitzva vezo hi genizatan:

Tik shehuchan lesefer tora vehunnach bo vechen hammitpachot vehaaron vehammigdal shemmannichin bo sefer tora af al pi shehassefer betoch hattik vechen hakkisse shehuchan lehanniach alav sefer tora vehunnach alav sefer tora hakkol tashmishe kedushsha hen veasur lezarkan ella kesheyyivlu o kesheyyishshavru nignazin. aval habbimot sheomed alehen sheliach tzibbur veochez hassefer vehalluchot shekkotvin bahen letinok lehitlammed en bahen kedushsha. vechen rimmone kesef vezahav vechayyotze bahen sheosin lesefer tora lenoy tashmishe kedushsha hen veasur lehotzian lechol ella im ken machar otan liknot bidmehen sefer tora o chummash:

Umuttar lehanniach sefer tora al gabbe sefer tora veen tzarich lomar al gabbe chummashoym. umenichin hachummashin al gabbe neviim uchetuvim. aval en mannichin neviim uchetuvim al gabbe chummashim velo chummashim al gabbe sefer tora. vechol kitve hakkodesh afillu halachot veaggadot asur lezarkan. hakkemein sheyyesh bahem inyanim shel kitve hakkodesh en nichnasin bahen levet hakkisse ella im ken hayu mechuppot or:

Lo yochaz adam sefer tora bizroo veyikkanes bo levet hammerchatz o levet hakkisse o levet hakkevarot af al pi shehu karuch bemitpachot venatun betoch hattik shello. velo yikra bo ad sheyyarchik arba ammot min hammet (o mibbet hammerchatz) o mibbet hakkisse. velo yochaz et sefer tora keshehu arom. veasur leshev al mitta shessefer tora aleha:

Bayit sheyyesh bo sefer tora asur leshammesh mittato bo ad sheyyotziennu o ad sheyyannichennu bichli veyitten hakkeli bichli acher sheeno mezumman lo. aval im haya mezumman lo afillu asara kelim ze betoch ze kichli echad hem. o ad sheyyaase lo mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim im lo haya lo bayit acher. aval im yesh lo bayit acher asur leshammesh ad sheyyotziennu:

Kol hattemein vaafillu niddot vaafillu kuti muttar leechoz sefer tora velikrot bo. sheen divre tora mekabbelin tuma. vehu shello yihyu yadav metunnafot o meluchlachot betit ella yirchatzu yedehem veachar kach yiggeu bo:

Kol haroe sefer tora keshehu mehallech chayyav laamod mippanav. veyihyu hakkol omdim ad sheyyaamod ze shehu mehallech bo kesheyyaggiennu limkomo o ad sheyyitkasse meenehem veachar kach yihyu muttarin leshev:

Mitzva leyached lesefer tora makom ulechabbedo ulehaddero yoter midday. devarim shebbeluchot habberit hen hen shebbechol sefer vesefer. lo yarok adam keneged sefer tora velo yegalle ervato kenegdo velo yafshit raglav kenegdo velo yannichennu al rosho kemassooy velo yachazir achorav lesefer tora ella im ken haya gavoah mimmennu asara tefachim:

Haya mehallech mimmakom lemakom vesefer tora immo lo yanniach sefer tora betoch hassak veyannichennu al gabbe hachamor veyirkav alav. veim haya mitpached min haggannavim muttar. veim en sham pachad mannicho becheko keneged libbo vehu rochev al habbehema veholech. kol mi sheyyoshev lifne sefer tora yeshev bechoved rosh beema vafachad. shehu haed hanneeman lechol bae olam shenneemar (Devarim lo 26) "vehaya sham becha leed". vichabbedehu kefi kocho. amru chachamim harishonim kol hamechallel et hattora gufo mechullal al habberiyyot vechol hamechabbed et hattora gufo mechubbad al habberiyyot:
nigmeru hilchot sefer tora berachame shemayya
Mishneh Torah, Fringes 1: Anaf sheosin al kenaf habbeged mimmin habbeged hu hannikra tzitzit mippene shehu dome letzitzit shel rosh. shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 8 3)</small> "vayyikkacheni betzitzit rashi". veze heanaf hu hannikra lavan mippene sheen anu metzuvvin letzavo. veen lechute heanaf minyan min hattora:
Velokchin chut tzemer shennitzba keen harakia vechorchin oto al heanaf vechut ze hu hannikra techelet. veen leminyan hakkerichot shekkorech chut ze shiur min hattora:

Nimtzeu bemitzva zo shene tzavvim. sheyyaase al hakkanaf anaf yotze mimmenna. vesheyyichroch al heanaf chut techelet shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 38)</small> "veasu lahem tzitzit" <small>(Bamidbar 15 38)</small> "venatnu al tzitzit hakkanaf petil techelet":

Vehattechelet eno meakkev et hallavan vehallavan eno meakkev et hattechelet. ketzad. hare sheen lo techelet ose lavan levaddo. vechen im asa lavan utechelet venifsak hallavan venitmaet ad hakkanaf venishar hattechelet levaddo kasher:

Af al pi sheen echad mehen meakkev et chavero enan shete mitzvot ella mitzvat ase achat. amru chachamim harishonim <small>(Bamidbar 15 39)</small> "vehaya lachem letzitzit" melammed sheshshenehem mitzva achat. vearba tzitziyyot meakkevot zo et zo shearbatan mitzva achat. vehallovesh tallit sheyyesh bah lavan o techelet o shenehem keechad hare kiyyem mitzvat ase achat:

Ketzad osin et hatztzitzit. matchil mizzavit shel tallit shehi sof haarug umarchik mimmenna lo yoter al shalosh etzbaot lemala velo pachot mikkesher gudal umachnis sham arbaa chutin vechoflan baemtza. nimtzeu shemona chutim meshullashin teluyin min hakkeren. veorech hachutim hashshemona en pachot mearba etzbaot. veim hayu yoter al ken afillu amma o shetayim kesherin. vechol haetzbaot begudal. veyihye echad mishshemona hachutim chut techelet vehashshiva levanim:

Velokeach chut echad min hallavan vechorech bo kericha achat al shear hachutin betzad habbeged umannicho. velokeach chut hattechelet vechorech bo shete kerichot betzad kericha shel lavan vekosher. veellu hashshalosh kerichot hem hannikrain chulya. umarchik meat veose chulya sheniyya bechut shel techelet levaddo. umarchik meat veose chulya shelishit vechen ad chulya acharona shehu korech bah shete kerichot shel techelet. uchericha acharona shel lavan. mippene shehitchil belavan mesayyem bo shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. velamma yatchil belavan kede sheyyehe samuch lichnaf minah. veal derech ze hu ose bearba hakkenafot:

Kamma chulyot hu ose bechol kanaf. lo pachot mishsheva velo yoter mishshelosh esre. vezo hi mitzva min hammuvchar. veim lo karach aleha ella chulya achat keshera. veim karach hattechelet al rov hatztzitzit keshera. venoy hattechelet sheyyihyu kol hachulyot bishlish hachutin hameshulshalin ushene shelishehen anaf. vetzarich lefardo ad sheyyihye ketzitzit sear harosh:

Haose lavan belo techelet lokeach echad mishshemona hachutin vechorech oto al shear hachutin ad shelishan umanniach shene shelishitan anaf. uchericha zo im ratza lichroch otah chulyot chulyot keen shekkorech battechelet harshut beyado veze hu minhagenu. veim ratza lichroch belo minyan chulyot ose. kelalo shel davar yitkavven lihyot hakkaruch shelish veheanaf shene shelishim. veyesh mi sheeno medakdek bedavar ze belavan. veim karach hallavan al rov hachutin o shello karach ella chulya achat keshera:
Echad chute lavan veechad chute techelet im ratza laasot shezurin ose. afillu haya hachut kaful mishshemona chutin veshazur ad shennaase petil echad eno nechshav ella chut echad:

Chute hatztzitzit ben lavan ben techelet tzerichin teviyya leshem tzitzit. veen osin otan lo min hatztzemer hanneechaz bakkotzim keshehatztzon rovtzin benehem. velo min hannimin hannitlashin min habbehema. velo mishshiyyure sheti shehaoreg meshayyer besof habbeged. ella min haggizza shel tzemer o min happishtan. veen osin otan mitztzemer haggazul velo mishshel ir hanniddachat velo mishshel kadashim. veim asa pasul. hammishtachave livhema tzamrah pasul letzitzit. aval hammishtachave lefishtan hannatua hare ze kasher shehare nishtanna:

Tzitzit sheasa oto kuti pasul shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 38)</small> "dabber el bene yisrael" <small>(Bamidbar 15 38)</small> "veasu lahem tzitzit". aval im asa otah yisrael belo kavvana keshera. vetzitzit shennaasa min heasuy mikkodem pasul:

Ketzad. hevi kanaf sheyyesh bah tzitzit utefarah al habbeged afillu yesh beotah hakkanaf amma al amma pasul shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 38)</small> "veasu lahem tzitzit", lo min heasuy, shehare ze dome lemi shennaaset meeleha. umuttar lehattir tzitzit mibbeged ze velitlotam beveged acher ben lavan ben techelet:

Tala hachutin ben shete kenafayim mizzo lezo vekashar kanaf zo kehilchatah vechanaf zo kehilchatah veachar kach chatachan baemtza venifredu ze mizze pasul shehare beet shekkesharan hayu pesulin lefi sheshshete hakkenafayim meorot zo bazo bachutin shebbenehen uveshaa sheppesakan naasu shete tzitziyyot nimtza ose min heasuy:

Hittil tzitzit al hatztzitzit im nitkavven levattel et harishonot mattir harishona o chotchah ucheshera. veim nitkavven lehosif af al pi shechatach achat mishshetehen hare zo pesula. shehare keshehosif pasal et hakkol ucheshehittir o chatach hattosefet nimtza hashshear naasa min heasuy sheasiyyato harishona pesula hayta:
Vechen hammattil levaalat shalosh veachar kach hishlimah learba vehittil larviit kullah pesula shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 12)</small> "taase" velo min heasuy:
En koflin et hattallit lishnayim umattilin tzitzit al arba kenafeha keshehi kefula ella im ken tefarah kullah vaafillu meruach achat:

Nifsak hakkanaf sheyyesh bah tzitzit chutz leshalosh etzbaot tofrah bimkomah. betoch shalosh lo yitpor. nitmaata zavit shel beged shebben chute hatztzitzit uven sof haarug afillu lo nishar min haarug ella kol shehu kasher. vechen im nitmaatu chute hatztzitzit afillu lo nishtayyer mehem ella kede aniva kasher. veim nifsak hachut meikkaro afillu chut echad pesula:
Mishneh Torah, Fringes 2: Techelet haamura battora bechol makom hi hatztzemer hatztzavua kefatuch shebbakkachol. vezo hi demut harakia hanniret leen hashshemesh betohoro shel rakia. vehattechelet haamura batztzitzit tzarich shettihye tzeviatah tzevia yedua sheomedet beyafyah velo tishtanne. vechol shello nitzba beotah tzevia pasul letzitzit af al pi shehu keen harakia. kegon shetztzevao beistis o beshachor o bishar hammashchirin hare ze pasul letzitzit. rachel bat ez tzamrah pasul letzitzit:

Ketzad tzovin techelet shel tzitzit. lokchin hatztzemer veshorin oto besid veachar kach mechabbesin oto ad sheyyihye naki umartichim oto beahala vechayyotze bo kederech shehatztzabbain osin kede sheyyiklot et haayin. veachar kach meviin dam chillazon vehu dag sheddome eno leen hattechelet vedamo shachor kidyo. uveyam hammelach hu matzuy. venotnin et haddam leyora venotnin immo sammanin kemo hakkamonya vechayyotze bahen kederech shehatztzabbain osin umartichin oto venotnin bo hatztzemer ad sheyyease keen rakia. vezo hi hattechelet shel tzitzit:

Hattechelet shel tzitzit tzericha tzevia lishmah. veim tzevaah shello lishmah pesula. vehayyora sheyyesh bah hatztzeva im tzava bah meat tzemer levadko im hu yafe im lav nifsela hayyora kullah. ella ketzad yaase. lokeach hatztzeva min hayyora bichli katan umanniach bo tzemer shebbodek bo vesoref et shebbadak shehare nitzba livdika. veshofech hatztzeva shebbakkeli shebbadak bo shehare taamo ufesalo. vetzovea hattechelet bishar hatztzeva shello nifgam:

Hattechelet enah nilkachat ella min hammumche, choshshin shemma nitzbea shello lishmah. af al pi shennilkecha min hammumche im nivdeka venoda shennitzbea beechad mishshear tzivonin hammashchirim sheenan omdin pesula:

Ketzad bodkin otah ad sheyyodea im nitzbea kehilchatah im lav. lokchin teven verir shel shabbelul ume raglayim shennitchammetzu arbaim yom veshorin hattechelet bechullan meet leet. im amda beenah velo kahata keshera. veim kahata lokchin batzek shel seorin shemmeappeshin oto lemureyays venotnin et zo hattechelet shennishtannet betocho veofe habbatzek betannur umotziim hattechelet min happat veroin otah im kahata mimma shehayta pesula. veim hosif enah vehushchara yoter mimma shehayta kodem haafiyya keshera:

Chatzer shemmochrin bah techelet vehayu muchzakin bechashrut lokchin mimmenna setam veen tzarich bedika vahare hi bechezkatah ad shettechashed. hammafkid techelet etzel hakkuti hare zo pesula shemma hechelifah. veim hayta bichli vehaya chatum bishne chotamot chotam betoch chotam keshera. bechotam echad pesula:

Hammotze techelet bashshuk afillu matza chutin pesukin pesula. shezurin keshera. hallokeach tallit metzuyyetzet min hashshuk, miyyisrael hare hi bechezkatah, min haggoy hattaggar keshera, min hahedyot pesula:

Tallit shehi kullah adumma o yerukka o mishshear tzivonin ose chute lavan shellah keen tzivah. im yerukka yerukkin im adumma adummin. hayta kullah techelet ose lavan shellah mishshear tzivonin chutz min hashshachor mippene shehu nire kitchelet. vechorech al hakkol chut echad techelet kederech sheosin bishar tzitziyyot sheenan tzevuin:
Kashe onesh mi sheeno manniach lavan yoter meonesh shello hinniach techelet lefi shehallavan matzuy lakkol vehattechelet eno metzuya bechol makom velo bechol zeman mippene hatztzeva sheamarnu:
Mishneh Torah, Fringes 3: Kesut shechayyav adam laasot bah tzitzit min hattora hi kesut sheyyesh lah arba kenafayim o yoter al arba. vetihye middatah kede sheyyitkasse bah rosho verubbo shel katan hammithallech levaddo bashshuk veeno tzarich acher leshamro velelech immo. vetihye hakkesut shel tzemer o shel pishtan bilvad:

Aval tallit shel shear minin kegon bigde meshi uvigde tzemer gefen uvigde tzemer gemallim vetzemer arnavim venotza shel izzim vechayyotze bahen en chayyavin bemitzvat tzitzit ella middivre chachamim kede lehizzaher bemitzvat tzitzit. vehu shettihye merubbaat o yoter al arba veyihye shiurah kashshiur sheamarnu. shekkol habbegadim haamurim battora setam enam ella tzemer ufishtim bilvad:

<small>(Devarim 22 12)</small> "al arba kanfot kesutecha" baalat arba velo baalat shalosh. im ken baalat arba velo baalat chamesh. talmud lomar <small>(Devarim 22 12)</small> "asher techasse bah" afillu baalat chamesh o yoter al ze. velamma ani mechayyev baalat chamesh ufoter baalat shalosh ushetehen enan baale arba kenafot. mippene sheyyesh bichlal hechamesh arba. lefichach keshehu ose tzitzit levaalat chamesh o shesh eno ose ella learba kenafayim hameruchakot zo mizzo meotan hechamesh o hashshesh bilvad. shenneemar al arba kanfot kesutecha:

Kesut shel beged uchenafeha shel or chayyevet. hi shel or uchenafeha shel beged petura sheen holchin ella achar ikkar hakkesut. kesut shel shene shuttafin chayyevet shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 38)</small> "al kanfe vigdehem". lo neemar <small>(Devarim 22 12)</small> "kesutecha" ella lemaet sheula shehattallit hashsheula petura min hatztzitzit sheloshim yom mikkan veelach chayyevet:

Kesut shel tzemer osin lavan shellah chute tzemer. uchesut shel pishtan osin lavan shellah chute pishtan mimmenna. ushear begadim osin lavan shel kol min vamin mimmino kegon chute meshi lichsut meshi vechute notza lichsut notza. veim ratza laasot lavan lechol shear minim mitztzemer o mippishtim ose. mippene shehatztzemer vehappishtan potrin ben beminan ben shello beminan ushear minin beminan potrin shello beminan en potrin:

Uma hu laasot chute tzemer bichsut shel pishtan o chute pishtan bichsut shel tzemer af al pi shehu lavan levaddo belo techelet. bedin hu sheyyehe muttar shehashshaatnez muttar leinyan tzitzit. shehare hattechelet tzemer hu umattilin otah lefishtan. umippene ma en osin ken. mippene sheefshar laasot hallavan shellah mimminah. vechol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase im yachol atta lekayyem et shetehen hare mutav. veim lav yavo ase veyidche et lo taase. vechan efshar lekayyem et shetehen:

Kesut shel pishtan en mattilin bah techelet ella osin hallavan bilvad shel chute pishtan. lo mippene shehatztzitzit nidchet mippene hashshaatnez ella gezera middivrehem shemma yitkasse bah ballayla sheenah zeman chiyyuv tzitzit venimtza over al lo taase beet sheen sham mitzvat ase. shechovat hatztzitzit bayyom velo ballayla shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 39)</small> "ureitem oto", bishat reiyya. vesuma chayyav betzitzit, af al pi sheeno roe acherim roin oto:

Muttar laadam lilbosh tzitzit ballayla ben bechol ben beshabbat veaf al pi sheeno zemannah uvilvad shello yevarech. umeematay yevarech al hatztzitzit bashshachar. mishsheyyakkir ben techelet shebbah lallavan shebbah. vechetzad mevarech aleha. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehitattef betzitzit. vechol zeman shemmitattef bah bayyom mevarech aleha kodem sheyyitattef. veeno mevarech al hatztzitzit bishat asiyyatah mippene shessof hammitzva hu sheyyitattef bah:

Umuttar lehikkanes betzitzit levet hakkisse ulevet hammerchatz. nifseku lo chute lavan o techelet zorko baashpa mippene shehi mitzva sheen begufah kedushsha. veasur limkor tallit metzuyyetzet legoy ad sheyyattir tzitziyyoteha. lo mippene sheyyesh begufah kedushsha ella shemma yitattef bah veyitlavve immo yisrael vidamme shehu yisrael veyahargennu. nashim vaavadim uketannim peturin min hatztzitzit min hattora. umiddivre sofrim shekkol katan sheyyodea lehitattef chayyav betzitzit kede lechannecho bemitzvot. venashim vaavadim sheratzu lehitattef betzitzit mitattefim belo beracha. vechen shear mitzvot ase shehannashim peturot mehen im ratzu laasot otan belo beracha en memachin beyadan. tumtum veanderoginus chayyavin bechullan missafek lefichach en mevarchin ella osin belo beracha:

Heach chiyyuv mitzvat hatztzitzit. kol adam shechayyav laasot mitzva zo im yitkasse bichsut harauy letzitzit yattil lah tzitzit veachar kach yitkasse bah. veim nitkassa bah belo tzitzit hare bittel mitzvat ase. aval begadim haruyim letzitzit kol zeman shello yitkasse bahen adam ella mekuppalim umunnachim peturin min hatztzitzit sheenah chovat hattallit ella chovat haish sheyyesh lo tallit:

Af al pi sheen adam mechuyyav liknot lo tallit ulehitattef bah kede sheyyaase bah tzitzit en rauy leadam chasid sheyyiftor atzmo mimmitzva zo. ella leolam yishtaddel lihyot atuf bichsut hamechuyyevet batztzitzit kede sheyyekayyem mitzva zo. uvishat hattefilla tzarich lehizzaher beyoter. genay gadol hu letalmide chachamim sheyyitpallelu vehem enam atufim:

Leolam yehe adam zahir bemitzvat tzitzit shehare hakkatuv shekalah vetala bah kol hammitzvot kullan shenneemar (Bamidbar 15 39) "ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai":
salik hilchot tzitzit
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 1: Mitzvat ase min hattora levarech achar achilat mazon shenneemar <small>(Devarim 8 10)</small> "veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha". veeno chayyav min hattora ella im ken sava shenneemar veachalta vesavata uverachta. umiddivre sofrim achal afillu kezayit mevarech acharav:

Umiddivre sofrim levarech al kol maachol techilla veachar kach yehane mimmennu. vaafillu nitkavven leechol o lishtot kol shehu mevarech veachar kach yehane. vechen im heriach reach tov mevarech veachar kach yehane mimmennu. vechol hannehene belo beracha maal. vechen middivre sofrim levarech achar kol ma sheyyochal vechol ma sheyyishte. vehu sheyyishte reviit vehu sheyyochal kezayit. umatemet enah tzericha beracha lo lefaneha velo leachareha ad reviit:

Ucheshem shemmevarchin al hahanaya kach mevarchin al kol mitzva umitzva veachar kach yaase otah. uverachot rabbot tikkenu chachamim derech shevach vehodaya vederech bakkasha kede lizkor et habbore tamid af al pi shello nehena velo asa mitzva:
Nimtzeu kol habberachot kullan shelosha minim. birchot hanaya. uvirchot mitzvot. uvirchot hodaa shehen derech shevach vehodaya uvakkasha kede lizkor et habbore tamid uleyira mimmennu:

Venosach kol habberachot ezra uvet dino tikkenum. veen rauy leshannotam velo lehosif al achat mehem velo ligroa mimmenna. vechol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim babberachot eno ella toe. vechol beracha sheen bah hazekarat hashshem umalchut enah beracha ella im ken hayta semucha lachavertah:
Vechol habberachot kullan neemarin bechol lashon vehu sheyyomar keen shettikkenu chachamim. veim shinna et hammatbea hoil vehizkir azkara umalchut veinyan habberacha afillu bilshon chol yatza:
Kol habberachot kullan tzarich sheyyashmia leazno ma shehu omer veim lo hishmia leazno yatza ben shehotzi bisfatav ben shebberech belibbo:

Kol habberachot kullan lo yafsik ben habberacha uven haddavar shemmevarchin alav bidvarim acherim veim hifsik tzarich lachazor ulevarech sheniyya. veim hifsik bidvarim shehen meinyan devarim shemmevarchin alav eno tzarich levarech sheniyya. ketzad. kegon shebberech al happat vekodem sheyyochal amar haviu melach haviu tavshil tenu lifloni leechol tenu maachol labbehema vechayyotze baellu eno tzarich levarech shenit. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol habberachot kullam muttar letame levarech otan. ben shehaya tame tuma shehu yachol laalot mimmenna bo bayyom. ben tuma sheeno yachol laalot mimmenna bo bayyom. veasur lamvarech levarech keshehu arom ad sheyyechasse ervato. bamme devarim amurim beish aval beishsha yoshevet ufaneha tuchot bakkarka umevarechet:

Kol habberachot kullan af al pi shebberech veyatza yede chovato muttar lo levarech laacherim shello yatzu yede chovatan kede lehotzian. chutz mibbirkat hahanaya sheen bah mitzva sheeno mevarech laacherim ella im ken nehena immahen. aval birkat hahanaya sheyyesh bah mitzva kegon achilat matztza belele happesachim vekiddush hayyom hare ze mevarech laacherim veochlin veshotim af al pi sheeno ochel immahen:

Kol hashshomea beracha min habberachot mittechillatah vead sofah venitkavven latzet bah yede chovato yatza veaf al pi shello ana amen. vechol haone amen achar hamevarech hare ze kimvarech vehu sheyyihye hamevarech chayyav beotah beracha. haya hamevarech chayyav middivre sofrim vehaone chayyav min hattora lo yatza yede chovato ad sheyyaane o ad sheyyishma mimmi shehu chayyav bah min hattora kamohu:

Rabbim shennitvaadu leechol pat o lishtot yayin uverech echad mehen veanu kullam amen hare ellu muttarin leechol velishtot. aval im lo nitkavvenu leechol keechad ella ze ba meatzmo veze ba meatzmo af al pi shehen ochlin mikkikkar echad kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. bamme devarim amurim befat veyayin bilvad aval shear ochalim umashkin enan tzerichin hassibba ella im berech echad mehen veanu kullan amen hare ellu ochlim veshotin. veaf al pi shello nitkavvenu lehasev keechad:

Kol hashshomea echad miyyisrael mevarech beracha mikkol habberachot kullan af al pi shello shama habberacha kullah mittechillatah vead sofah veaf al pi sheeno chayyav beotah beracha chayyav laanot amen. veim haya hamevarech goy o eppikoros o kuti o tinok hammitlammed o shehaya gadol veshinna mimmatbea habberacha en onin acharehen amen:

Kol haone amen lo yaane lo amen chatufa velo amen ketufa velo amen ketzara velo arukka ella amen benonit. velo yagbiah kolo yoter min hamevarech. vechol mi shello shama et habberacha shehu chayyav bah lo yaane amen bichlal haonim:

Kol hamevarech beracha sheenah tzericha hare ze nose shem shamayim lashshav vahare hu kenishba lashshav veasur laanot acharav amen. hattinokot melammedin otan habberachot ketikkunan veaf al pi shehen mevarchin levattala bishat limmud hare ze muttar. veen onin acharehen amen. vehaone acharehen amen lo yatza yede chovato:

Kol haone amen achar birchotav hare ze megunne. vehaone achar beracha shehi sof berachot acharonot hare ze meshubbach. kegon achar bone yerushalayim bevirkat hammazon veachar beracha acharona shel keriat shema shel arvit. vechen besof kol beracha shehi sof berachot acharonot one bah amen achar atzmo:

Velamma yaane amen achar bone yerushalayim vahare achareha birkat hattov vehammetiv. mippene shebberacha zo bime chachme mishna tikkenuha ucheillu hi tosefet. aval sof ikkar habberachot shel birkat hammazon hi bone yerushalayim. velamma lo yaane amen achar ahavat olam mippene shehi sof berachot rishonot shel keriat shema, vechen kol kayyotze bah mibberachot shemmevarchin otan techilla laddavar, kegon berachot shemmevarchin lifne keriat megilla vehadelakat ner chanukka. lemaan lo yafsik beamen ben beracha uven haddavar shebberech alav:

Velamma lo yaane amen achar birkat happerot vechayyotze bah. mippene shehi beracha achat veen onin amen ella achar beracha acharona shekkadma otah beracha acheret o berachot kegon birchot hammelech uvirchot kohen gadol vechayyotze bahen, lehodia shekkevar hishlim kol birchotav ulefichach one amen:

Kol haochel davar haasur ben bezadon ben bishgaga eno mevarech alav lo battechilla velo bassof. ketzad. hare sheachal tevel shel divrehem o sheachal maaser rishon shello nittelu terumotav o maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu kehilchatan eno mevarech. veen tzarich lomar im achal nevelot uterefot o shata yen nesech vechayyotze bo:

Aval im achal demay af al pi sheeno rauy ella laaniyyim o maaser rishon shennittela terumato af al pi shello nittal mimmennu cheshbon teruma gedola vehu shehikdimo beshibbolin, o maaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu af al pi shello natan et hachomesh. hare ze mevarech techilla vasof. vechen kol keyotze bahen:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 2: Seder birkat hammazon kach hi. rishona birkat hazzan. sheniyya birkat haaretz. shelishit bone yerushalayim. reviit hattov vehammetiv. beracha rishona moshe rabbenu tikkenah. sheniyya tikken yehoshua. shelishit tikken david ushelomo beno. reviit chachme mishna tikkenuha:

Happoalim shehayu osin melacha etzel baal habbayit veachlu pittan en mevarchin lefaneha. umevarchin leachar seuddatan shete berachot bilvad kede shello yevattelu melechet baal habbayit. beracha rishona ketikkunah. sheniyya poteach bevirkat haaretz vecholel bah bone yerushalayim vechotem bevirkat haaretz. veim hayu osin bisuddatan bilvad o shehaya baal habbayit mesev immahen mevarchin arba berachot ketikkunan kishar kol adam:

Birkat haaretz tzarich lomar hodaya bitchillatah uvesofah vechotem bah al haaretz veal hammazon. vechol shello amar eretz chemda tova urechava bevirkat haaretz lo yatza yede chovato. vetzarich lehazekir bah berit vetora ulehakdim berit letora. shehabberit hazzot sheomrim bevirkat haaretz hi berit mila shennichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot vehattora kullah nichretu aleha shalosh beritot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 28 69)</small> "elle divre habberit" vegomer, <small>(Devarim 28 69)</small> "millevad habberit asher karat ittam bechorev", <small>(Devarim 29 9)</small> "attem nitztzavim" vegomer <small>(Devarim 29 11)</small> "leavrecha bivrit" vegomer:

Beracha shelishit poteach bah rachem Adonai elohenu alenu veal yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal tziyyon mishkan kevodecha. o nachamenu Adonai elohenu birushalayim irecha vechotem bah bone yerushalayim o menachem ammo yisrael bevinyan yerushalayim. ulefichach nikret beracha zo nechama. vechol mi shello amar malchut bet david bivracha zo lo yatza yede chovato mippene shehi inyan habberacha, sheen nechama gemura ella bachazarat malchut bet david:

Beshabbatot uveyamim tovim matchil benechama umesayyem benechama veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza. ketzad matchil. nachamenu Adonai elohenu betziyyon irecha o rachem Adonai elohenu al yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha. umesayyem menachem ammo yisrael bevinyan yerushalayim o bone yerushalayim. veomer baemtza beshabbat elohenu velohe avotenu retze vehachalitzenu Adonai elohenu bemitzvotecha uvemitzvat yom hashshevii haggadol vehakkadosh hazze ki yom ze gadol vekadosh hu millefanecha nishbot bo venanuach bo beahava kemitzvat retzonecha birtzoncha hanach lanu Adonai elohenu veal tehe alenu tzara veraa veyagon vaanacha beyom menuchatenu. uveyamim tovim omer yaale veyavo. vechen berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed mosif beemtza beracha shelishit yaale veyavo:

Bachanukka uvefurim mosif beemtza birkat haaretz al hannissim kederech shemmosif battefilla. veyom tov o rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat mazkir retze vehachalitzenu techilla veachar kach yaale veyavo. vechen rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihyot beshabbat mazkir al hannissim bevirkat haaretz uretze vehachalitzenu veyaale veyavo benechama:

Beracha reviit tzarich lehazekir bah shalosh malchuyyot. ucheshemmevarech haoreach etzel baal habbayit mosif bah beracha levaal habbayit. ketzad. omer yehi ratzon shello yevosh baal habbayit baolam hazze velo yikkalem laolam habba vechulei. veyesh lo reshut lehosif bevirkat baal habbayit ulehaarich bah:

Ucheshemmevarchin bevet haavel omer bivracha reviit hammelech hachay hattov vehammetiv el emet dayan emet shofet betzedek shallit beolamo laasot bo kirtzono sheanachnu ammo vaavadav uvakkol anachnu chayyavin lehodot lo ulevarcho. umevakkesh rachamim al haavel lenachamo kefi ma sheyyirtze. vegomer harachaman kulei:

Bevet chatanim mevarchin birkat chatanim achar arba berachot ellu bechol seudda useudda sheochlim sham. veen mevarchin beracha zo lo avadim velo ketannim. ad kamma mevarchin beracha zo. im haya almon shennasa almana mevarchin otah beyom rishon bilvad. veim bachur shennasa almana o almon shennasa betula mevarchin otah kol shivat yeme hammishte:

Beracha zo shemmosifin bevet chatanim hi beracha acharona mishsheva berachot shel nissuin. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu haochlin hem sheamdu bevirkat nissuin veshamu habberachot aval im hayu haochlin acherim shello shamu birkat nissuin bishat nissuin mevarchin bishvilam achar birkat mazon sheva berachot kederech shemmevarchin bishat nissuin. vehu sheyyihyu asara. vachatanim min hamminyan:

Veellu hen sheva berachot. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam yotzer haadam. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shehakkol bara lichvodo. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher yatzar et haadam betzalmo betzelem demut tavnito vehitkin lo mimmennu binyan ade ad baruch atta Adonai yotzer haadam. sos tasis vetagel akara bekibbutz baneha letochah besimcha baruch [atta] Adonai mesammeach tziyyon bevaneha. sammeach tesammach reim vaahuvim kesammechacha yetzircha began eden mikkedem baruch atta Adonai mesammeach chatan vechalla. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bara sason vesimcha chatan vechalla gila verinna ditza vechedva ahava achava shalom vereut mehera Adonai elohenu yishshama beare yehuda uvechutzot yerushalayim kol sason vekol simcha kol chatan vekol kalla kol mitzhalot chatanim [mechuppatam] unearim minneginatam baruch atta Adonai mesammeach chatan im hakkalla:

Shachach velo hizkir beshabbat o beyom tov kedushshat hayyom. im nizkar kodem sheyyatchil bivracha reviit beshabbat omer baruch Adonai asher natan menucha leammo yisrael leot velivrit kodesh baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat. beyom tov omer baruch asher natan yamim tovim leammo yisrael lesashon ulesimcha baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim. umatchil bevirkat reviit vegomer. veim nizkar achar shehitchil bivracha reviit posek vechozer larosh shehu birkat hazzan:

Berashe chodashim shachach velo amar yaale veyavo im nizkar kodem sheyyatchil beracha reviit omer baruch asher natan rashe chodashim leammo yisrael lezikkaron veeno chotem bah umatchil bivracha reviit vegomer. veim nizkar achar shehitchil bivracha reviit gomer otah veeno chozer. vechen bechullo shel moed uvachanukka uvefurim, shachach velo hizkir hainyan bevirkat hammazon eno chozer:

Mi sheachal veshachach velo berech. im nizkar kodem sheyyitakkel hammaachol shebbemeav chozer umevarech. nitakkel hammazon shebbemeav eno chozer umevarech. vechen im neelam mimmennu velo yada im berech o lo berech chozer umevarech vehu shello nitakkel hammazon shebbemeav:
